title: Software Engineer
description:
At Precis, we are a group of friendly experts in media buying, analytics & marketing science, creative and technology with a joint mission to help great companies thrive in the digital landscape.
   

  

 Are you curious to learn more about us? Read more about us here. For insights into what life is like at Precis and a peek at the perks of working with us, visit this page. In our Handbook, you can get a neat summary of who we are, our culture and our offices.
 **In** 
**this document** 
**, we have summarised what our recruitment process looks like. Take a look!**
 One of our most exciting products is Alvie, a cutting-edge SaaS platform for performance marketing optimization. Designed to deliver data-driven insights for e-commerce, B2C, and other companies, Alvie helps businesses fine-tune marketing strategies with precision. In addition to scaling Alvie, we’re constantly building and developing new features, AI-driven workflows, and data capabilities to help clients maximize their marketing investments.
   

  

 We are currently expanding our technology team and looking for curious, fast-learning engineers across different areas of expertise, ranging from
 **Frontend & Software Engineering to Data Engineering & Data Science** 
 . Whether you love building intuitive user interfaces, experimenting with
 **AI workflows** 
 , or designing robust data pipelines, if you are excited about modern tech stacks and fast-paced learning, we want to hear from you!
   

  

*We are committed to building an inclusive and fair workplace that attracts talent and advances its people, regardless of their background, experiences or perspectives. We believe that a diverse set of minds will continue to contribute to our innovative culture and our ability to reinvent ourselves constantly.*
**What You Will Be Doing 💼**
 We are currently growing two specific teams within our tech team. We are looking for engineers to join our Creative Tech team (building ad reporting features and tools for managing creative assets within our SaaS platform) and engineers for our Data & Analytics team (scaling our data pipeline stack and building robust attribution models)
   

  

* Build Modern Applications & Interfaces: Develop clean, responsive UI components and frontend experiences using ReactJS, Next.js, and modern TypeScript.
* Integrate AI & LLM Workflows: Experiment with and integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI tools into our products and developer workflows to build smarter, faster features.
* Power Data & Analytics: Work with SQL/NoSQL databases, data modeling, and pipelines to ensure our analytics engine and AI models have clean, high-quality data.
* Learn & Adapt Fast: Rapidly test new technologies, benchmark tools, and adapt as the modern software and AI stack evolves.
* End-to-End Ownership: Collaborate across functional teams to take features from early ideation and prototyping all the way to production deployment.


**What We Are Looking For ✔️**
 We care more about your curiosity, problem-solving mindset, and speed of learning than a rigid checklist. We welcome applicants with strengths in either software engineering/frontend OR data engineering/data science, paired with a generalist curiosity.
   

  

* Fast Learner & Adaptable Mindset: A high capacity to pick up new tools, languages, and frameworks quickly.
* Core Technical Foundation:
* Experience with Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Node.js.
* Hands-on exposure to modern frameworks (e.g., ReactJS, Next.js, FastAPI, ExpressJs Flask, or Django).
* Exposure to cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), Docker, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* AI Tooling Curiosity: Practical experience or strong interest in using AI dev tools, prompt engineering, or building with LLMs.
* Data Literacy: Experience with data modeling, statistics, data warehousing (BigQuery, Snowflake), dbt, or data pipeline orchestration.
* Collaborative Spirit: Strong communication skills and a team-first mindset.


**What Will Make You Stand Out (track-specific Bonuses) ✔️**
 You don’t need all of these! We are building a well-rounded team across these areas:
   

  

* Domain Interest: Experience or interest in digital marketing, ad tech, or e-commerce analytics.
* AI & LLM Engineering: Practical experience building RAG architectures, prompt pipelines, agentic workflows, or working with vector databases
* Frontend & Data Visualization: Ability to translate complex data into clean, intuitive user interfaces using interactive visualization tools
* Data & Pipeline Infrastructure: Working with third-party marketing APIs (Meta, Google, TikTok Ads) and exposure to microservice architecture and tools like airflow


**WHAT WE OFFER 🌟**
*You can read our full offering in our* 
*handbook* 
*.*
* An intense learning environment where you will be able to grow and develop your skills and passions alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry.
* A culture that is built on collaboration, trust and innovation. We value having fun together - that’s why we also have regular afterworks, team events and a yearly festival.
* Transparent salary setting - you can find it below the job description on our website!
* 30 days paid leave, flexible public holidays, parental pay, a solid pension scheme and key insurance. Our different offices also offer different perks such as massage, health care contributions, free book orders, healthy snacks & great coffee, EAP programs and your choice of PC or Mac.
* A diverse environment with a high focus on inclusion and belonging. We speak 46 native languages around Precis, and our internal inclusion score is 4.5 out of 5.


**PRACTICAL INFORMATION 🤔**
* We are open to different seniorities. Initially, we are looking for people currently on L2-L3.
* Preferably you'll work in our Stockholm, Copenhagen or Gothenburg office, but we are open to candidates in any of our Precis offices.

**We update all candidates on their applications by email. If you don't receive an email from us, please check your spam folder.**

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
**Who are Benifex?** 
 💚💜
   

  

 We are a fast-moving technology company, and
 **one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world.** 
 We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build
 **workplace technology** 
 that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to
 **build remarkable experiences that employees love.** 
 Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best,
 **we need brilliant people** 
 on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀
   

  

**Why should you apply? 🌟**
* Impact: work on a product suite used by millions of people that improves employee experience and wellbeing.
* Scale: a big focus of our engineering teams is building features and services to support our customers globally.
* Autonomy: have an input into the product roadmap and technically lead features/services.
* Development: this is a crucial part of our aim to ensure a seamless experience across FPS.
* Top 10 Employer, Sunday Times Best Places to Work Awards
* Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and benefits space


****Great Benefits****
 🧠 ITP1 pension.
   

  

 ❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings.
   

  

 📝 Collective agreement.
   

  

 💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal.
   

  

 🤸 Generous wellness allowance.
   

  

 ✈️ 30 vacation days / year.
   

  

 💰 Referral bonuses.
   

  

 🌟 Enhanced parental pay.
   

  

 🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.
   

  

****Role Overview 🚀****
 As a Software Developer in one of our platform-oriented teams, you'll work almost entirely on backend development (90%+), with occasional, light frontend involvement.
   

  

 The team owns the foundational components and services that the rest of the platform is built on, such as the core frameworks, the user and company data domain, and the APIs and platform services that every other team depends on. Reliability, data integrity and security are central to everything the team delivers.
   

  

 This role is focused on turning business and architectural needs into well-built, maintainable systems: designing clean APIs, evolving long-lived frameworks safely, and helping share knowledge across our internal developer community.
   

  

 You'll also help shape our ways of working and technical direction. You'll join a focused team of engineers working alongside a tech lead, a product manager and an engineering manager in Gothenburg.
   

  

 We are also on a journey to use AI more deliberately in our daily engineering work. We are looking for someone who has practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows, or who wants to keep exploring how these tools can help us move faster, improve quality, understand complex codebases, and reduce repetitive work without lowering our engineering standards.
   

  

****Responsibilities 🤘****
* Design, build and maintain backend services, APIs and shared frameworks to a high standard.
* Evolve and progressively refactor a large, long-lived codebase safely.
* Treat non-functional qualities such as reliability, backward compatibility, data integrity, security and performance as high priority.
* Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, working with domain experts to keep solutions aligned with the business.
* Participate in code reviews and uphold shared coding standards.
* Write automated integration and component tests.
* Help drive technical decisions, reduce technical debt, and document and share knowledge so critical areas aren't held by one person.


****Responsibilities 🤘****
* Develop backend services and maintain high coding standards.
* Contribute to frontend changes using JavaScript and TypeScript when needed.
* Collaborate with developers, product owners, UX designers, and other stakeholders.
* Participate in code reviews and uphold team coding standards.
* Implement automated integration and component tests.
* Drive technical strategy, refactor legacy code, and reduce technical debt.
* Engage in pair and mob programming sessions to solve the more complex problems together.


**What are we looking for? 🔎**
* Strong experience with Java, SQL, and Spring / Spring Boot.
* Solid understanding of Git and CI/CD pipelines.
* API design and development (REST / OpenAPI).
* As this is central to the role, we want someone who cares about clear, well-versioned, dependable interfaces.
* Experienced in evaluating trade-offs between solution design, quality, and timeframes.
* Comfort working in large, established codebases.
* This includes reading unfamiliar code, understanding existing frameworks, and making careful, incremental changes rather than rewriting from scratch.
* Practical experience in Domain-Driven Design, including working with domain experts to build well-aligned, maintainable systems.
* A collaborative way of working. This means enjoying being in the office with the team as required, working through pair and mob programming when it helps, communicating openly, and constructively challenging ideas.


**Important, But Not Essential:**
* Microservices experience: Most of our work happens within an established platform and its shared frameworks, so we value the judgement to know when a service boundary is worth drawing more than a long list of microservices built.
* AI-assisted development: We care more about a learning mindset and curiosity for using AI tools to work better than about existing skillset.
* Cloud platforms: We're progressively moving towards GCP, we experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) is preferred.
* Asynchronous messaging, pub/sub and system integration, and data-exchange patterns.
* Observability and monitoring tooling (e.g. Grafana) and Hibernate.


**Please note:** 
 Our recruitment process will begin in mid-to-late August, once the hiring team has returned from their summer holidays. We appreciate your patience and look forward to reviewing your application.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving and reading your application!
   

  

**Our Interview Process ✌**
 Benifex understand the need to have a fast and efficient process, the below will all be completed in the shortest time possible, typically a 2-2.5 week timeframe.
   

  

 📞 Initial informal call with the Talent team
   

  

 ⏳ Interview with our Engineering Director 30-45 min
   

  

 🧪 Technical Task
   

  

 🔎 Technical Interview - 60 min
   

  

 🤩 Final interview with VP of Engineering - 30-45 min
   

  

  

  

**We are a proud member of the Disability Confident employer scheme.**
**If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage during the recruitment process, please let us know with your application.**

title: Fullstack Engineer - Node, Python & Applied AI
description:
Playground Dev
   

  

* Stockholm
* Hybrid


 Fullstack Engineer - Node, Python & Applied AI
   

  

 Playground Dev is the software engineering company in Playground Group. We're a tight-knit team in central Stockholm, and we're in a growth phase: expanding across backend, fullstack and AI engineering. This opening is the fullstack part of that.
   

  

 Titles matter less to us than what you've built and how you work with others. The distance from idea to production is short here, and we'd like to keep it that way as we grow.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 This role is primarily for
 **our in-house team & platform deliveries** 
 : group-wide initiatives that several companies in Playground Group depend on. The environments are complex - multiple systems, multiple stakeholders, real data flowing through - and the deliveries matter, which is exactly why we're strengthening the team around them.
   

  

 All our work is done in teams. You'll be part of a Playground team shipping these platforms together, doing solid backend engineering with a growing slice of applied AI on top.
   

  

**In Practice**
* Build and own backend systems that run in production across the group
* Design APIs, services and data flows in environments with many moving parts
* Work with AI integrations such as LLMs and agents
* Deploy and operate systems in cloud environments
* Contribute to internal products and technical initiatives


 Who we're looking for
   

  

 You're comfortable across the full stack and you've reached a point where you can reason about trade-offs, navigate large systems and stay steady when things get complex. We work a lot with Node.js, TypeScript, React, Next.js and Python in multi-cloud environments. Experience with Rust, Go, Java or similar is a big plus.
   

  

 You write code that holds up in production, and you care about shipping. You share what you know rather than hoarding it.
   

  

 On the AI side: you're already a strong engineer who wants to go deeper into applied AI. You don't need to know LLMs, agents, RAG or knowledge graphs going in. Curious and hands-on is enough - you'll learn it as part of real deliveries, alongside our AI engineers.
   

  

 Side projects, open source, weird experiments? Tell us about it.
   

  

 How we work
   

  

 Three types of engagements. This role sits mainly in the first two:
   

  

* In-house platform deliveries for group-wide initiatives
* Team-based client solutions with shared ownership
* Consulting engineering for clients who need extra technical strength


 AI is part of our daily workflow, from delivery process to how we learn and solve problems. We spend real time understanding new tools and learning from each other, and the bar is high.
   

  

 You won't sit in a narrow box. You'll collaborate with backend, fullstack and AI-focused engineers across deliveries, and put your skills where they create the most impact.
   

  

 Practical details
   

  

* Based in central Stockholm
* Fluency in Swedish is a strong plus, and English is required.
* Some assignments require extended background vetting.
* No visa sponsorship or relocation support. You need an existing, independent and permanent right to work in Sweden.
* The final stage of recruitment includes a background check by a third party.

 Här får du arbeta långsiktigt med utveckling av digitala tjänster som stödjer Naturvårdsverkets verksamhet och Sveriges miljöarbete. Du blir en del av ett erfaret team från Softronic där vi tillsammans tar ansvar för att säkerställa bästa möjliga kvalité i utvecklingen av Naturvårdsverkets tjänster.
   

  

**Varför du kommer att trivas hos oss**
* Du får arbeta med ett uppdrag som gör skillnad. De lösningar vi utvecklar tillsammans med Naturvårdsverket bidrar till att digitalisera och effektivisera viktiga delar av Sveriges miljöarbete.
* Du får påverka, på riktigt. Vi arbetar nära kunden och tar ett stort ansvar för lösningarna vi utvecklar. Som senior utvecklare får du vara med och påverka både tekniska vägval och hur vi arbetar tillsammans.
* Du blir en del av ett erfaret team. Här finns kollegor att diskutera lösningar med, lära av och dela kunskap med. Vi tror på att utvecklas tillsammans.


 Och ja, vi vet att livet är mer än jobb. Därför erbjuder vi ett tryggt anställningspaket med kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och flexibla lösningar för balans i vardagen.
   

  

**Som senior .NET-utvecklare hos oss kommer du att**
* Arbeta med systemdesign, arkitektur och implementation i Microsofts teknikstack.
* Utveckla och vidareutveckla e-tjänster och andra digitala lösningar för Naturvårdsverket.
* Vara delaktig i tekniska vägval och bidra med din erfarenhet i teamet.
* Arbeta nära både kund och kollegor i ett agilt team.
* Dela kunskap och stötta andra utvecklare


**Vi vill att du har**
* Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av .NET-utveckling och Microsofts teknikstack.
* Erfarenhet av agila utvecklingsmiljöer.
* Ett självgående och strukturerat arbetssätt.
* Förmåga att ta ansvar för tekniska lösningar och samtidigt bidra till teamets gemensamma leverans.
* Ett stort teknikintresse och en nyfikenhet på nya tekniker, verktyg och arbetssätt. Du håller dig gärna uppdaterad inom ditt område.
* God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift.

* E-tjänster.
* Offentlig sektor.
* Större eller komplexa systemmiljöer.
* Erfarenhet av JavaScript/react.


**Varför Naturvårdsverket?**
 Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med teknik i ett sammanhang där systemen har ett tydligt syfte. Naturvårdsverket har en central roll i Sveriges miljöarbete och digitalisering är en viktig del i att göra information, processer och tjänster mer effektiva och tillgängliga.

title: Cobol Programmer
description:
På IT Liv och Pension jobbar vi för att skapa ett Folksam som är enklare, snabbare, mer lönsamt och kundorienterat.
 



  





 Vill du arbeta med IT som stödjer Folksamsgruppens livaffär? Här är utvecklingstakten hög för att förflytta oss mot framtiden, uppfylla partskrav och regelverk. Du får jobba tillsammans med många erfarna och högpresterande kollegor, i ett nära samarbete mellan IT och affärsverksamheten.
 



 Vi söker nu en engagerad Cobolutvecklare som vill bli en del av vårt team och arbeta nära Folksams affär. Är du redo att göra skillnad?
 



  





**Det här gör du som Cobolutvecklare på Folksam** 




 Som utvecklare hos oss jobbar du med nyutveckling, förvaltning och livscykelhantering av våra system. Du tillhör ett team som jobbar efter agila principer. Förutom att koda så arbetar du med analys, test och design. Våra system finns på Mainframe. Vår vardag präglas av tät dialog med både verksamhet och IT. Vi behöver samverka med alla roller som behövs för innovativ problemlösning och utveckling. Där blir du en viktig lagspelare som stärker teamet och bidrar till att vi når resultat, kan fira framgångar och ha roligt tillsammans på jobbet! Vi värderar ditt engagemang, vilja att lära och utvecklas samt dina personliga egenskaper högt. Tillsammans med oss levererar du systemstöd till Folksams viktigaste processer - det gör arbetsdagarna varierande och spännande.
 




 Läs
 
 gärna mer om hur Maria berättar om sin roll som Cobolutvecklare hos oss - kanske är hon din nya kollega?
 



  





 Folksams IT-enhet består av cirka 750 personer i nio sektioner. Sektionen IT Liv och pension ansvarar för Folksams system för våra liv- och pensionsförsäkringar. Vi befinner oss i ett spännande skede då vi moderniserar och förflyttar vår affär till målplattformerna Lumera och vårt egenutvecklade KPP. Samtidigt behöver vi fortsätta att förvalta och utveckla våra stordatorsystem.
 



  





 Vi arbetar nära vår affärsverksamhet och vårt arbetsklimat kännetecknas av engagemang och stor drivkraft.
 



  





**Är du den vi söker?** 




 Vi söker dig som har minst fem års erfarenhet av Cobolutveckling och som trivs i en miljö där både förvaltning och problemlösning är en självklar del av vardagen. Du gillar att jobba agilt och vill vara med och påverka både teknik och affär. Har du dessutom erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen – särskilt livförsäkring – är det ett stort plus.
 



  





 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har flerårig erfarenhet av:
 


* COBOL-utveckling på IBM Z Mainframe
* CICS – för att hantera transaktioner i realtid.
* JCL – för batchhantering och styrning av jobb.
* DB2 och SQL – för databashantering och affärslogik.
* Compuware Topaz – för modern utveckling och analys i mainframe-miljö.



  





 Det är meriterande om du även behärskar följande:
 


* AQT (Advanced Query Tool) – för effektiv databasutveckling och felsökning.
* TSO/ISPF - utvecklingsmiljö/terminal interface



  





 Du är ansvarstagande, nyfiken och gillar att driva saker framåt. Problemlösning är något som engagerar dig! För att trivas och lyckas i rollen behöver du ha god samarbetsförmåga, både inom ditt eget team och tillsammans med andra team och intressenter. Du har ett starkt teknikintresse, är självgående, nyfiken och har en vilja att ständigt lära och utvecklas för att skapa värde.
 



  





**Här kan du göra skillnad** 




 Välkommen till Folksam – här driver du viktiga frågor framåt. Från de avgörande detaljerna till de stora perspektiven, med fokus på att förenkla våra kunders vardag. Det gör att du bidrar till något större, oavsett roll. Här finns det många roliga, utvecklande jobb och du har goda chanser till en spännande karriär.
 



  





 Vi tror på ett hållbart arbetsliv och jobbar aktivt med inkludering och mångfald. Våra moderna kontor bjuder in till samarbete och lärande, här får vi saker att hända! Du har flexibiliteten att kunna varva arbete på kontoret med att jobba hemifrån, utifrån verksamhetens behov.
 



 Läs mer och se filmer om livet hos oss på
 
 folksam.se/jobb-och-karriar.
 




  





**Så söker du jobbet** 




 Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan senast den 17 september 2026.
 



  





 Vill du veta mer om jobbet? Kontakta gruppchef Susan Wollberg 070-228 96 83.
 




 Här
 
 kan du läsa mer om vilka bakgrundskontroller som kan vara aktuella i den här rekryteringen.
 



  





 Fackliga representanter: Akademikerföreningen Per Hansson 070-831 60 67, Forena Mari Leppioja 070-831 54 29 och Handels Mikael Carlsson 070-831 51 32.
 



  





*Kundägda Folksamgruppen erbjuder sedan 1908 försäkringar och sparande som ger trygghet i livets alla skeden. Vi gör det enklare för våra fyra miljoner kunder att känna sig trygga i en hållbar värld genom rätt försäkringar, rätt sparande och rätt hjälp när något händer.*

title: AI Ops Engineer (People Team)
description:
**TL;DR**
 We're looking for an exceptional AI Software Engineer to build the AI-powered People systems that help Lovable scale.
   

  

 As Lovable grows, we're rethinking how work gets done. Rather than relying on traditional HR software, we're building AI-native products that transform hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, identity, compliance, and other core People workflows.
   

  

 You'll work embedded with our People team, partnering closely with stakeholders to understand problems, design solutions, and ship production-ready software. Many of the products you build won't stop at improving Lovable internally — they have the potential to become capabilities we offer to customers in the future, giving you the opportunity to shape products that start inside Lovable and scale far beyond it.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**Why join now?**
 Very few engineering roles offer this level of ownership.
   

  

 You'll help define how AI transforms internal operations. You'll work directly with the People team to identify problems, design solutions, and build products that improve how Lovable operates every day.
   

  

 As Lovable scales, we're building the operating system the company runs on—function by function, directly in Lovable. The People team is one of the first. You'll help define how AI transforms one of our most important internal functions, and the best ideas will eventually become building blocks for our customers.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 We're looking for a software engineer with strong product instincts and experience building secure software that handles sensitive information.
   

  

**You'll likely have:**
* Experience shipping production software that handles sensitive data — HR tech, fintech, identity management, or similar.
* Experience working with people data, business systems, analytics platforms, or enterprise data infrastructure (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Airflow, Fivetran, SQL, etc.).
* Deep familiarity with HR systems and/or ATS platforms (HiBob, Ashby, Workday, Greenhouse, or similar), either as a builder or through close collaboration with People teams.
* Experience designing secure systems with role-based access control and data permissioning.
* Strong product instincts—you think end-to-end, ask why, and care about building products people actually use.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate operational challenges into technical solutions.
* Experience building products from scratch and taking them into production.


**Bonus points if you have:**
* Experience at an HR technology company, Work OS platform, or identity provider,
* Experience with HRIS, ATS, compensation, workforce planning tools.
* Experience building AI-powered products or internal tooling.
* Experience working closely with People or Operations teams.


**What You'll Do**
**In one sentence:**
 Build AI-powered People systems that make Lovable run better — and create products that can graduate from internal tools to customer-facing features.
   

  

**Examples include:**
* Partner with the People team to identify, scope, and ship AI-powered internal products.
* Build integrations with HR systems (HiBob, Ashby, etc.), ATS platforms, and identity providers.
* Design secure systems with robust role-based permissions and access controls.
* Develop predictive and diagnostic models (workforce trends, hiring capacity, retention risks, compensation dynamics).
* Create canonical datasets and source-of-truth models for hiring, headcount, compensation, organizational design, and workforce planning.
* Data governance — source-of-truth logic, naming conventions, ownership.
* Own products end-to-end—from research and design through implementation, deployment, and iteration.
* Translate operational challenges into elegant technical solutions.
* Build systems that meet legal and compliance requirements for handling sensitive employee data.
* Work closely with other AI Ops Engineers, sharing building blocks, patterns, and learnings across Lovable's functions.
* Build AI agents, workflows, dashboards, and decision-support tools that help leaders make better decisions.


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love.
   

  

**Languages:** 
 TypeScript, Python, Go
   

  

**AI:** 
 OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP, AI Agents
   

  

**Business Systems:** 
 HiBob, Ashby, Okta
   

  

**Infrastructure:** 
 Cloudflare, PostgreSQL, Temporal
   

  

 We're always looking for better tools and better ways of building software.
   

  

**About Your Application**

 We review every application carefully and encourage anyone excited by the role to apply, even if your background doesn't perfectly match every bullet point.

title: DataOps Engineer
description:
**About The Job**
 Are you looking for a role where your engineering skills create real business value? As a DataOps Engineer in NOBA Bank Group, you’ll be instrumental in ensuring that raw data is efficiently transformed into structured, high-quality assets. You’ll play a key role in modernizing and maintaining our data infrastructure, implementing new technologies, and enabling the organization to innovate and grow through reliable, accessible, and well-managed data operations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Data & Analytics Engineering department brings together specialists in data infrastructure, analytics, and data management. Together we build a modern and reliable data foundation that supports decision making across the business. This role is for Data Management & New Initiatives team under Data & Analytics Engineering department.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines, partner with teams across the bank, and ensure that business critical data needs are met. You will take responsibility for ensuring continuous operations of our data warehouse across all domains, making sure daily processes run smoothly and data is readily accessible for all users. You’ll also monitor data infrastructure performance, proactively troubleshoot issues, and collaborate with other engineers to develop our security and business continuity best-practices.
   

  

 This is a great opportunity to enjoy a high degree of self-responsibility and expand your expertise into areas of your interest. You’ll collaborate broadly and see the tangible results of your work.
   

  

 We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team building, and enjoying fikas and after work gatherings together!
   

  

**Main Tasks**
* Design, build, and maintain data pipelines using Databricks and dbt.
* Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines for data workflows.
* Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and DevOps teams to ensure robust, scalable, and reliable data operations.
* Monitor data infrastructure performance and proactively perform troubleshooting to ensure high availability and reliability.
* Ensure data quality, security, and compliance throughout the data lifecycle.
* Monitor data infrastructure performance and proactively perform troubleshooting to ensure high availability and reliability.
* Enhance data usage and accessibility by applying modern data engineering practices
* Document processes and contribute to best practices.


**We Are Looking For You Who**
 Enjoys working at the intersection of data engineering and operations, ensuring that data infrastructure is robust, efficient, and reliable. You are passionate about automating processes, monitoring systems, and proactively resolving issues to keep data flowing smoothly across the organization.
   

  

 You are proactive and detail-oriented, with a genuine curiosity for new technologies and best practices in Data. You thrive in collaborative environments, approach challenges with a “can-do” mindset, and enjoy transforming complex operational problems into practical, scalable solutions. You value a high degree of self-responsibility and are motivated to expand your expertise in areas that interest you, contributing to both the stability and innovation of our data platform.
   

  

**For This Role, You’ll Need**
* Experience working in DataOps/ AI Ops, Data Engineering, or similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and operations.

* An academic degree in a relevant field such as data engineering, computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline.

title: Analytics Engineer (in-house)
description:
We are looking for a full-time
 **Analytics Engineer** 
 in-house (m/f/d) to join our motivated global Insights team starting as soon as possible
 **in the Stockholm or Munich office** 
 .
 



  





**The Role** 




 As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions.
 



  





 As a vital member of our international IT organization, you will be involved in the foundation of our internal product development and will join the cross-functional data team that is responsible for developing and maintaining Netlight's business-critical data platform and strives to decentralize analytics. That is why it is important that you are a self-driven person, who is comfortable with taking initiative and responsibility, as well as a service-minded and communicative team player.
 



  





**Who you are** 



* A trusted communicator who builds relationships across technical and non-technical stakeholders and translates data into decisions
* Self-driven and proactive, but also team-oriented, with sound judgment on when to lean on AI tools for speed and when human oversight and design thinking matter more
* Comfortable working in ambiguity — organized yet flexible, able to adapt as tools, priorities, and team structures evolve quickly
* A curious, fast learner with a growth mindset — genuinely energized by new tools, AI-assisted workflows, and continuously raising your own technical bar



  





**Qualifications** 



* Based in
 **Stockholm or Munich**
* A degree in a quantitative field (e.g. software engineering, computer science, economics, mathematics, statistics) — if you think you’re a great fit, we want to hear from you!
* At least 2+ years of relevant experience in fields like Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, or Software Development.
* Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience building and testing data models in dbt on a cloud warehouse, and an understanding of dimensional data modeling (star schemas, facts and dimensions)
* Solid grasp of version control with Git, including CI/CD workflows for data pipelines
* Familiarity with Python for data transformation, automation, and light pipeline work
* Fluent in written and spoken English (business level)
* Comfort working with AI copilots and AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g. Copilot-style code/doc generation, AI BI assistants) while maintaining human oversight on data quality and design
* Bonus: Experience with, or strong interest in, semantic layers and metric governance — ensuring a single, trusted definition of key business metrics that both humans and AI tools can rely on



  





**What you will do** 




 As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions.
 



  






 Data Modeling & Quality
 



* Transform raw data into clean, usable datasets for analytics and business intelligence, and AI use cases.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain a semantic layer and single source of truth for key business metrics.
* Ensure data quality and consistency across teams and tools.
* Build and maintain robust, well-documented data models using Snowflake and dbt.




 Governance & Enablement
 



* Provide compliant, user-friendly access to data across various tools (e.g. Power BI, Excel, or AI-powered BI assistants).
* Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need.
* Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end, balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Maintain clear documentation and metadata (data catalog, definitions, lineage, ownership) so both people and AI tools can trust and correctly interpret the data




 Optimization & Agile Delivery
 



* Continuously evaluate and improve data models for performance and scalability.
* Contribute to agile ways of working, participating in planning, refinement, and delivery cycles.
* Stay current with emerging tools and practices in the data stack (e.g. orchestration, observability, AI-assisted development) and help the team adopt what's genuinely useful.



  





**What we offer** 



* The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry
* Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
* Modern and centrally located
 **offices in Stockholm or Munich**
* A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
* Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
* Mental health & parental support offerings
* 30 days of paid vacation.



  





 Specific benefit package if positioned in
 **Stockholm:** 



* 5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
* Private pension savings



  





 Specific benefit package if positioned in
 **Munich:** 



* Deutschlandticket
* Wellpass



  





**About us** 




 Netlight is an international digital consulting firm, helping leading companies to succeed in the digital landscape, from advice to implementation. Our service contains the collective intelligence of more than 2200 consultants offering a comprehensive range of digital services, from strategy to technology. Co-creating the future today, since 1999.
 



  





 Netlight has been awarded several times for profitable growth and management, as a top employer, and for our engagement in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Located in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen, Munich, Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Zurich, Cologne, Amsterdam, Madrid, Toronto, Vienna and London.
 



  





**Come work with us** 




 Netlight as a company strives to be a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive organisation. Regardless of who you are, what personality, background, and experience you have, you enrich our culture through your values. Netlight’s purpose is to unleash full potential, realise great careers, and fulfil personal growth.
 



  





 To achieve this, we have a highly engaged network organisation, where every employee gets a mentor, delivery coach, and personal communities. The key to our continued success is trust and personal responsibility, diverse experiences, challenging opportunities, and development based on personal values. Every Netlighter is an active part of building and shaping this culture, which leads to a clear correlation between personal growth and the growth of Netlight.
 



  





**Apply today** 




 Should your experience and education match, we will get back to you within two weeks after your application. Feel free to contact us on LinkedIn if you have any further questions.
 



  





 Please apply with your resume in English. Links to relevant projects, GitHub, or IaC repositories are welcome. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Data Platform Engineer, Solna
description:
Are you passionate about the infrastructure of scalable, secure, and future-proof data platforms that power analytics, AI, and business-critical insights? Do you thrive in environments where automation, cloud technologies, and platform reliability are at the core of everything you do? We're looking for a Data Platform Engineer who wants to play a pivotal role in shaping and operating a modern Azure and Databricks-based data platform that enables data-driven decision-making, advanced analytics, and AI innovation at scale.
   

  

**About The Role**
 In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure that supports analytics, reporting, AI, and data product development. You will help establish platform standards, develop automation capabilities, and ensure the platform remains secure, scalable, and resilient. Working closely with Data Architects, Data Engineers, Enterprise Architects, and Security teams, you will drive the evolution of a modern cloud-based platform that enables seamless data ingestion, processing, and consumption across the organization.
   

  

 As a key member of the team, you will manage and optimize Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake, networking, and supporting platform services. You will implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, and create observability frameworks that provide transparency into platform health, performance, and cost efficiency. You will also play an important role in troubleshooting complex issues, improving operational excellence, supporting disaster recovery planning, and enabling AI and machine learning capabilities through robust platform engineering practices.
   

  

 Beyond the technical responsibilities, you will act as a trusted subject matter expert, helping engineering teams adopt cloud platform best practices while continuously driving improvements in reliability, security, governance, and operational efficiency.
   

  

 ,
   

  

 We're looking for someone who combines a strong engineering foundation with hands-on experience building and operating the infrastructure of enterprise-scale cloud platforms.
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or similar roles.
* Proven experience designing, implementing, and operating secure, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure in Azure.
* Experience supporting modern data platforms, analytics, AI, and machine learning workloads.


**Key Technical Skills**
 We're looking for someone with strong expertise across several of the following areas:
   

  

* Azure cloud and data platforms, including Azure Databricks Administration, Azure Data Lake, data integration services, and analytics workloads.
* Infrastructure as Code and platform automation, including Terraform, Git, CI/CD, automated provisioning, and configuration management.
* Containerized and cloud-native environments, including Kubernetes and Docker.
* Cloud networking and identity management, including Azure Networking, Entra ID/IAM, DNS, connectivity, private networking, routing, and firewalls.
* Security, compliance, and governance, including implementation of security controls and governance frameworks within regulated environments.
* Observability and platform operations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, high availability, platform reliability, and cost optimization (FinOps).
* Scripting and automation, using Python, PowerShell, or Bash.


**Nice to have**
 Experience with any of the following would be considered an advantage:
   

  

* Microsoft Purview and Apache Airflow.
* MLOps and Azure AI Services.
* Multi-cloud environments.
* Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, or Databricks Platform Administrator certifications.
* Experience from the logistics industry.


**Language Requirements**
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken
* Swedish, Danish, Finnish, or Norwegian is considered an advantage


**Who you are**
 You are a curious and proactive engineer who enjoys solving complex challenges and building reliable platforms that create value at scale. With a strong analytical mindset and a passion for troubleshooting, you thrive in environments where continuous improvement, automation, and operational excellence are key. You take a structured approach to problem-solving, have a natural sense of ownership, and are committed to delivering high-quality solutions. At the same time, you're a collaborative team player who builds strong relationships across Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Business teams, enabling effective stakeholder engagement and driving results through cross-functional collaboration.
   

  

**Apply**
 Welcome to submit your application! The selection is ongoing, but please note that due to the summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take longer than usual and response times may therefore be delayed. We appreciate your patience and understanding. If you have any questions or concerns, please email recruiting manager Linda Njeru at linda.njeru@postnord.com.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you!
   

  

 Read more about our union representatives

title: LEAD DATA ENGINEER
description:
**Challenges You Will Work On**
 At SAS, data is the engine behind everything we build from AI models and personalized offers to real-time operational intelligence. As Lead Data Engineer, you will strengthen the engineering foundation that makes all of it possible: reliable, scalable, well-operated data products, pipelines, and integrations. You will work closely with the Data Architect to turn architectural direction into practical engineering standards, modern DataOps practices, and production-ready solutions that create real business impact.
   

  

 We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer who will act as a senior engineering leader and close partner to the Data Architect, driving the development of scalable and reliable data solutions across SAS. You will lead the implementation of engineering standards for data testing, observability, monitoring, , SLAs, version control, and DataOps practices, while supporting teams in adopting modern software engineering practices.
   

  

 You will work at the technical frontier of our data stack, leading implementation choices, code reviews, technical standards, and engineering quality across data products, pipelines, and integrations. In close collaboration with the Data Architect, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will bring modern perspectives on data products, DataOps, and software engineering craft, while ensuring solutions are aligned with the broader enterprise architecture and stakeholder priorities.
   

  

 As Lead Data Engineer you will bring deep engineering expertise and hands-on DataOps leadership, helping transform architectural intent into robust, maintainable, and production-ready solutions.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Include**
* Lead the design, development, and operation of scalable data pipelines, data products, and integrations.
* Establish and drive engineering standards for testing, documentation, observability, monitoring, , SLAs, version control, and DataOps.
* Partner with the Data Architect to translate architectural direction into practical implementation patterns and reusable engineering standards.
* Lead code reviews and drive continuous improvement of engineering practices across the team.
* Mentor and support data engineers and DataOps engineers in modern tools, standards, and software engineering practices.
* Collaborate with architecture, data stewardship, IT, cloud teams, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions meet quality, security, governance and operational requirements.


 The Team
   

  

 The Analytics & Data team develops and manages the data infrastructure that powers AI, analytics, and business operations at SAS. We build and maintain data pipelines, data products, and enterprise integrations on a modern cloud platform.
   

  

 Working closely with the AI & Automation team, analysts, and business units across SAS we ensure that trusted and accessible data is available where it is needed. Our work spans batch and near-real-time pipelines, data product development, and integration with core operational systems.
   

  

 As SAS continues to expand its AI and analytics capabilities — including a new Customer Data Platform, agentic AI pilots, and an expanding BI estate — the demand for high-quality and well-engineered data infrastructure continues to grow. We are looking for a lead who can drive this forward.
   

  

 To be successful we believe you have
   

  

* A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of hands-on data engineering experience, including experience in a senior or lead role.
* Strong skills in SQL and Python, with experience in Spark or similar distributed processing frameworks.
* Experience building and operating cloud-based data pipelines, preferably in Azure using services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse, or equivalent.
* Solid understanding of data modelling, data warehouse design, data lake architecture, and enterprise data solutions.
* Practical experience with DataOps, version control, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, alerting, and operational SLAs.
* Experience with orchestration and transformation tools such as Azure Data Factory, Airflow, Prefect, Lakeflow, or dbt.
* Strong mentoring skills and an passion for helping others grow through clear standards, documentation, and practical guidance.
* A collaborative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to bring practical engineering perspectives into architectural discussions.


 Why SAS?
   

  

**Benefits**
 At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
   

  

* Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
* Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
* Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
* Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
* Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


 Our Culture at SAS
   

  

 At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
   

  

 Come and fly with us!
   

  

 Additional information
   

  

* Apply by: 11/09/2026. We review applications continuously, so please send us your CV as soon as you can. The role may be filled before the deadline.
* Start and scope: Full-time role, starting with a 6-month probation period.
* Location: You’ll be based at our office in Frösundavik, Solna, Stockholm. This is mainly an onsite role, with some flexibility for remote work depending on the agreement with your manager.
* Security: As this role is security classified, a background check will be part of the final stage of the recruitment process.


 If you have any questions about the role, please contact Jonas Blomqvist, Head of Analytics & Data, at jonas.blomqvist@sas.se. Please note that, due to GDPR, we can’t accept applications by email.

title: Product Engineer - Growth Lab
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

**Summer hiring notice:** 
**Due to summer vacations, we will begin the reviewing and interviewing process for this role from August. However, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.**
 We're a product-led company where engineers don't just ship features; they shape what gets built and why.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Growth Lab helps self-service users start, return, and expand with Mentimeter, finding and acting on high-impact opportunities across the user lifecycle. Experimentation is at the heart of how we work: we form hypotheses, test them with real users, and let the results guide what we do next.
   

  

 We care about learning and impact over output. We move quickly, collaborate closely across engineering, product, and design, and hold our work loosely. We are happy to change direction, or throw code away, when the evidence points elsewhere. Exactly how we work keeps evolving; what stays constant is a curious team that learns fast together.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Comfortable driving growth experiments end to end, ready to pick up any step (hypothesis and feasibility, implementation, tracking, analysis, and the decision to kill, iterate, or ship) while we work closely together as a team
* Design and instrument experiments using our stack: Confidence for assignment and data quality and HEX for digging into data questions
* Build tracking and instrumentation with discipline, so every experiment produces results we can actually trust
* Take outcome-driven product problems and drive them to measurable movement in KPI’s spanning acquisition, activation, adoption, and conversion
* Raise the bar on experimentation craft within the team: strengthen how we design, instrument, and analyse experiments, and lead technical discussions that bring clarity to fuzzy problems
* Partner closely with the PM and Product Designer on framing and prioritising bets, and step in to drive the thinking when needed


**Who You Are**
* Hands-on experience in growth engineering / experimentation, backed by solid all-round engineering experience - you're already up and running in the discipline and don't need to learn it from scratch
* You've run the full growth loop yourself: hypothesis → ideation → implementation → post-experiment analysis, and you've used experimentation tooling (Confidence or similar)
* You independently own and solve complicated problems: work with several moving parts and dependencies, weighing trade-offs and applying sound technical judgment to land a solid solution
* Data-savvy: comfortable forming and answering your own data questions, and setting up experiments that produce clean, trustworthy results
* A strong communicator who enjoys working with people outside the team - you can package an idea, bring others along, and step into a product-thinking role when the moment calls for it
* You lift the people around you: you mentor teammates and raise craft standards rather than working in isolation
* You hold your code loosely - motivated by impact on users and the business, not by the code itself, and happy to throw work away when an experiment says so
* A genuine growth mindset, curious about problems beyond pure engineering and energised by ambiguity
* Fluent in written and spoken English (Swedish is not required)


**Location & work arrangement**
 This role is based at our Stockholm headquarters, with a hybrid arrangement of 3 days/week on-site. We're unable to offer relocation sponsorship for this position.
   

  

**We offer**
* Competitive compensation, including pension contributions
* Leadership and professional development programs, plus access to external coaching
* A budget and culture that supports continuous learning
* Genuine flexibility and a healthy approach to work-life balance
* A diverse, international team of 50+ nationalities who care about doing great work and having fun doing it


*At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you. The salary range for this role is SEK 54,000–SEK 70,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.*
*Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements. We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.*
***In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here:***
***https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm***
***.***
**What Mentimeter Can Offer**
 At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
   

  

 All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
   

  

**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
   

  

* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.


 AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
   

  

**Culture at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
   

  

 Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
   

  

 Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

title: Senior Principal Runtime Engineer
description:
The era of pervasive AI has arrived. In this era, organizations will use generative AI to unlock hidden value in their data, accelerate processes, reduce costs, drive efficiency and innovation to fundamentally transform their businesses and operations at scale.
   

  

 SambaNova Suite™ is the first full-stack, generative AI platform, from chip to model, optimized for enterprise and government organizations. Powered by the intelligent SN40L chip, the SambaNova Suite is a fully integrated platform, delivered on-premises or in the cloud, combined with state-of-the-art open-source models that can be easily and securely fine-tuned using customer data for greater accuracy. Once adapted with customer data, customers retain model ownership in perpetuity, so they can turn generative AI into one of their most valuable assets.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Runtime team at Sambanova is a seasoned engineering team with a proven track record of delivering cutting-edge system software solutions for AI and machine learning applications in the enterprise & commercial landscape.
   

  

 Runtime is responsible for the lowest levels of the SambaNova stack, efficiently interacting with the hardware to provide the best application performance and maximize hardware utilization. We handle all aspects of software infrastructure to enable higher level applications, including:
   

  

* High performance user libraries
* Operating System interface/integration
* Data model manipulation for scaling
* Networking/communication intra and inter node
* Orchestration of partitioned workloads
* Error monitoring and tools for system management and observability


 We build a high performance, distributed and scalable software execution environment for SambaNova DataScale & Cloud platforms to support data-flow applications such as ML training and inference and HPC applications.
   

  

 We are searching for a software engineer who will work on all parts of the runtime stacks, supporting AI, ML, and scientific applications in high-performance distributed systems. You will participate in building, testing and deploying next-generation high-performance compute systems for AI applications at scale. We expect the candidate to have a strong background in programming, building and testing software in distributed systems, performance tuning of large scale systems, and good teamwork and planning skills.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work on design and implementation of new and enhanced features of the runtime stack to support high performance and scalable ML inference and training applications
* System software (drivers and kernel) support for the next generation silicon.
* Design user-space libraries for high performance and high utilization of HW resources.
* User-facing tools (analysis, job and HW management, profiling, debugging, etc) for Datascale systems.
* Collaborate with other teams including Hardware, ML Application, Compiler, DevOps.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent and with 3-5 years of industry experience
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python
* Experience with user space libraries, operating systems, and kernel drivers
* Experience working with highly concurrent and distributed systems, with a focus on performance and scalability


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with different types of fabrics, such as PCIe, Infiniband, and RoCE
* Experience with fast networking stacks, such as RDMA
* Good communication skills and enthusiasm to help colleagues


**Submission Guidelines**
 Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.
   

  

**EEO Policy**
 SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

**Benefits Summary For US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions**
 SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

title: Principal Database Engineer
description:
Are you driven by innovation and looking to thrive in a fast-paced, growing environment? Join us at Calabrio-Verint and be part of our dynamic team! Help us in reshaping the landscape of customer experience – where every interaction becomes an opportunity, and every insight drives meaningful change.
 



 Calabrio-Verint are he trailblazers in customer experience intelligence! Revolutionizing the way organizations connect with their customers, we empower businesses to elevate every interaction to new heights. Our cutting-edge cloud platform, coupled with AI-driven analytics tools, unlocks the true essence of customer sentiment, turning data into actionable insights with lightning speed.
 



 As a
 **Principal Database Engineer** 
 you are responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and optimizing database systems to ensure secure, reliable, and efficient management of organizational data. Beyond day-to-day database ownership, you serve as the connective tissue for how data is structured across our products — holding deep domain and data-model expertise that enables cross-product data mapping and integration. In your role, you support business operations by delivering high-performing, enterprise-scale database solutions and ensuring data availability, integrity, and security.
 



 \*\*Candidate must be located in Stockholm, Sweden.\*\*
 



  





**What You'll be doing:** 



* Own and maintain deep expertise in the organization's domain model — designing database structures, schemas, tables, indexes, and data models that reflect how data is structured and related across products.
* Develop and optimize queries, stored procedures, and database processes to improve system performance and efficiency.
* Map and reconcile data models across products to enable cross-sell initiatives and other data-integration efforts, acting as the go-to technical authority for adjacent teams on how data connects across the platform.
* Monitor database health, troubleshoot issues, and implement performance tuning and capacity planning activities to meet the scale and performance demands of large enterprise customers.
* Implement and maintain database security controls, including user access management, encryption, and compliance requirements.
* Support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence needs through data extraction and database solutions.
* Collaborate with application developers, data teams, and infrastructure teams to integrate and support enterprise systems.
* Maintain database documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies and best practices to improve scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Set database standards and best practices across teams, and act as the senior technical point of contact for data-integration questions from product, engineering, and adjacent teams.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 10+ years of professional experience with strong knowledge of SQL and database platforms such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL. Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Understanding of data modelling, indexing, query optimization, and database architecture.
* Programming and automation skills using languages such as Python, Java, or C#.
* Expertise in database security, backup and recovery, and performance management.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.
* Experience mapping and integrating data models across multiple products or systems, and supporting database performance at enterprise scale.
