title: Customer Service Representative (f/m/d) - Sweden
description:
**Are you ready to change the market?**
 PAIR Finance has been reshaping debt collection across Europe since 2016, combining technology and AI-powered communication to make debt collection fairer, more transparent, and more human. We work with leading European companies to create customer experiences that put people first, even when conversations involve sensitive financial matters.
   

  

 We’re currently expanding our Swedish team in Stockholm and are looking for a
 **Customer Service Representative (f/m/d)** 
 who enjoys helping people, solving problems, and finding the right solution. You’ll communicate directly with consumers (B2C), clients, and third parties, handling a wide range of questions and cases with empathy, confidence, and attention to detail. Whether you’re resolving a complaint, supporting a customer through a complex situation, processing a case, or sharing valuable feedback with our product team, your work will have a direct impact on how people experience debt collection.
   

  

 If you’re a strong communicator, stay calm in challenging conversations, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where your work makes a real difference, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

 Ready to make a difference? Apply now and join our team in Sweden.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities:**
* Communicate confidently with consumers, clients, and third parties (e.g. lawyers, debt counseling agencies, bailiffs) via phone, e-mail, chat, and letter - always solution-oriented and to the point
* Handle legal and regulatory inquiries, including criminal charges, data protection requests, and court files
* Route client inquiries to the right internal contacts and make sure nothing falls through the cracks
* Process case files in a commercially effective way and keep CRM systems accurate and up to date
* Collect feedback from clients and consumers and feed it back into the improvement of our technology and services
* Contribute to the development of internal processes and team structures


**What we're looking for:**
* Hands-on experience in B2C customer service, ideally with a focus on receivables management/debt collection.
* Passion for contributing to fast-paced environments and to continuously improve processes and standards.
* A solution-oriented, customer-centric mindset with a highly collaborative way of working.
* Business-level fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken - this is essential for the role
* Solid MS Office skills and a genuine interest in new technologies, including AI


 Transparency, Execution, Ownership, Customer Centricity, Innovation and Integrity are important to us and we at PAIR Finance embody these values. We are a technology-driven company that embraces AI and intelligent tools to work smarter. We value teammates who share that curiosity, bring a creative mindset, and are excited to explore new ways of doing things.
   

  

**Our offer for you:**
* An international team of professional colleagues and strong experts that form an inspiring network working together to achieve success
* Individual development opportunities and a transparent, appreciative feedback culture for your personal growth
* Mobile working in a hybrid model for more flexibility in your everyday life. In addition, up to six weeks of work abroad per year upon arrangement
* A meaningful job with the innovative leader in Europe's debt collection industry and a job with a great purpose
* We want you to have a healthy work-life balance. As far as we can, we organize flexible working hours and the possibility to work partly from home
* 28 days of annual leave
* Language courses and training opportunities adapted to your individual situation
* Modern offices at international locations with fresh fruit and drinks for a feel-good working environment
* Regular team and company events to celebrate successes together


**Who is your contact person?**
 Your contact person for this position is Jasmin Baldrich. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us via email (jobs@pairfinance.com) - we look forward to hearing from you!
   

  

 For more information about PAIR Finance, please visit our website and our careers page.
   

  

**About Us**
 We are rethinking debt collection with our digital debt collection solution, characterized by our high customer orientation and efficiency standards. By using artificial intelligence, we are combining technology with behavioral science and so we are able to contact customers individually and in a simple way throughout the entire collection process.
   

  

 Strengthened by one of the most renowned private equity firms in the fintech sector, Pollen Street, as well as partnerships with other investors such as Zalando Payments, PAIR Finance offers an excellent opportunity to dive deep into and actively shape the fintech industry.
   

  

 PAIR Finance is an equal-opportunity employer. We value a diverse team and an inclusive culture. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of ethnicity, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, or disability.
   

  

 For more information about PAIR Finance, visit www.pairfinance.com/ and www.pairfinance.com/karriere/ and www.trustpilot.com/review/www.pairfinance.com
   

  

 Do you want to find out more about PAIR Finance and the position? We are happy to answer your questions and also to receive your application!

title: Systemadministratör – Produktion
description:
Är du en tekniskt nyfiken systemadministratör som gillar att förstå hur saker fungerar på djupet? Trivs du nära tekniken och motiveras av att felsöka, automatisera och skapa stabila lösningar i verksamhetskritiska miljöer?
   

  

 Vi söker nu en
 **Systemadministratör inom produktion** 
 som vill arbeta brett med drift, förvaltning och vidareutveckling av produktionsnära IT-system. Här får du en roll där du både arbetar operativt med den dagliga driften och är med och förbättrar och automatiserar miljön framåt.
   

  

 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med komplexa tekniska miljöer där tillgänglighet, säkerhet och stabilitet är avgörande.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder dig
   

  

* Trygga anställningsvillkor och fast månadslön
* Långsiktiga och utvecklande konsultuppdrag
* Möjlighet att arbeta med verksamhetskritiska och tekniskt komplexa miljöer
* Två valfria certifieringar per år
* Kompetensutveckling och möjlighet att växa inom Nexer
* En närvarande konsultchef och en individuell utvecklingsplan
* Ett stort nätverk av kollegor och specialister inom drift, support och infrastruktur
* Gemensamma aktiviteter, föreläsningar, after works och lunchträffar


 Din roll
   

  

 Som Systemadministratör blir du en viktig del av ett team som ansvarar för att säkerställa hög tillgänglighet, prestanda och säkerhet i produktionsnära IT-system.
   

  

 Du arbetar hands-on med drift, övervakning, felsökning och förvaltning, men rollen innehåller också ett tydligt fokus på utveckling och förbättring. Vi söker därför dig som inte bara vill hålla systemen igång, utan som också tycker om att fundera på hur arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar kan bli smartare, stabilare och mer automatiserade.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att innebära att:
   

  

* Drifta, övervaka och förvalta servermiljöer inom Windows och Linux
* Felsöka och hantera incidenter i produktionsmiljö
* Installera, konfigurera och vidareutveckla system och tjänster
* Automatisera rutiner och processer genom scripting, exempelvis PowerShell och Azure DevOps
* Arbeta med SQL och databashantering
* Hantera integrationer och dataflöden mellan olika system
* Genomföra systemuppdateringar och arbeta med säkerhetsrelaterade åtgärder
* Arbeta med PAM och behörighetsstyrning
* Dokumentera tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt
* Identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och bidra till en mer effektiv och stabil IT-miljö
* Samarbeta med interna team, andra tekniska specialister och externa leverantörer


 Vi söker dig som
   

  

 Har erfarenhet av systemadministration, drift, teknisk support, systemförvaltning eller en liknande teknisk roll och känner dig bekväm med att arbeta hands-on i IT-miljöer.
   

  

 Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. För oss är det viktigare att du har en stabil teknisk grund, är nyfiken och har förmågan att självständigt felsöka och sätta dig in i nya system och tekniker.
   

  

 Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:
   

  

* Windows Server och Linux
* Scripting och automation, exempelvis PowerShell
* Azure DevOps
* SQL och databashantering
* Nätverk och kommunikation
* Drift och övervakning
* Incidenthantering och felsökning
* PAM och behörighetshantering
* Produktionsnära eller verksamhetskritiska IT-miljöer


 Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* CheckMK eller andra verktyg för övervakning
* Logghantering och prestandaoptimering
* Jira och arbete i sprintar
* ServiceNow och ärendehantering


 Om dig
   

  

 Vi tror att du är en person som tycker om att lösa problem och som inte ger upp när svaret inte är uppenbart från början. Du är analytisk och strukturerad samtidigt som du är nyfiken och gärna testar dig fram för att förstå hur olika delar av en miljö hänger ihop.
   

  

 Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och driver dem framåt självständigt, men trivs samtidigt med att samarbeta och dela kunskap med andra.
   

  

 Eftersom rollen innebär kontakt med både tekniska kollegor, verksamheten och externa leverantörer är det också viktigt att du är kommunikativ och har lätt för att samarbeta.
   

  

 Framför allt söker vi dig som
 **gillar teknik på riktigt** 
 och som vill fortsätta utvecklas inom drift, automation och moderna infrastrukturlösningar.
   

  

 Mer om Nexer Infrastructure
   

  

 Nexer Infrastructure, tidigare Sigma IT Tech, startade sin verksamhet 2018 och är specialister på kompetens inom drift, support och infrastruktur.
   

  

 Vi hjälper organisationer att utveckla och framtidssäkra sina IT-miljöer genom våra konsulter och arbetar med välkända kunder inom både privat och offentlig sektor.
   

  

 Som konsult hos oss blir du en del av ett bolag där vi lägger stor vikt vid både din utveckling och din trivsel. Vi vill förstå vad du är bra på idag, men också vart du vill ta nästa steg i din karriär.
   

  

 Hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas genom nya uppdrag, certifieringar och utbildningar samtidigt som du har en trygg anställning och ett team bakom dig.
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot att höra mer om dig och vad du vill göra härnäst!
   

  

 Har du frågor om rollen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare:
   

  

**Jenny Örvell**
 Nexer Infrastructure

title: HP Business Development Manager
description:
Take charge of growing the HP business in Sweden’s commercial and public segment, driving strategic initiatives, building strong relationships with HP and Dustin account managers, and making a tangible impact on business development success.
   

  

**This is what makes the position as HP Business Development Manager unique**
* Drive growth of HP's Client Portfolio business by building strong, strategic relationships
* Identify new business opportunities using HP data, tools, and leads to actively support commercial sales growth
* Take ownership of driving HP business growth and creating impactful initiatives that deliver measurable results


 In this role, you will be responsible for driving the growth of the Client Portfolio business and strengthening relationships with our strategic vendor, HP. You will be part of the vendor management team while working closely with the commercial and public sales team to develop impactful initiatives that stimulate business growth. Your responsibilities will include building strong connections between HP and Dustin account managers, identifying new business opportunities, and leveraging HP’s tools, data, and leads to support commercial sales.
   

  

 This hybrid role combines two days at our Nacka office with one day at HP’s office, plus flexibility for remote work. You’ll support larger deals, join HP events, and work closely with the vendor manager driving the overall strategy, while you focus on business development.
   

  

 My name is Arjan Kats. I'm the hiring manager for the HP growth Manager role. As a leader, I value personal development and guidance highly. We place a strong emphasis on personal development and guidance, fully tailored to each employee’s expertise and needs, while remaining mindful of the different tasks they undertake. You may be highly autonomous in one area yet require additional support in another; we will address these areas together, empowering you to grow both professionally and personally. Furthermore, there is always room for your own contribution, as we believe your ideas can drive success.
   

  

**Your role & influence as HP Business Development Manager**
*Responsibility* 
 : You will be given responsibility for significantly growing HP’s Client Portfolio business within the commercial and public segment in Sweden, driving strategic initiatives and business development together with both HP and Dustin account managers—essentially acting in a Business Development Manager capacity
   

  

*Collaboration* 
 : Together with your team, you take care of strengthening the relationship with our strategic vendors within Dustin. You'll work closely not only with your immediate team members but also with departments such as Sales, Category Management, and Marketing, aligning on strategic business plans and ensuring the best possible communication.
   

  

*Core activities:*
* Grow HP’s Client Portfolio business in the commercial and public segment
* Act as the bridge between Dustin and HP account managers
* Work closely with the vendor manager to develop and launch impactful initiatives


**Benefits Of Joining Dustin**
 We believe there's more to Dustin than just the benefits listed here. You'll fully understand this once you're with us. Curious? Our Life at Dustin page has you covered.
   

  

**You can find more of our benefits below in the vacancy.**
**This Is What We Imagine You Bring**
 We envision you as a curious and driven individual who is passionate about business development, building strong relationships, and driving significant growth in strategic partnerships.
 *Please note: we are not looking for consultants, freelance professionals, or acquisition based on this vacancy.*
*Additionally, it's important that:*
* Experience with business development or commercial sales
* Strong presentation skills – expected to speak to groups regularly
* Familiar with relationship building and nurturing
* You gain a lot of energy from actively wanting to drive the business forward
* Fluent in English and Swedish, with English being the primary language used across the company


**What can you expect next?**
 To ensure a fair recruitment process free from unconscious bias, we handle your application anonymously and do not accept cover letters. Please refrain from sending one, so that the selection is based solely on professional competencies. We expect the following steps in the recruitment process:
   

  

* Telephone screening with TA partner Sander Dirks
* 1st interview with the Hiring Manager Arjan Kats
* Assessment (Personality- and cognitive thinking test)
* 2nd interview with the Vendormanager HP & Arjan Kats


 For questions about the position, please contact the TA Partner Sander via e-mail.

title: Territory Sales Manager, Upper Extremities (Stockholm)
description:
At Stryker, we are driven to make healthcare better.
   

  

 We are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Territory Sales Manager to join our Upper Extremities business in Sweden. This role is focused on managing and growing key customer relationships across Stockholm and Northern Sweden, while driving new business opportunities within a highly specialized orthopedic portfolio.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity for a strong sales professional who thrives in a dynamic clinical environment and enjoys building long-term partnerships with surgeons and healthcare stakeholders.
   

  

**Upper Extremities Products:** 
 Upper extremities | Stryker
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Build and maintain strong relationships with surgeons, clinical teams, and key stakeholders
* Provide expert product and procedural support in the operating theatre
* Identify and develop new business opportunities to grow market share
* Create and execute a clear, strategic territory plan with defined priorities and actions
* Support tenders, pricing discussions, and commercial negotiations
* Collaborate cross-functionally to unlock opportunities and deliver results
* Mentor and support junior colleagues when needed


**What You Bring**
* Minimum 4 years of sales experience within medical devices or a related healthcare environment
* Proven track record of achieving or exceeding targets
* Strong commercial acumen and results-driven mindset
* Ability to build credibility and communicate confidently in clinical environments
* Fluency in English and Swedish
* Highly self-motivated, resilient, and proactive
* Strong organizational and planning skills
* Collaborative team player with influencing skills
* Valid driving licence


**Nice to Have**
* Experience within orthopedics or upper extremities
* Knowledge of shoulder arthroplasty or related procedures
* Background as a physiotherapist or nurse combined with commercial experience
* Experience managing complex healthcare stakeholders


**What Sets You Apart**
* A consultative, customer-first mindset
* Ability to identify opportunities and convert them into tangible results
* Confidence navigating both public and private healthcare systems
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability for your territory


**Sweden Pay Ranges:**
* Sweden: kr493.000 - kr823.000 SEK Annual


 At Stryker, we believe transparency helps candidates make confident decisions about their next career step. Compensation is an important part of that process and we want to be clear about how pay is determined. The compensation information posted for this role may be presented as a salary range or a fixed amount depending on the role. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation (such as bonus and/or commissions where applicable), along with Stryker’s comprehensive benefits package.
   

  

 If you’d like to learn more about the salary or the benefits associated with this role, your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details as you progress through the hiring process.
   

  

 Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Technology Director B2C
description:
**About The Job**
 At Impact Commerce, we're looking for a Technology Director to set our technical vision, bridge the gap between technology and business, and help shape the future of digital commerce — for our clients and for our own organisation.
   

  

 With deep technical expertise, you'll integrate solutions that support digital transformation and strategic objectives, lead the development of advanced solutions, stay ahead of industry trends, and oversee operations to ensure projects land on time and on budget.
   

  

 This is a dual role: half consulting, half commercial. You'll provide visionary technical leadership on high-stakes client engagements, while also acting as a trusted advisor to our Sales organisation — translating deep technical expertise into business value that wins deals and builds lasting client relationships.
   

  

 YOUR PROFILE
   

  

 As Technology Director, you will set a clear tech vision aligned with business goals and develop a strategic tech plan that drives innovation and competitiveness. You'll build strong relationships with stakeholders — including C-level executives — bridging the gap between technical and non-technical teams to ensure successful project delivery
   

  

**We Expect Someone Who**
**Strategic vision & market leadership**
* Build and drive industry innovation and blueprint development — defining, improving, and owning our strategic technical blueprints.
* Partner with Sales and Account Management to translate technical complexity into clear business value propositions, ensuring a smooth, well-informed sales process.
* Secure that everyone in Sales understands Impact Commerce's tech priorities — acting as the connective tissue between our technology roadmap and our commercial teams.
* Engage in pre-sales activities, including technical presentations, client workshops, and discovery sessions — identifying client pain points and designing tailored technical solutions.
* Combine deep tech insight with sharp commercial understanding to deliver real business value.
* Collaborate closely with C-level executives, marketing, sales, and product teams to align technology strategy with broader business goals.
* Lead digital transformation efforts and champion innovation through cutting-edge technology solutions.


**Technical mastery & domain expertise**
* Master the intricacies of B2C processes — from commerce to lead generation and marketplaces.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership during key phases of client projects, overseeing architecture, design, development, and implementation.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for prospective clients during proposal and pitch phases, ensuring solutions align with both client needs and internal capabilities.
* Offer ongoing technical consultation to key clients — identifying optimisation opportunities and presenting technical roadmaps.
* Mentor and guide development teams on new technologies and approaches; lead technical workshops to upskill internal teams.
* Design holistic, end-to-end architecture with specialisation in areas such as frontend, martech, and integrations.
* Maintain and grow our organisation's platform expertise.


**Strategic thinking & collaboration**
* Lead through thought leadership and expert opinion — be a recognised authority whose insight shapes decision-making.
* Build cross-functional relationships that connect diverse disciplines into cohesive solutions.
* Act as solution architect and strategic thinker, translating complex ideas into actionable plans.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to internal and external stakeholders alike.
* Own a leadership role with a dotted-line reporting structure, blending formal and informal leadership.


 We are looking for a team member, who can contribute to a fun and healthy everyday culture at IMPACT while ensuring a high standard in collaboration with your colleagues.
   

  

**At Last, We Imagine You Have**
* Experience as a CTO, Senior Technology Director, or in a similar role leading transformative projects.
* Strong consultancy and sales expertise, with a track record of translating technology into commercial value.
* Demonstrated success leading high-stakes, full-cycle commerce projects.
* A strong ability to articulate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Deep technological understanding of platforms such as Commercetools, Contentful, and Optimizely.
* An international outlook — global experience and a diverse leadership profile are a strong plus.
* A genuine drive to be an individual contributor and a visionary leader in equal measure.


**Who You Are**
* A strategic thinker and innovation leader who shapes and owns the future of commerce.
* A communicative leader who builds trust by making complex technology understandable to any audience.
* A natural cross-functional bridge builder who thrives working alongside C-level executives.
* An expert with deep technological insight and strong B2C process proficiency.
* A decisive, inspiring leader who acts as a trusted advisor and guides others through digital transformation.


 LIFE AT IMPACT
   

  

 Commerce has never stood still. Neither have we. For more than 25 years, we have helped ambitious businesses turn change into growth by taking the time to understand what truly moves their business. What started in Aarhus, Denmark has grown into a European powerhouse with offices across the world.
   

  

 From strategy and experience to technology, data, and execution, every capability sits under one roof. That’s how we move faster, align better, and build solutions that hold over time. We work close by. We think long-term. And we take responsibility for bringing technology, strategy, and execution together - helping brands grow with clarity and confidence in the
 *next era of commerce.*
 IMPACT is built by specialists who care deeply about what they do, and take responsibility for what they deliver. Wherever commerce happens, we show up with the same standards, the same accountability, and the same ambition. Because consistency is what builds trust, across borders and over time.
   

  

 CONTACT
   

  

 Send your CV via the link below. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis, as the position is to be filled as soon as possible.
   

  

 If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Christian Kerrn-Jespersen at +45 23299249
   

  

 We are looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**You could call it a Delivery Manager for our Analytical team**
**But we’re actually looking for a passionate leader with technical skills**
 Are you passionate about leading others and want to be an important piece in the digitalization journey within the business area Industrial at the Nordic region's largest insurance company?
   

  

 The Industrial business area is facing interesting challenges and now needs to strengthen our team with an experienced Delivery Manager who has experience from agile way of working and building and leading high-performing teams.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Delivery Manager you will take both the formal leadership - and team lead of the teams’ progress. This means stretching from operational to strategic areas of responsibility. You will lead, coach, support and challenge your team, and together with the Product Owner steer its work in a journey becoming more efficient within the data analytics - and reporting area utilizing latest tech capabilities such as Ai development supported tools and technologies.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Your team consists of nine IT Analytics professionals in the BI&Reporting/Analytics domain, one of four domains in the If IT-unit Industrial. We believe in having an atmosphere built on trust and stability where employees have the possibility to truly put our hearts into our job – even though we sometimes have a short deadline to explain complex matters. This also means that we need to be flexible, so except that you’ll contribute with your competence in the analytics area, you are expected to work with all IT teams needing your skills. And last but not least; we welcome you to an informal working environment with lots of smiles and a positive attitude.
   

  

**Who are you?**
 Today you are working in an IT development team inspired by agile methodologies in which you feel confident. You have a manager or Team lead role securing operational and tactical progress, governance and all that comes with that, preferably with people formally reporting to you.
   

  

 You find this role interesting because you want to continue evolving your leadership skills but at the same time want to keep a foot in the technique and not afraid of “getting your hands dirty” if needed. You love to see people grow, strive for a good working environment delivering high-class business values.
   

  

 The responsibility requires good planning, communication, involvement and securing progress and follow-up of the teams’ delivery and communicated plans. Continued communication with internal stakeholders of the teams’ work and progress is an important part of the role. The position entails a planning diet and budget responsibility.
   

  

 In parallel with implementing business requirements, we place great focus on IT quality-enhancing measures and innovation to secure If Industrial's insurance business in the future.
   

  

**You also have:**
 A structured and focused mindset, enjoying taking personal responsibility, having a strong drive and commitment and doing this with a coaching leadership style. You have good communication skills and concepts such as quality, customer orientation and innovation are a matter of course for you. You have a proactive solution-oriented work attitude, like to have a lot of “balls in the air” with a high integrity and a "service-minded" attitude.
   

  

* 5-7 + years of documented experience of leadership roles within IT
* Documented experience from working with Datawarehouse/Analytics solutions, preferably Insurance business
* At least 5+ years of documented experience of working with IT system management
* At least 5+ years of documented experience of working with translating requirements and needs into IT solutions
* Documented experience of working with agile development methodology
* Fluent in Swedish and English in speech and writing
* Formal education: Bachelor's degree or higher


 You will report to the Head of IT Industrial, be a part of the IT Industrial mgmt. team and together with our Nordic organization have great opportunities to influence and contribute to IT Industrial's development.
   

  

**Finally**
 We have an attractive benefits package including subsidized lunches, 6 weeks paid vacation, cheaper access to insurances (obviously), an attractive pension plan, annual bonus for employees and more… We pride ourselves in having a very low employee turnover – we like it here!
   

  

**Additional Facts And Recruitment Process**
**Application deadline** 
 : Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, deadline to apply is 2026.09.18
   

**To apply for the position:** 
 Please attach your CV and answer the questions in the application form.
   

**Work location** 
 : Bergshamra in Stockholm.
   

**Travelling** 
 : Expect some travelling in the Nordics + Baltics.
   

  

**Start:** 
 As soon as possible/by agreement.
   

  

**For more information, please contact** 
 : Peter Thörnqvist, Head of IT, BA Industrial, peter.thornqvist@if.se
   

  

 We look forward to your application!

title: (Senior) Applied Scientist, Recommendations
description:
**About Wolt**
 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
   

  

 Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
   

  

 Wolt is part of DoorDash - together we form one of the world’s largest local commerce platforms. We build recommendation systems that help customers discover the most relevant restaurants, dishes and items throughout their Wolt experience.
   

  

 We are looking for an Applied Scientist to advance the machine learning models behind these experiences. You’ll work on challenging applied ML problems where model quality, product decisions and customer experience are tightly connected. This is an opportunity to take ideas from problem framing and data analysis through experimentation, production deployment and measurable customer impact.
   

  

 What you’ll be doing
   

  

* Design, develop and improve recommendation, ranking and retrieval models that surface relevant restaurants, dishes, items and content to customers.
* Own applied ML problems end to end: frame the problem, analyze data, develop models, define offline evaluation, run experiments and monitor production performance.
* Develop methods that balance relevance with product and customer needs, such as diversity, availability, business constraints and changing user intent.
* Collaborate closely with Software Engineers, ML Engineers, Product Managers and Analysts to turn scientific insights into reliable customer-facing products.
* Evaluate and apply state-of-the-art ML methods where they meaningfully improve recommendation quality, robustness or efficiency.
* Contribute to a high bar for applied-science practice through technical reviews, knowledge sharing and thoughtful experimentation.


 Our humble expectations
   

  

* You have substantial hands-on experience applying machine learning to real-world problems and a track record of bringing models from development into production; a PhD with relevant applied research experience is equally welcome.
* You have experience with recommendation systems, ranking, retrieval, personalisation, or closely related ML problems.
* You can independently turn an ambiguous customer or product problem into a well-scoped ML approach, make sound trade-offs and drive it to a measurable outcome.
* You are proficient in Python and experienced with modern ML frameworks and large-scale data processing.
* You understand how to evaluate ML systems rigorously, including offline metrics, experiment design and interpreting online results.
* You communicate complex technical ideas clearly and work effectively with cross-functional partners.


 What we offer
   

  

 You will work on recommendation problems with direct, measurable impact on how customers discover relevant content. You’ll collaborate with experienced scientists and engineers across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt, learning from multiple recommendation systems while helping shape the next generation of the experience.
   

  

 Together with your lead, you will have the opportunity to create a personalised development plan that builds on your strengths and develops new capabilities.
   

  

 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
   

  

 We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Suomenkielinen Business Developer
description:
Miksi BrightAnalytics?
   

  

 BrightAnalytics on yksi Belgian nopeimmin kasvavista fintech-yrityksistä. SaaS-ratkaisumme avulla autamme yrityksiä automatisoimaan johdon raportoinnin. Osana Euroopan laajentumistamme etsimme motivoituneita kollegoita liittymään tiimiimme Tukholman toimistolle. Ruotsista käsin osallistut Suomen markkinoiden kasvuun. Sinulla on mahdollisuus kasvaa ja muokata yrityksen tulevaisuutta Pohjoismaissa.
   

  

 Mitä Business Developer tekee?
   

  

* Ymmärrät prospektiemme vaatimukset ja tarpeet, ja esittelet heille BrightAnalyticsin tarinan.
* Kartoitat liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia kohdennetun segmentoinnin avulla.
* Kasvatat Account Executive -tiimimme liidien määrää kohdennetuilla myyntitoimenpiteillä (outbound-myynti, social selling, messut, seminaarit).
* Etsit jatkuvasti uusia ja luovia tapoja lisätä tunnettuuttamme.
* Tämä positio on ihanteellinen ponnahduslauta menestyksekkäälle uralle B2B-myynnissä.


 Mitä tuot mukanasi myyntitiimiin?
   

  

* Sinulla on maisterin tutkinto, mieluiten kaupalliselta alalta. Aiempi työkokemus ei ole välttämätöntä.
* Suomen kielen sujuva taito on välttämätöntä alustan monimutkaisuuden vuoksi, ja englannin kielen sujuva taito on ehdoton kansainvälisessä ympäristössämme.
* Saat energiaa kommunikoinnista potentiaalisten asiakkaiden kanssa sekä liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien löytämisestä ja kehittämisestä.
* Sinulla on motivaatiota ja itsenäisyyttä, joita tässä keskeisessä roolissa vaaditaan.
* Uteliaisuutta oppia uusia asioita joka päivä.
* Tiimipelaajana olet valmis tekemään parhaasi yhteisen menestyksen eteen.
* Viihdyt nopeasti kehittyvässä ympäristössä.
* Vahva kiinnostus liiketoimintaa, rahoitusta ja uusia teknologioita kohtaan.


 Mitä etuja tämä fintech-scale-up tarjoaa?
   

  

* Pääset osaksi kunnianhimoista, dynaamista ja innostunutta tiimiä monipuolisessa työssä.
* Viikoittaiset sisäiset koulutukset ja työssäoppiminen (coaching) opettavat sinulle ainutlaatuisia taitoja, jotka palvelevat sinua koko urasi ajan.
* Olemme taloudellisesti vakaa scale-up-yritys, jolla on kansainvälisiä kasvutavoitteita.
* Meillä on avoin yrityskulttuuri, jossa on tilaa omalle aloitteellisuudelle.
* Saat kilpailukykyisen palkan ja motivoivan bonusjärjestelmän.
* Liikunta- ja kulttuurietu (Friskvårdsbidrag).
* Eläkesuunnitelma.
* Vakuutukset (sairaus, eläke, TGL, TFA).
* Perjantain after-workit, legendaariset tiimi-illat ja vuosittainen viikonloppumatka koko BrightAnalyticsin tiimin kanssa.


**Oletko valmis kiihdyttämään uraasi fintech-alalla?** 
**Hae tänään ja kasva BrightAnalyticsin mukana!**

title: Innesäljare
description:
Har du arbetat med försäljning av kyla eller VVS-artiklar tidigare? Trivs du med att skriva offerter och har du erfarenhet av dimensioneringsprogram? Då kan det vara dig vi söker!
 



  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Vi söker just nu efter en ny kollega som kommer att arbeta som Innesäljare. Som innesäljare hos oss kommer du att förstärka vårat professionella och sammansvetsade Offert och Projekteringsteam. Arbetsuppgifterna kommer framförallt innebära:
 



 · Skriva offerter
 



 · Dimensionera värmepumpar och kylsystem
 



 · Svara i telefon och mail
 



 · Snabbt återkoppla priser till kund
 



 · Hjälpa kunden att välja produkter ur katalogen
 



 · Sitta i vårt showroom/ta emot kunder.
 



  





 Du kommer att arbeta på vårat kontor i Stockholm och vara en viktig länk ut till kunder och kollegor.
 



 Dina arbetstider kommer vara mån-tors kl 8-16,30 och fre kl 8-16,00.
 



  





**Detta söker vi:** 




 Vi söker dig som tidigare arbetat med försäljning av kyla eller VVS-artiklar från exempelvis en grossistverksamhet eller kyl/VVS-företag. Du ska ha erfarenhet av offertskrivningar och dimensioneringsprogram. Vidare behöver du ha:
 



 · God kunskap i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift
 



 · Förmåga att vilja lära sig nya system
 



 · Meriterande om du har arbetat med SAP eller andra CRM-system
 



  





 Som person är du stresstålig där du kan klara av att ha många bollar i luften och hitta tillbaka till arbetsuppgifter efter att ha blivit avbruten. Vidare är det viktigt att du är noggrann och servicemainded då arbetet innebär kundkontakt via telefon och mail.
 



 Du som söker ska ha en vilja att ständigt uppdateras om Daikins produkter och vi ser gärna att du ser långsiktigt på tjänsten.
 



  





**Att jobba på Daikin** 




 Vi tillhandahåller regelbundna vidareutbildningar för att du som medarbetare ska få rätt kompetens. Dessa hålls både i Sverige och utomlands och ger dig goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din yrkesroll. Ett av våra värdeord är att ”Ha Kul!”, vilket vi verkligen har! Vi erbjuder dessutom goda förmåner såsom sex veckors semester, friskvårdsbidrag och bra pensionsavtal. Daikin är en trygg arbetsgivare och hos oss får du möjligheten att sälja och representera högkvalitativa produkter.
 



  





**Ansökan** 




 Låter det intressant och stämmer beskrivningen in på dig? Ansök idag!
 



 Osäker? Du är välkommen att kontakta Sewit Mikael på mail: sewit.mikael@daikin.se.
 



 Intervjuer och urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. Skicka därför in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.
 



 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Project Manager
description:
**Own the delivery of EG MainManager, the Nordic region's leading property management solution, as we build our presence in Sweden.**
*Do you want to own projects from first customer conversation through to delivery, and be trusted to shape how we work along the way?*
*Are you energised by complex projects, close customer relationships, and a deep interest in the property industry?*
*Then you might be our new Project Manager for EG MainManager in Sweden.*
**About The Role**
 We're building our presence with EG MainManager, the Nordic region's leading property management solution, in the Swedish market - and we're looking for an experienced, driven Project Manager to play a central role in shaping that success. This isn't a role where you follow a path someone else has laid out. You're involved from sale to delivery and handover, and you own your projects from start to finish.
   

  

 You'll work closely with customers in property management, and beyond the project manager role, you'll often take on the role of functional solution architect and process expert - guiding customers toward better ways of working, challenging and advising them, not just delivering a system. You'll collaborate closely with our solution and technical experts to make sure customers get the best property management solution on the market.
   

  

 As one of the first people on board in this venture, you'll help build the working methods and delivery model that lay the foundation for continued growth in the Swedish market.
   

  

 The role is based in our Stockholm office, in a hybrid setup - though being in the office regularly matters to us, especially while we build this team and this market from the ground up.
   

  

**From Sale to Delivery**
* Project management, start to finish - Take part in the sales process with project insight from an early stage, then lead implementation projects end to end: planning, resourcing, timeline, budget and risk. You're the customer's main point of contact throughout, managing expectations, scope and any deviations. You identify and manage project risks, escalating when needed, and you run status meetings and steering committees, documenting decisions and deliverables.
* Functional solution architecture - Run needs analyses together with customers and translates them into concrete solutions in the system, guiding customers toward better, more efficient property management processes. You work closely with technical experts and development resources to ensure the right delivery, and feed real customer needs back to the product team.
* Building the delivery model - Help establish and improve implementation methodology, templates and best practice for the Swedish market. Document learnings from the first projects to create a repeatable, scalable process for future project managers and consultants to build on.
* Customer relationships - Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers during and after implementation, ensure a smooth handover to ongoing support, and act as an ambassador for the solution - helping build reference customers in Sweden.


**What You Bring**
 We care more about what you can do than what your CV looks like. You have a solid track record as a project manager, ideally from real estate, PropTech, ERP or similar business systems. You're motivated by complex, challenging projects, and you thrive in environments where you get to take ownership of a role that isn't fully defined yet.
   

  

* Proven experience leading complex projects end to end, ideally within real estate, PropTech, ERP or similar business systems
* Motivated, ambitious and self-driven - you take initiative and push projects and processes forward without waiting to be asked
* Natural leadership qualities - you take the lead with customers and internal stakeholders alike, even without formal authority over the people around you
* Structured, with a methodical approach and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in parallel
* A clear, confident communicator - with customers at every level, and internally across the organisation
* Solution-oriented - you combine a helicopter view of project governance with the readiness to dig into detail when it matters
* Curious, with a good understanding of how organisations work, so you can navigate stakeholders and decisions on both the customer's side and EG's
* Hands-on experience using AI as a natural part of how you work and deliver projects
* Fluent in Swedish and English, spoken and written, and confident in customer meetings at every level


**What's in it for you?**
 At EG, you'll join an ambitious environment with a fast pace and real opportunities for professional and personal development, as a key person in a venture that genuinely matters - where your work has a direct impact on our position in the Swedish market.
   

  

**Real ownership -** 
 You own your projects end-to-end, from the sales process through delivery and handover, with genuine autonomy as one of the first people building this market.
   

  

**Meaningful impact -** 
 Your work has a direct, visible effect on EG's position in the Swedish property management market - from day one.
   

  

**Growth mandate -** 
 You help define the working methods, templates and delivery model that future project managers and consultants in Sweden will build on.
   

  

**AI-enabled leadership -** 
 You'll help shape how AI becomes a natural part of how we run projects and support customers - not as an add-on, but as part of how the team works.
   

  

**Collaborative culture -** 
 Close collaboration with our solution and technical experts and the product team, in a Nordic culture built on trust, openness and no politics.
   

  

**Our Values**
* Lead the Industry - We don't just serve our industries - we lead them. We bring deep expertise, set new standards, and help our customers stay ahead.
* Make it Happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver real impact. When we say we'll do something, it gets done - no excuses, no politics.
* Stronger Together - We are a global team shaped by Scandinavian values. The best software - and the best teams - are built on trust, openness, and collaboration across borders.


**We Look Forward to Hearing From You!**
 If you would like more information before you apply, please contact Director, Andreas Sinding-Larsen on +47 917 62 838. We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and recruit when the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially.
   

  

**At EG, we build software that makes a difference.**
 Our industry-specific software help people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.
   

  

 Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security.
   

  

 If you're ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you'll thrive here. You'll be trusted to grow your skills, shape meaningful solutions, and make an impact together with talented colleagues across borders.
   

  

 Join us in creating software that works for people - not software that makes people work.
   

  

 Curious what it's really like to work at EG? Explore life at EG, meet some of your future colleagues, and see our values in action: Working at EG
   

  

 See all our open positions here
   

  

 Learn more about EG here
   

  

 This position will be in legal entity: Mestro AB

title: Account Director, Startups
description:
**About The Team**
 OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.
   

  

 In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.
   

  

**About The Role**
 OpenAI is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Account Director to join our Startups Go To Market team. You will play a critical role in owning relationships with top startup customers and supporting them in building successfully on the OpenAI platform.
   

  

 We believe that many of the most disruptive and category-defining AI applications will be created by startups. The Startup Go To Market team’s mission is to help startups harness the power of AI models to drive these advances. You will support startups building effectively with OpenAI’s APIs, and provide access to OpenAI teams and expertise to support their growth.
   

  

 This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and strategy. You’ll be responsible for serving as the primary relationship owner for a set of strategically important startup customers, as well as working across the OpenAI organization to help these startups accelerate their progress and be successful using our models. You’ll work cross-functionality with product, research, engineering, support, and solutions architecture to help customers get the most out of our models.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Manage a portfolio of startups accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan.
* Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects.
* Own a consumption revenue target.
* Manage consumption revenue forecasts.
* Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders.
* Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies.
* Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering.
* Serve as an advocate for improving the startup experience building with OpenAI, synthesizing product feedback from insights captured from our work with startups.
* Closely monitor the industry landscape and startup landscape to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies.
* Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates.
* Support the development of company culture.


**We're Seeking Someone With Experience In**
* 6+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service.
* Designing and executing complex deal strategies.
* Experience working in or around the startup ecosystem, preferably as either a founder of a startup, an employee of a startup, or someone who worked with startup customers.
* Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies.
* Working directly with C-level executives.
* Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.).
* Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence.


**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**
* Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.
* Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.
* Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision.
* Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions.
* Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.


**About OpenAI**
 OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
   

  

 For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.
   

  

 Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
   

  

 To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.
   

  

 OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy
   

  

 At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

title: Hardware System Engineer
description:
*Är du en ansvarstagande och tekniskt kunnig person som vill vara med i händelserna för liveproduktion? Vill du vara en drivande del av installationer och driftsättning? Då kan rollen som Hardware System Engineer i vårt starka team vara någonting för dig.* 




  





**I rollen får du:** 



* Ansvara för kontribution och distribution av alla Kanal 75:s audiovideosignaler
* Säkerställa driften för dessa signaler och sammanhängande tekniska system
* Vara en del av ett starkt team med god gemenskap.



 Du kommer att arbeta med avancerad felsökning i en modern broadcastmiljö där teknik, drift och problemlösning är en naturlig del av vardagen. Här kommer du ständigt att lära dig olika system och utvecklas kontinuerligt.
 



  





**Är det här du?** 




 För att trivas i rollen är du tekniskt nyfiken, ansvarstagande och du trivs i en miljö där stabil drift och snabba problemlösningar är avgörande. Du arbetar strukturerat och metodiskt även när tempot är högt och förstår hur tekniska system fungerar tillsammans. Du är bekväm med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra och vill även bidra med att utveckla vår teknik för liveproduktion.
 



  





**Vi ser att du har:** 



* Erfarenhet av arbete med tekniska system inom broadcast, AV, IT eller liknande område
* God förståelse för audio- och videosignaler samt signalflöden
* Kunskap om nätverk och IP-baserade tekniska lösningar
* Förmåga att systematiskt felsöka och lösa tekniska problem
* Dokumenterat tekniska system och arbetssätt



  





**Meriterande:** 



* Erfarenhet av liveproduktion eller broadcastmiljö
* Kunskap om tekniker och standarder som SDI, NDI, SMPTE ST 2110, Dante/AES67
* Erfarenhet av system för routing, kontribution och distribution av audio och video
* Erfarenhet av övervakning och felsökning i verksamhetskritiska system
* Kunskap inom scripting, automation eller API-integrationer



  





**" Som chef ger jag ett stort eget ansvar och utrymme"** 




 Det bästa med att arbeta på Kanal 75 är kombinationen av teknik och liveproduktioner. Här får du arbeta med skräddarsydda system som verkligen används varje dag, där det du gör är avgörande för att de dagliga produktionerna går att genomföra. Som chef ger jag ett stort eget ansvar och utrymme att hitta egna bra lösningar, samtidigt som vi alltid hjälps åt som team.
 



**Rekryterande chef- Samuel Norrgård- Palo, Manager Hardware System** 




  





**We are the game** 




 Kanal 75 är ett dotterbolag till spelbolaget ATG och har i mer än 25 år sett till att välkomna publiken, bjuda in till en rolig värld och göra den tillgänglig. Vi ska kunna ge kunnig och insatt service för givande underhållning och sunt spel. Vi sänder flest livetimmar av alla nordiska produktionsbolag och är ett av Sveriges mest mångsidiga produktionsbolag som kombinerar innehåll och teknik. Vi uppmuntrar multikompetens och satsar gärna på duktiga utvecklingsbara personer som har bred erfarenhet eller som vill lära sig mer.
 



 Läs gärna mer på vår hemsidan; kanal75.se
 



  





**Join the game!** 




 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vår rekryteringsportal antingen med ditt cv eller din LinkedIn-profil – det som är enklast och smidigast för dig. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår karriärsida och tveka inte att höra av dig om du har frågor om tjänsten.
 



  





 Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning och kommer att göra en bakgrundskontroll för denna roll. Tjänsten är på heltid och vi arbetar på plats på vårt kontor i Värtahamnen. Var med och bygg världens bästa spelupplevelse tillsammans med oss!

title: Administratör - Långt uppdrag
description:
Administration & Ekonomi
   

  

* Stockholm
* Hybridarbete


 Administratör - Långt uppdrag
   

  

 Vi söker en ny kollega som vill vara del av vårt dynamiska team och bidra till vår framgångsrika verksamhet. Vi värdesätter egenskaper som Ansvarsfull, Självständig och Driven, och vi tror att du är en person som passar in i denna profil.
   

  

 Om Techfactory
   

  

 Vi är ett konsultbolag som sätter stort värde på våra medarbetare och vår kultur. Vi strävar efter att vara en arbetsplats där varje individ känner sig stöttad och har möjlighet att utvecklas.
   

  

 Gruppadministratör till vår kund
   

  

 Är du en strukturerad och serviceinriktad administratör som trivs i en central roll med många kontaktytor? Har du förmågan att hålla ihop flera parallella arbetsuppgifter, skapa struktur och ligga steget före? Då kan det här vara uppdraget för dig.
   

  

 OBS! Detta konsultuppdrag sträcker sig från 2026-09-16 tom 2029-12-14. Viktigt att man kan och har möjlighet att stanna hela uppdragstiden. Du kommer vara anställd hos Techfactory.
   

  

 Om uppdraget
   

  

 Vår kund har behov av en
 **Gruppadministratör** 
 som ska avlasta befintliga administratörer och projektingenjörer med projektövergripande administrativa arbetsuppgifter.
   

  

 I rollen blir du en viktig spindel i nätet med många kontaktytor, både internt och externt. Du stöttar gruppen i det dagliga arbetet och bidrar till en effektiv och välfungerande verksamhet genom att skapa struktur, samordna administrativa aktiviteter och underlätta för dina kollegor.
   

  

 Arbetet innebär att hantera flera uppgifter parallellt och vissa arbetsuppgifter är händelsestyrda. Det är därför viktigt att du är flexibel, kan anpassa dig efter förändrade behov och har en god förmåga att självständigt prioritera ditt arbete.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Som Gruppadministratör Ansvarar Du Främst För Att Stötta Gruppen Med Övergripande Administrativa Arbetsuppgifter. I Uppdraget Ingår Bland Annat Att:
   

  

* Vara gruppens huvudadministratör i passersystemet, exempelvis genom att registrera uppdrag och beställa behörigheter.
* Avlasta projekten med löpande diarieföring.
* Hantera övergripande administration i dokumenthanteringssystemet Atlas, bland annat tilldelning av behörigheter samt upplägg och justering av mappstrukturer.
* Vid behov stötta med administrativa delar av mer omfattande projektmoment, exempelvis överlämning vid projektslut.
* Administrera SOW/åtaganden i kundens system, inklusive att ta emot och fördela fakturor, bevaka beviljad budget och hantera utökningar vid behov.
* Hantera resursanskaffning i systemen genom bland annat konsultavrop, förlängningar och utökningar av befintliga resursers uppdrag.
* Stötta vid onboarding av nya medarbetare och konsulter, exempelvis genom beställning av behörigheter, passerkort och hårdvara.


 Du kommer att samverka brett med kollegor och projektmedlemmar och behöver därför vara bekväm med en roll där service, koordinering och kommunikation är centrala delar av vardagen.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som
   

  

 För att vara aktuell för uppdraget behöver du uppfylla följande krav:
   

  

* Har som lägst gymnasieexamen.
* Har minst 3 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av administrativt arbete, exempelvis inom kontor, reception, ekonomi, HR, kundservice eller offentlig verksamhet. Erfarenheten behöver inte vara sammanhängande.
* Har minst 3 års erfarenhet av att självständigt planera, prioritera och följa upp flera parallella arbetsuppgifter med varierande deadlines och prioritet.
* Har minst 1 års erfarenhet av fakturahantering eller annan ekonomiadministration.
* Har minst 2 års erfarenhet av att koordinera administrativa aktiviteter mellan flera intressenter, exempelvis möten, beställningar, informationsflöden, uppföljning eller dokumentation.
* Har erfarenhet från minst en anställning eller ett uppdrag där du har identifierat, föreslagit och genomfört förbättringar av administrativa arbetssätt, rutiner eller processer som bidragit till ökad effektivitet, kvalitet eller service.
* Har minst 3 års erfarenhet av Microsoft 365/Office 365 och har lätt för att sätta dig in i nya administrativa system och digitala verktyg.


 Meriterande
   

  

 Det är meriterande om du har minst
 **1 års erfarenhet av onboarding av nya medarbetare** 
 , exempelvis beställning av passerkort, behörigheter samt uppstart eller beställning av dator, telefon eller motsvarande utrustning.
   

  

 Vem är du?
   

  

 Vi söker dig som är
 **noggrann, ansvarsfull, initiativtagande och lösningsorienterad** 
 . Du trivs med varierade administrativa och serviceinriktade arbetsuppgifter och har lätt för att identifiera vad som behöver göras och strukturera ditt arbete utifrån rådande prioriteringar.
   

  

 Du har förmågan att ligga steget före och tycker om att underlätta för dina kollegor och skapa goda arbetsflöden. title: Junior HR-konsult med intresse för AI
description:
Vill du arbeta verksamhetsnära med HR och samtidigt vara med och utveckla framtidens smartare HR-leveranser? Hos Sweden HR Group får du varierande konsultuppdrag, stort ansvar och möjlighet att kombinera operativ HR med utveckling inom AI och HR-tech.
 




  





 Sweden HR Group söker en strukturerad, nyfiken och prestigelös junior HR-konsult som vill utvecklas inom konsultbranschen och vara med och forma framtidens HR.
 



  





 Hos oss får du arbeta i varierande uppdrag inom olika branscher, tillsammans med kompetenta och engagerade HR-kollegor. Du blir en del av ett team där vi kombinerar affärsfokus, kvalitet och nytänkande för att skapa verklig förflyttning hos våra kunder.
 



  




**Om Sweden HR Group** 

 Sweden HR Group är en konsultbyrå specialiserad på HR och organisationsutveckling. Genom projekt och löpande leveranser stärker och utvecklar vi ledare, medarbetare, processer, strukturer och kompetenser. Gemensamt för allt vi gör är att kundens affär alltid står i fokus.
 



  





 Våra ledord är
 
 Affärsdrivna, Modiga och framåtlutade samt Starka tillsammans
 
 . De präglar vår vardag, både internt och i samarbetet med våra kunder. Tillsammans gör vi organisationer starkare.
 



  




**Om rollen** 

 Som junior HR-konsult hos oss får du en varierad vardag med uppdrag hos kunder i olika branscher. Vi arbetar oftast nära ledningsgrupper och chefer, och i varje uppdrag har vi kundens verksamhet och affär som utgångspunkt.
 



  





 Du arbetar alltid tillsammans med andra. Varje kunduppdrag har en intern HR-projektledare med ansvar för leveransen, och du blir en del av ett konsultteam som ofta arbetar med flera parallella kunder och uppdrag. Rollen ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas snabbt, få inblick i olika verksamheter och vara med och forma framtidens HR tillsammans med kollegor och kunder.
 



  





 En viktig del av rollen är att medverka i våra operativa HR-uppdrag inom HR Outsourcing. Du kommer också att vara delaktig i utvecklingen av våra erbjudanden för att möta nya möjligheter och utmaningar kopplade till AI.
 



  






 I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
 



* Delta i operativa HR-uppdrag och löpande HR-leveranser hos våra kunder.
* Skapa struktur, ordning och kvalitet i kundernas HR-arbete.
* Arbeta i team med en intern HR-projektledare och andra HR-konsulter.
* Bidra i flera parallella kunduppdrag och projekt.
* Vara med och utveckla våra erbjudanden inom AI, HR-tech och HR Outsourcing.
* Föreslå och genomföra förbättringar som ökar effektiviteten samtidigt som kvaliteten i våra leveranser bibehålls.
* Bidra med idéer kring hur vi kan förbättra och effektivisera vår verksamhet och vårt erbjudande.


**Vi söker dig som har** 
* En akademisk examen inom HR, ekonomi eller ett motsvarande område.
* Förmåga och ett stort intresse för att organisera, strukturera och skapa ordning i en HR-funktion.
* Ett stort intresse för IT, teknik, AI och HR-stödsystem.
* Erfarenhet av att använda olika AI-tekniker och verktyg i din vardag, både professionellt och privat.
* En vilja att utvecklas inom konsultbranschen och arbeta i varierande kundmiljöer.


**Vem är du?** 

 Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. För att trivas hos oss tror vi att du är en prestigelös lagspelare som möter nya människor, organisationer och situationer med nyfikenhet och ett öppet förhållningssätt.
 



  





 Du har lätt för att skapa struktur i olika typer av projekt och kan anpassa dig efter olika kunder, verksamheter och uppdrag. Du tycker om att samarbeta, men är också bekväm med att ta eget ansvar och driva ditt arbete framåt.
 



  





 Du är intresserad av hur teknik och AI kan användas för att förbättra HR-arbetet. Samtidigt förstår du att smartare arbetssätt behöver kombineras med hög kvalitet och ett tydligt verksamhetsfokus. Hos oss får du möjlighet att omsätta ditt intresse i praktiken och bidra till utvecklingen av både våra kunduppdrag och våra egna erbjudanden.
 



  




**Hos oss får du:** 
* Stor variation genom uppdrag i olika verksamheter och branscher.
* Arbeta tillsammans med kompetenta och engagerade HR-kollegor.
* Erfarenhet av både operativt och utvecklingsinriktat HR-arbete.
* Möjlighet att arbeta nära kundernas chefer och ledningar.
* Vara med och utveckla framtidens HR med hjälp av AI och ny teknik.



  





 Ett team där vi är starka tillsammans och där idéer om förbättring och effektivisering uppmuntras. Sweden HR Group är en konsultbyrå specialiserad på HR och organisationsutveckling. Genom projekt och löpande leveranser stärker och utvecklar vi ledare, medarbetare, processer, strukturer och kompetenser. Gemensamt för allt vi gör är att kundens affär alltid står i fokus.
   




**Praktisk information** 


 Placeringsort:
 
 Stockholm
 




 Anställningsform:
 
 Tillsvidareanställning
 




 Omfattning:
 
 Heltid
 




 Startdatum:
 
 Hösten 2026
   




**Ansökan** 

 Låter det här som rätt nästa steg för dig? Skicka in din ansökan och berätta varför du vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss på Sweden HR Group.
 



  






 Sista ansökningsdag:
 
 11 september 2026
 



  





 Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Senior Software Engineer - Activation
description:
**Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking, from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We're an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. Creating and collaborating to transform the sound of streaming, content, and culture. Come join us, and let the world** 
***feel***
**your work.**
 As a
 **Senior Software Engineer,** 
 you will play a crucial role in the
 **Activation** 
 team, which owns the first minutes a new user spends inside Epidemic Sound. Your role will be to improve new user onboarding through customised, data-driven journeys — building both the user-facing flows and the signal-based systems behind them
   

  

 You will join a friendly and highly collaborative team that works in fast feedback loops, with AI-assisted workflows such as Claude Code as part of everyday engineering, and you will work alongside product, design, marketing, data and analytics colleagues across the Growth domain, taking ambiguous problems from an idea to a shipped experiment.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities Include**
* Build user-facing onboarding flows, contextual nudges and interactive elements across logged-in and logged-out experiences.
* Develop systems that read early-funnel signals to understand user intent and route new users to relevant product paths.
* Deliver end to end across the stack, in React and TypeScript on the frontend and Python, Go or Kotlin on the backend.
* Run A/B tests and fast feedback loops so improvements to activation are measured rather than assumed.
* Own the observability, reliability and developer experience of the systems the Activation team runs.


**Requirements**
* 4+ years of experience in React, TypeScript and modern CSS and HTML.
* Experience in backend development (Python, Go or Kotlin).
* A proven track record in full-stack product development, including backend-for-frontend patterns and event-driven systems.
* Experience in analytics instrumentation and experimentation, covering event tracking, A/B testing, feature flags and using data to judge product impact.
* Comfortable in working AI-first, with agentic tools as part of everyday craft.
* Strong collaborative skills and being able to comfortably drive ambiguous problems towards clarity and implementation.


**It would also be music to our ears if you have** 
 deep experience architecting scalable web applications in React and TypeScript, including server-side rendering, frontend architecture and performance work, along with familiarity with observability tooling and experimentation and product analytics platforms.
   

  

**Equal opportunity employer**
 We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.
   

  

**Application**
 Ready to make the world
 *feel* 
 your work? Please apply, in English.

 As a

 , you will play a crucial role in our
 **Content Protection** 
 team
 **.** 
 Your role will be to design and implement systems that protect our enterprise customers from copyright litigation and licensing risks
 **.** 




  





 Our mission is simple: paying customers never lose sleep over music licensing. You will help our customers identify and mitigate licensing liabilities, proactively identifying and mitigating licensing risks, ensuring our licensing promise remains bulletproof. By identifying and resolving licensing risks across every social channel, you will give top global brands absolute confidence and control over their music usage. You will be joining a highly collaborative, cross-functional engineering team, working closely with Data and Machine Learning functions, as well as our legal and business operations teams, to ensure we have the precise data needed to enforce rights.
 



  





**Your Key Responsibilities Include** 



* End-to-End Ownership: Architect, build, and maintain the critical infrastructure and monitoring alerts for our content protection and rights enforcement services.
* User Generated Content Monitoring & Optimization: Build high-throughput services that continuously fetch, parse, and analyze massive volumes of usage data from platforms like YouTube to monitor compliance.
* Data Analysis & Autonomous Improvement: The pipeline we’re building is complex and still evolving, and we expect you in the data itself — querying it, spotting where signals are weak or cases are being missed, and deciding what to do about it. You’ll pick up problems no one has scoped yet, make the case for the fix, and ship it.
* Cross-Functional Defense: Collaborate with ML engineers to develop advanced detection models and arm business operations with actionable data.



  





**Requirements** 



* 6+ years of experience in backend software engineering with a focus on designing and scaling distributed systems.
* Proven experience building high-throughput services and data pipelines capable of handling massive volumes of data.
* Proficiency in modern backend languages (e.g., Python, Go, Java) and cloud infrastructure (GCP/AWS).
* Strong architectural mindset with the ability to take full ownership of a system from design to deployment.
