title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
We're a small, hybrid team with a big mission. We move fast, care deeply about educators and students, and love working together. We just raised $4.5M to bring safe AI to every classroom, and we're looking for a Product Designer to build it with us.
   

  

**About Imagi**
 School districts across the US know they need to bring AI into classrooms. Board members are asking, state grants are available, and students who do not learn AI today will be behind the ones who do. But the AI tools that actually work were not built for schools. They do not meet COPPA or FERPA requirements, and every district leader knows they are one news story away from a problem they cannot explain to their school board.
   

  

 imagi is the only K-12 platform that puts all three things districts need in one place: a student-safe, compliant AI environment; a structured curriculum that has students actually learning and building real applications with AI; and professional development so teachers do not have to be AI experts to teach it.
   

  

**The role**
 You will own product design at imagi end to end: research, flows, interface, and copy. This is a lead-and-do role on a lean team. You decide what to design, you design it, and you test it with real teachers and students.
   

  

 You will work directly with our co-founders and with our engineering and commercial team. We use AI tools daily to move faster than a traditional team could, and we expect the same from you. As imagi grows, this role grows into leading the design function.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Own product design end to end, from a problem or research insight to dev-ready design, for both teachers and students.
* Build clickable prototypes (Figma or code) and put them in front of real users.
* Run our user research: plan it, moderate it, synthesize it, and turn findings into shipped design within days.
* Write the interface copy as part of the design, in clear, precise English.
* Build and maintain our design system as the product grows.
* Use AI tools daily to multiply your output, and help define how an AI-first design practice at imagi should work.


**What You Bring**
* 4+ years of product design experience with real ownership at a startup or fast-moving product team.
* Maximum energy and ownership; you do not wait to be told what to design next.
* Strong prototyping skills: you get ideas into a testable, clickable state fast and reliably.
* Solid user research fundamentals: you have planned and moderated sessions, and you can show how research changed what you shipped.
* You are AI-native. AI tools are part of how you design every day, and you use them to raise both speed and quality, not to produce slop.
* Product judgment: you care who the feature is for, push back when something does not make sense, and sweat the details that reach students and teachers.
* Excellent written English, communication, persuasion, and a sharp eye for detail.


**Nice to have**
* Experience in edtech, K-12, or other products with a buyer and an end user who are different people.
* Familiarity with tools like Lovable, Claude, ElevenLabs, or Synthesia.
* Enough front-end fluency (HTML/CSS, or vibe coding) to prototype in code when it beats Figma.
* Experience as the first or only designer at a company.


****Where you're based****
 Stockholm. Our wider team is remote-friendly and meets as a full team once a quarter, but this role is different: as our Product Designer, you will work in person with our product team in Stockholm.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation and meaningful equity/stock options, so you own a real piece of what you build.
* An AI-first way of working, with the tools and freedom to move as fast as you can.
* Flexible working plus 30 days vacation.
* Tjänstepension (occupational pension) and friskvårdsbidrag (wellness allowance).
* A close-knit, international team that takes its mission seriously and has fun doing it.
* Real ownership and visible impact: on a team this small, your work ships and reaches classrooms fast.


**Apply**
 This is a rare chance to define how a generation learns about AI. If that excites you, apply below, we read every application.

title: Tjänstedesigner – från användarinsikt till verklig nytta
description:
**Digitaliseringsavdelningen, Sektionen för produkt- och tjänstedesign**
 Regeringskansliet är mitt i en omfattande digital utveckling. Vi bygger moderna digitala tjänster, stärker informationshanteringen och utvecklar en säker och hållbar digital miljö för hela organisationen. För att lyckas behöver vi bli fler.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en eller flera tjänstedesigners som vill vara med och utveckla vår förmåga att sätta användaren i centrum och säkerställa att våra digitala satsningar skapar verklig nytta.
   

  

 Din arbetsdag. Sveriges morgondag.
   

  

 Digitaliseringsavdelningen leder stora delar av Regeringskansliets digitala förflyttning. Vårt uppdrag är unikt – våra lösningar används i hela Regeringskansliet och på över 100 utlandsmyndigheter världen över. Det du är med och utvecklar får direkt betydelse för hur Sveriges regering bedriver sitt arbete, både nationellt och globalt.
   

  

 Nu stärker vi vår förmåga inom produkt- och tjänsteutveckling för att skapa hållbara, användarcentrerade och framtidssäkra digitala lösningar. Som en del av denna satsning utvecklar vi vår kompetens inom tjänstedesign för att säkerställa att verksamhetsbehov omsätts till robusta, sammanhållna och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Digitaliseringsavdelningen driver Regeringskansliets digitala utveckling. Som tjänstedesigner identifierar du användarnas behov, analyserar insikter och omsätter dem till förbättringar som skapar värde för både användare och verksamhet. Du använder intervjuer, workshops och dataanalys för att säkerställa att vi utvecklar rätt lösningar.
   

  

 Du visualiserar användarresor och processer, följer upp effekter och bidrar med underlag för beslut. Tillsammans med produktledare, utvecklare, arkitekter och andra designers utvecklar du även våra användarcentrerade arbetssätt och metoder för digital tjänsteutveckling.
   

  

 Hos oss får du
   

  

* Göra verklig skillnad genom att utveckla digitala tjänster för hela Regeringskansliet och våra utlandsmyndigheter.
* Arbeta med komplexa och samhällsviktiga frågor där användarbehov, verksamhet, teknik och säkerhet möts.
* Driva användarperspektivet och bidra till välgrundade beslut baserade på insikter, fakta och nytta.
* Utveckla tjänstedesignförmåga, metoder och arbetssätt tillsammans med verksamhet, produktledning, utveckling, arkitektur och andra specialister.
* Följa tjänster genom hela livscykeln och utvecklas i en tvärfunktionell miljö.


 Din bakgrund
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
**Formella krav**
* Relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom exempelvis tjänstedesign, interaktionsdesign, design, beteendevetenskap, informatik eller annat närliggande område.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av tjänstedesign eller användarcentrerad utveckling.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta tvärfunktionellt i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, teknik och användare.
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av att formulera mål, följa upp resultat och bidra till att skapa verksamhetseffekter.
* Erfarenhet av datadrivna arbetssätt och analysverktyg för tjänsteutveckling.
* Kunskap om tjänsteförvaltning genom hela tjänstens livscykel.
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift.


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av förändringsledning eller implementering av nya arbetssätt.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i komplexa organisationer, gärna inom offentlig sektor.
* Kunskap om hur designinsatser kan kopplas till verksamhetsmål och samhällsnytta.
* Förståelse för offentlig förvaltning, styrning och regelverk.
* Förståelse för informationssäkerhet och dataskydd.


 Dina egenskaper
   

  

 Du har stark användarförståelse och analytisk förmåga och kan omsätta insikter till konkreta förbättringar. Du är kommunikativ, nyfiken och van att skapa samsyn mellan olika perspektiv. Med ett strukturerat och drivande arbetssätt tar du utveckling från idé till resultat och identifierar proaktivt nya möjligheter där tjänstedesign kan skapa värde.
   

  

 Regeringskansliets medarbetarkriterier är helhet, utveckling och resultat. Alla som arbetar i Regeringskansliet behöver ha helhetssyn och samarbeta för verksamhetens bästa. Du förväntas bidra med ditt perspektiv och din kompetens samt vara öppen för andras. Du kommer med idéer och nya angreppssätt för att förbättra och utveckla verksamheten och din egen kompetens. Du är inriktad på resultat i ditt agerande och anpassar dig när behov och inriktning ändras.
   

  

 Övrigt
   

  

 Rollen är en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Befattningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass och en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas. Du måste vara svensk medborgare, men får gärna ha utländsk bakgrund.
   

  

 Är du intresserad?
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om jobbet och vad vi erbjuder, vänligen kontakta sektionschef Sofia Pörner. Du är även välkommen att kontakta rekryteringsspecialist Filip Ristov. Fackliga kontakter är Johan Strokirk för Saco och Jan Wahlström för ST. Du når dem via Regeringskansliets växel, 08-405 10 00.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan senast 28 september 2026.**
 Vi tar gärna emot samtal från dig som är intresserad av jobbet men vi tackar nej till dig som säljer annonser och rekryteringstjänster.

title: Framer Website Designer
description:
****Framer Website Designer (Onsite – Presidio, San Francisco)****
**About Air Apps**
 At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018 and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco, we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
   

  

 Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
   

  

 Join us on this journey to redefine resource management and change lives along the way.
   

  

* This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts.


**The Role**
 As a
 **Framer Website Designer** 
 , you’ll take ownership of designing and building high-performing, visually compelling websites using
 **Framer** 
 . You’ll collaborate closely with our marketing, product, and engineering teams to create seamless web experiences that reflect our brand vision while meeting business and performance goals.
   

  

 You’ll also work directly with
 **SEO professionals** 
 , your closest collaborators, to ensure all pages are optimized for discoverability, loading speed, and accessibility. From landing pages to product microsites, your designs will directly influence how millions of users engage with Air Apps online.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and build responsive, accessible, and engaging websites and landing pages using Framer.
* Partner with SEO experts to ensure designs meet performance, accessibility, and search engine optimization standards.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders from brand, marketing, and product to align on business goals and messaging.
* Develop modular components and templates for scalable site structures.
* Maintain and evolve the visual identity of our web presence in line with Air Apps’ brand guidelines.
* Monitor site analytics and user behavior to inform iterative improvements and A/B testing.
* Stay up to date with web design trends, Framer updates, and best practices in site performance.


**Requirements**
* Around 3–5+ years of experience designing and building websites with a strong emphasis on visual storytelling and UX.
* Deep proficiency in Framer, with a strong portfolio of responsive web experiences or live projects.
* Solid understanding of web design principles including layout, hierarchy, typography, and mobile-first design.
* Familiarity with web performance best practices, SEO fundamentals, and accessibility standards (WCAG).
* Ability to work collaboratively with SEO and marketing teams to align design with search and content strategies.
* Experience maintaining or contributing to a design system.
* Strong visual communication and prototyping skills.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving.


*Bonus points for:*
* Experience working on marketing sites for SaaS, tech, or AI-driven products.
* Familiarity with HTML/CSS or understanding of how websites are developed under the hood.


**What benefits do we offer?**
* Apple hardware ecosystem for work.
* Annual Bonus
* Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind.
* Transportation Budget to support your commute needs.
* Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more.
* Childcare support.
* Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
* Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning.
* Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active.
* Meals 100% free at the hub.


****Diversity & Inclusion****
 At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.
   

  

****Application Disclaimer****
 At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.
   

  

 Compensation Range: $100K - $125K

title: Data Scientist, Product
description:
**TL;DR** 
 - You own the metrics for a product area, find where users get stuck or drop off, and turn that into product bets that ship. You build the measurement and experimentation the teams rely on, and the systems that surface opportunities without waiting on you.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* A product-minded data scientist who owns a product area's outcomes: you find the opportunity, form the bet, and see it shipped, rather than handing insights to a PM.
* You build systems, not one-offs: the instrumentation, metrics, and agents that produce insight and flag opportunities proactively.
* Strong SQL, Python, applied statistics, and experimentation (A/B and growth tests).
* Deep instinct for user behavior: activation, engagement, retention, and what moves them.
* Comfortable shipping directional answers fast, and knowing when a decision needs rigor.
* Entrepreneurial. Thrives with autonomy and ambiguity, and works shoulder to shoulder with product and engineering.


**What You'll Do**
* Own the metrics and funnels for a product area, and drive measurable improvement in activation, engagement, and retention.
* Find opportunities in user behavior and turn them into product bets, working directly with PMs and engineers to ship them.
* Design and run experiments, and act on the results.
* Build the instrumentation, semantic models, and agents the product team runs on.
* Keep the data the team trusts trustworthy: quality, definitions, and lineage.


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:
   

  

* Languages: SQL and Python
* Warehouse & events: BigQuery, PubSub
* Analytics & product: Hex, Lovable Apps
* Experimentation: A/B and growth testing
* Cloud: GCP


 And always on the lookout for what's next.
   

  

**How We Hire**
* Fill in a short form and jump on an intro call with our recruiting team
* A call with the hiring team member
* A take-home case study
* A Most Impressive Project session
* Cross-functional interviews with the people you'd work with
* A final conversation with leadership


**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally. If you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Global Web Manager
description:
Vill du skapa en digital upplevelse som inspirerar, konverterar och driver tillväxt över flera marknader? JumpYard söker nu en erfaren
 **Global** 
**Web Manager** 
 med globalt ansvar för våra webbplatser – från strategi till daglig optimering.
   

  

**Om JumpYard:**
 Vår första park i Sverige, JumpYard Barkarby, invigdes 2017 och redan från start kunde vi erbjuda fler aktiviteter än bara trampoliner.
   

  

 Efter JumpYard Barkarby har vi öppnat fler parker i Sverige, Danmark, Norge, Spanien, Portugal och snart Tyskland! Utvecklingen av våra parker går fort framåt och idag kan våra gäster uppleva aktiviteter som Clip ‘N Climb, Sky Rider, Valo Jump, olika ninjabanor och mycket mer.
   

  

 Framgången består förstås i människors förtjusta inställning till rörelseglädje! En annan viktig framgångsfaktor är vår personal – med fokus på gästupplevelse, flexibilitet och inspiration ger de gästerna valuta för inträdet sju dagar i veckan året runt. Nu söker vi en Global Web Manager till vårt globala marknadsteam. Vill du bli en del av JumpYard och ha #seriouslyfun tillsammans med oss?
   

  

**Om rollen:**
 Som Global Web Manager ansvarar du för hela vår webbplats och är både strateg och doer. Du leder utvecklingen av våra webbplatser – med fokus på strategi, struktur, innehåll, bokningsflöden och konvertering.
   

  

 Du optimerar hela kundresan – från startsida till tack-sida – och säkerställer att webbplatserna följer företagets varumärkesstrategi, visuella identitet och kommunikationsriktlinjer. Rollen är global, men det operativa arbetet sker främst för Norden. För Spanien och Portugal har du stöd av en kollega, men du sätter ramar och kvalitet även där.
   

  

 Även om JumpYard inte är en klassisk e-handlare är vår affär bokningsdriven. Du har erfarenhet av att optimera konverteringsflöden – från startsida till checkout – och vet hur man skapar sömlösa digitala kundresor inspirerade av e-commerce och CRO-metodik.
   

  

**Dina ansvarsområden**
* Utveckla och driva vår globala webbstrategi med affärsmål och kundbehov i fokus
* Arbeta i WordPress med innehåll, struktur och visuell uppdatering
* Du driver ett datadrivet arbetssätt för att ständigt förbättra konvertering och lönsamhet.
* Säkerställa en inspirerande, intuitiv och konverterande bokningsupplevelse
* Säkerställa att webbplatserna följer varumärkesstrategi, visuell identitet och kommunikationsriktlinjer
* Optimera UX/UI, laddningstider, navigation och mobilanpassning
* Identifiera och åtgärda friktion i användarflöden och mikrointeraktioner
* Genomföra A/B-tester och heatmap-analyser, driva hypotesdriven optimering
* Analysera försäljning och besöksdata (GA4, Hotjar eller liknande) och agera på insikter
* Koordinera globala webkampanjer och lokal anpassning av innehåll
* Samarbeta nära extern webbyrå


**Vi söker dig som har:**
* Relevant utbildning inom digital marknadsföring, UX, e-handel eller webbteknik.
* Minst 4 års erfarenhet i en roll med ansvar för webbstrategi, konverteringsoptimering och digital affärsutveckling.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att driva större webbprojekt från strategi till implementation – gärna i en internationell kontext.
* Stark e-commerce mindset och vana att optimera bokningsflöden, checkout och kundresor för maximal konvertering.
* Mycket god kompetens inom CRO, A/B-tester, heatmaps och hypotesdriven optimering.
* Djup förståelse för UX/UI, användarcentrerad design och digitala beteenden.
* God teknisk förståelse för CMS (gärna WordPress), webbutveckling och digital infrastruktur.
* Avancerade kunskaper i SEO och webbanalys (GA4, Hotjar eller liknande).
* Självgående, initiativtagande och lösningsorienterad – trygg i att prioritera och ta beslut med affärsnytta i fokus.


*Detta är en 100 % tjänst. Du kommer att vara placerad i Stockholm och rapportera till Chief Marketing Officer.*
 Välkommen med din ansökan – rekrytering sker löpande och tjänsten önskar vi tillsätta omgående.

title: Solution owner
description:
What happens when 30 retailers have different technical setups, but you want to give them one scalable integration?
   

  

 That’s one of the challenges you’ll take on as our Solution Owner for Accelerators.
   

  

 Voyado Elevate helps retailers create more relevant and personalized shopping experiences. Getting the full value from Elevate also means connecting it seamlessly with the platforms our customers already use. As Shopify continues to grow within our customer base, making those integrations easier, faster, and more reusable becomes increasingly important.
   

  

 That’s where our accelerators come in.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Solution Owner, you'll take ownership of our accelerator track for Elevate, initially with a strong focus on Shopify. You'll work at the intersection of customer needs, implementation expertise, and Engineering, helping us evolve how we build and maintain integrations that can serve many customers with different technical setups.
   

  

 This isn't quite a Product Manager role, and it isn't quite a Solution Architect role either. You'll combine technical solution ownership with elements of product and project management, customer dialogue, and implementation. You won't own the direction of the Elevate product itself. Instead, you'll own an important part of how we make that product easier and more scalable to integrate into our customers' ecosystems.
   

  

 Some of the things you'll be up to:
   

  

* Own and continuously evolve our accelerator solutions, ensuring they meet both current customer needs and the longer-term needs of our growing customer base
* Shape the requirements, priorities, and development plan for our accelerator capabilities together with Engineering and other stakeholders
* Work directly with customers to understand both the business and technical sides of their e-commerce setup and determine how Elevate can best integrate with it
* Collaborate closely with your Expert Services team, exchanging knowledge and solving complex implementation and integration challenges together
* Coordinate with relevant partners and stakeholders involved in our accelerator ecosystem
* Over time, independently take responsibility for customer onboarding alongside your accelerator ownership


 So, who are you?
   

  

 We think you're someone who enjoys operating where technology, customers, and development meet.
   

  

 You might currently be working as a Technical Project Manager, Solution Architect, Technical Product Owner, Application Specialist, Implementation Consultant, or in another role where you've had to understand complex technical requirements and turn them into solutions.
   

  

 You're technical enough to understand integrations, APIs, and how systems fit together, but you also enjoy the coordination and ownership required to get something built. You can sit with a customer to understand why their setup works the way it does, then take that context into a conversation with Engineering and turn it into something concrete and actionable.
   

  

 The environment will keep changing. Shopify will evolve, Elevate will evolve, and our customers will bring new use cases. You enjoy that kind of movement and are comfortable taking ownership even when every answer isn't available from the start.
   

  

**We believe you have:**
* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or another relevant technical field
* Hands-on experience designing and developing integrations using REST APIs.
* Experience working closely with developers and participating in the planning and prioritization of development work
* Experience working directly with customers in an advisory or technical capacity, such as implementation, onboarding, consulting, or solution architecture
* Fluency in English, written and spoken


 Experience working with Shopify is highly valued, particularly if you've worked with its technical ecosystem, integrations, or implementations in an e-commerce environment.
   

  

 What's in it for you?
   

  

 You'll be joining at a particularly interesting point in the accelerator journey.
   

  

 E-commerce never stands still; neither will the integrations. New customer needs, changes to Shopify, developments within Elevate, and potentially entirely new platforms mean there will always be another technical problem to understand and solve.
   

  

 Voyado wouldn’t be the powerful platform it is without the people behind it. We really care for our Voyadoers, and some examples of what we can offer you are:
   

  

* You’ll operate in a culture that values curiosity, open discussion, and constructive challenge, where good ideas triumph over hierarchy
* Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
* Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment
* Work-life balance. We don't have a long work-hours culture; we value engagement over hours worked


 Some of our benefits:
   

  

* 30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
* Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
* Breakfast buffet on Fridays
* In-house gym only for Voyadoers
* A generous gadget-and-phone package, your choice!
* 5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
* Parental leave top-up with additional support for new parents
* A wellness hour you can use every week


**About Voyado**
 Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite for retail.
   

  

 More than 500 retail brands across 100 markets use Voyado to unite CRM, loyalty, product discovery, e-commerce personalization, and retail media with retail-trained AI that acts on real-time shopper intent.
   

  

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel - online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.
   

  

 We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.
   

  

 Be yourself 🏳️‍🌈
   

  

 At Voyado, we believe in gender equality. We are proud sponsors of Womengineer as well as Tjejer Kodar!
   

  

 Equality is not only about gender but also about making everyone feel welcome and heard in a multicultural and diverse environment. We at Voyado strive to make everyone feel like they can bring their true self to work every day. Gender-equal and diverse teams have more perspectives on life and bring different ideas to the table, which in the end leads not only to a better working environment but also a better product.
   

  

 Making it personal with AI
   

  

 We truly believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you will even be expected to use AI. But at the end of the day, what matters is meeting you, the person behind the application.
   

  

 There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self! Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about the most.
   

  

 Note: As of right now, we are unable to proceed with applicants outside of the EU, and a requirement of eligibility to work at Voyado is the right to work in the EU without limitations. Needless to say, this is something we are actively working on to be able to onboard colleagues from all over the world.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact?
   

  

 Fantastic! 🎉
   

  

 Applying is easy - upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.
   

  

 Additional information
   

  

 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.
   

  

 In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.
   

  

 With AI-driven CRM, loyalty, e-commerce personalization, and retail media, Voyado turns every interaction - online or in-store - into lasting growth.
   

  

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.

title: Data Annotator
description:
**Mission**
 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
   

  

 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
* At Neko Health, our mission is to deliver proactive healthcare for all, empowering members to take control of their health through cutting-edge technology and compassionate care. As a Data Annotator, you will support our AI and Machine Learning teams by reviewing and accurately annotating health-related data according to defined guidelines. Your work will help create high-quality datasets that enable the development and improvement of our preventive healthcare technology. This role requires a high level of integrity, strong attention to detail, consistency, and the ability to work efficiently with large volumes of data.


**What You'll Deliver In The First 6–12 Months**
* Label and quality-check images/audio using our annotation tools.
* Follow clear guidelines and examples to label consistently and accurately.
* Flag unclear cases or data issues, and escalate to the team when needed.
* Help improve our labelling instructions by reporting edge cases and tool friction.


**Requirements**
* Comfortable working on a computer all day and a fast learner with new software.
* Experience to data analysis, data science, medical imaging or data annotation.
* High attention to detail and consistency; you enjoy structured tasks.
* Reliable, able to hit daily throughput targets without sacrificing quality.
* Professional with sensitive data, with a privacy-first mindset.
* Eligible to work in Sweden.


**Preferred**
* Experience with annotation tools, QA/review work, data analysis, or repetitive production workflows.
* Interest in health/tech, data science, machine learning, or AI (no medical background required).

title: Utredare
company: The National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen)
description:
**Utredare med uppdrag att leda pilotprojekt för nationell förvaltning av Komet** 




 Vill du bidra till en kunskapsbaserad socialtjänst? Socialstyrelsen söker en utredare som ska leda ett pilotprojekt för nationell förvaltning av föräldraskapsstödsprogrammet Komet.
 



  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Du leder och samordnar i huvudsak arbetet med pilotprojektet för nationell förvaltning av Komet. En central del av uppdraget är att planera, genomföra och utveckla utbildning och handledning för Komet-instruktörer inom ramen för en train-the-trainer-modell. Du bidrar till att Komet genomförs på ett enhetligt sätt och i enlighet med programmets innehåll och arbetssätt. Pilotprojektet planeras att pågå till och med 2029. Under perioden ska formerna för en långsiktigt hållbar nationell förvaltning av Komet prövas och utvecklas. Du samverkar med andra myndigheter och aktörer, framför allt med Myndigheten för familjerätt och föräldraskapsstöd (MFoF).
 



  





 Rollen innebär ett stort eget ansvar för att planera, driva och följa upp arbetet. Tjänsten är huvudsakligen inriktad på pilotprojektet, men kan även omfatta andra arbetsuppgifter inom enhetens ansvarsområde utifrån verksamhetens behov. Du deltar exempelvis i enhetens arbete med att utveckla och förvalta kunskapsstöd samt stödja evidensbaserad praktik i socialtjänsten.
 



  





 Du arbetar på enheten för forskning och utveckling (FoU), som utvecklar och utvärderar kunskapsstöd, arbetssätt och metoder för socialtjänsten. Enheten består av cirka 17 medarbetare, varav flertalet är forskare.
 



  





**Om dig** 




 Du samarbetar väl och kan bygga förtroendefulla relationer med olika professioner och organisationer. Du arbetar strukturerat och självständigt, kan analysera komplexa frågor och omsätta kunskap i praktiken. Du är trygg i att utbilda yrkesverksamma, anpassar din kommunikation till olika målgrupper och kan hantera olika perspektiv och meningsskiljaktigheter på ett konstruktivt sätt. Du uttrycker dig väl i tal och skrift. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.
 



  





 Vi söker dig som har
 


* akademisk examen i socialt arbete, sociologi, psykologi eller angränsande discipliner som kan anses som relevant
* erfarenhet av implementeringsarbete i kommunal eller regional verksamhet, exempelvis socialtjänst, skola, BUP eller elevhälsa
* erfarenhet av arbete vid statlig myndighet eller annan offentlig verksamhet
* erfarenhet av att planera och genomföra utbildning och/eller handledning för yrkesverksamma
* erfarenhet av att arbeta med, utbilda i eller implementera strukturerade och manualbaserade stöd- eller behandlingsinsatser för barn, unga eller föräldrar
* god och aktuell kännedom om socialtjänstens verksamhet
* förmåga att läsa, värdera och tillgodogöra dig vetenskaplig kunskap
* erfarenhet av rapportskrivning och muntliga presentationer
* mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.



  





 Det är meriterande om du har
 


* utbildning på avancerad nivå, det vill säga magister- eller masterexamen, inom ett för tjänsten relevant område
* instruktörsutbildning i Komet och/eller erfarenhet av att utbilda eller handleda inom programmet
* kunskap om social inlärningsteori, KBT eller andra relevanta teorier och arbetssätt inom föräldraskapsstöd
* erfarenhet av metodutveckling eller forskning inom socialtjänst eller välfärdssektorn.



  





**Bra att veta** 




 Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning och inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Tjänstetiteln är utredare och placeringen är vid Avdelningen för socialtjänst på systemnivå, enheten för forskning och utveckling (FoU). Du utgår från Socialstyrelsens kontor på Västerbroplan i Stockholm och har möjlighet att arbeta på distans upp till två dagar i veckan. Under våren 2027 flyttar Socialstyrelsen till Solna strand.
 



  





 För att göra en rättvis och likvärdig bedömning av använder vi oss urvalsfrågor. Besvara därför frågorna så utförligt som möjligt. Vi använder inte personligt brev i vårt urvalsarbete.
 



  





 Om du har frågor om tjänsten, kontakta tillförordnade enhetschef Renée Andersson, Anders.Nordlund@socialstyrelsen.se Vid frågor om rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta personalspecialist Galina Psibilskiene, galina.psibilskiene@socialstyrelsen.se
 



 Facklig företrädare för Saco-S är Isabelle Ålander Isabelle.Alander@socialstyrelsen.se Facklig företrädare för ST/OFR är Anders Nordlund Anders.Nordlund@socialstyrelsen.se Samtliga nås på telefonnummer 075-247 30 00.ACO.
 



  





 Har du skyddad identitet? Kontakta angiven personalspecialist ovan.
 



 Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 13 september 2026.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Vill du vara med och leda Folksam in i framtiden och göra skillnad på riktigt?
 



 På Folksam är vi inne i en stor digitaliseringsresa som ska skapa trygghet för våra 4 miljoner kunder. Fokus är på digitalisering av kundmötet, utveckling av framtidens försäkringssystem och förflyttning mot publika molntjänster. På IT enheten är vi cirka 750 medarbetare och har en teknisk miljö bestående av både standard- och egenutvecklade system.
 



 Vi söker nu en arkitekt som leder Folksams arkitekturarbete med fokus på vår digitala kundupplevelse.
 



  





**Det här gör du som Solution Architect Digital på Folksam** 




 Arkitektur är centralt i Folksams strategiska arbete, från affärsplanering till utförande med avgörande betydelse för att vägleda utvecklingsteamen att ständigt skapa mer kund- och affärsvärde på kortare tid. Vi moderniserar, effektiviserar och konsoliderar för att tillgodose dagens och morgondagens behov. För att lyckas med detta är vår digitala arkitektur av avgörande betydelse.
 



  





 Som Solution Architect Digital är du ansvarig för Folksams digitalisering och har stora möjligheter att påverka Folksams framtid. Du jobbar tillsammans med andra för att nå framdrift i vår digitala transformation.
 



  





 Huvudsakligen ansvarar du för att:
 


* leda och hålla ihop arkitekturarbetet kring vår digitala kundupplevelse
* utveckla Folksams arkitektur med betoning på det digitala tillsammans med övriga arkitekter och utvecklare
* arkitekturen är en möjliggörare för Folksams vision, strategi och mål på kort och lång sikt
* bryta ner affärskrav och arkitektur till leveranser och leda det operativa lösningsarbetet
* kartlägga, hantera och visualisera beroenden mellan olika affärsbehov för att ta fram effektiva lösningar och utvecklingsplaner
* arkitekturen är beskriven på ett sätt som gör att den är lätt att ta till sig av olika målgrupper
* arkitekturen följer dom regulatoriska krav som finns



  





 Som Solution Architect Digital jobbar du på både den strategiska, taktiska och operativa nivån. Till exempel så kommer du aktivt att bidra i frågor kring lösningsdesign, implementationsmönster, teknikval och kompetensförsörjning så att vi säkerställer effekthemtagning av våra förflyttningar. Tillsammans skapar vi möjligheten att utveckla vår affär!
 



  





**Är du den vi söker?** 




 Vi söker dig som har:
 


* bakgrund inom systemutveckling
* dokumenterad erfarenhet av att producera lösningsarkitektur som har realiserats
* dokumenterad hands-on implementationserfarenhet av en eller flera av följande: e-Commerce, IAM, CRM & CDP

title: Product Manager Ads Data Insights & Targeting
description:
**About The Team**
 The Ads Data Insights & Targeting team delivers leading targeting and reporting capabilities, a necessity for Schibsted to succeed in the advertising market. Our competition is Meta and Google, so the bar is high.
   

  

 Among our products are data cleanrooms, matched audiences infrastructure, reach estimation models, as well as general ad impression level data reporting and data products. Real AI requires real AI ready data and working towards this is our current top priority.
   

  

 Our products are powered by data from the billions of advertising impressions Schibsted generates each month as well as data about the millions of people using our services each day. Based on available data we define and calculate relevant metrics for our advertisers, we integrate with vendors and customers and provide targeting datasets for our advertising delivery systems. You and the team deliver the models and pipelines to convert the data we import into data outputs used by our customer facing applications.
   

  

 The data and insights team consists of 11 people, mostly based in Krakow, with a mix of data engineering, general software engineering and data analytics and science roles.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The product manager for data solutions is responsible for managing product development of all advertising data flows related to campaign targeting and insight reporting. The responsibilities include:
   

  

* Manage near-term product delivery (we use a Kanban approach) while steering our offering with a long-term product strategy in mind.
* Collaborate with product marketing and sales teams to understand client and market requirements to feed into the product development process
* Collaborate with teams in ad operations and ad technology and other engineering teams and product functions to bring our data products to market


 You will report to the director of ad data capabilities and work closely with our data portfolio team in Norway and Sweden as well as other product managers for Schibsted ad technologies. You will work on site in either our office in Akersgata (Oslo) or Västra Järnvägsgatan (Stockholm).
   

  

**To thrive in this role we believe you**
* Are in possession of strong analytical skills and mindset
* Are good at building trust with all types of internal and external stakeholders
* Enjoy constantly changing perspectives from the critical details to the bigger picture


**Competency Requirements**
* Degree level qualification in business, mathematics, statistics or technology, or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of experience within product management or data analyst roles or equivalent.


**Valued Skills And Experience**
* Fluency in a Scandinavian language
* Experience from product management with data products and large datasets
* High level understanding of relevant cloud and big data technologies
* Experience from media or advertising industry


**About Schibsted Marketing Services**
 Schibsted Marketing Services is Schibsted´s advertising organization, representing some of the strongest news brands in Norway and Sweden - like VG, Aftonbladet, Aftenposten and SvD. In addition we work with our partners at TVM representing TV4 and MTV on select data targeting and insights projects.
   

  

 Advertising plays a central role in funding independent news media, and every day the people at Schibsted Marketing Services work hard to strengthen Schibsted
 **’** 
 s position in the advertising markets we operate. You can be part of that team and that journey.

title: Design Manager
description:
**Design Project Manager** 




**Location: Sweden** 




**Sector: Data Centres / Mission Critical** 




**On site Monday - Friday** 




**Project Type: Large-Scale Data Centre Development** 




  





**The Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Project Design Manager** 
 to join the delivery team on a major data centre development in Sweden.
 



 This is a key project position responsible for leading and coordinating multidisciplinary design activities throughout the project lifecycle, from early-stage design through construction and execution.
 



  





 The successful candidate will work closely with engineering teams, architects, consultants, contractors and project stakeholders to ensure design solutions are technically robust, commercially viable, constructible and aligned with programme requirements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead and coordinate the multidisciplinary design process across Architectural, Structural, Civil, Mechanical and Electrical disciplines.
* Manage design activities from early-stage development through detailed design, construction and project delivery.
* Coordinate closely with engineers, architects, consultants, contractors and internal project teams.
* Monitor design programmes, key milestones, deliverables and deadlines.
* Review technical drawings, specifications, design packages and associated documentation.
* Ensure designs comply with relevant Nordic and European standards, regulations and project requirements.
* Manage interfaces between CSA, Mechanical and Electrical disciplines to ensure effective design integration.
* Drive design coordination meetings, technical reviews and workshops.
* Identify design risks, clashes and potential constructability issues at an early stage and coordinate appropriate solutions.
* Support the optimisation of design solutions with a focus on efficiency, scalability, resilience and performance.
* Work closely with construction and project delivery teams to ensure designs are practical and aligned with site requirements.
* Manage communication between key stakeholders and ensure technical requirements are clearly understood and incorporated into the design.
* Support design change management and ensure changes are effectively communicated across relevant disciplines.
* Maintain a strong focus on quality, programme and successful project execution.



  





**Experience & Qualifications** 




 The ideal candidate will have:
 


* A degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Approximately 8–10+ years' experience within design, engineering or design management.
* Proven experience managing and coordinating multidisciplinary design teams.
* Strong understanding of Architectural, Structural and MEP design coordination.
* Previous experience within data centres, mission-critical facilities or other technically complex construction projects would be highly advantageous.
* Knowledge of relevant industry standards, potentially including ASHRAE, EN 50600, Uptime Institute and TIA.
* Experience working with AutoCAD, Revit and/or BIM platforms.
* Experience working within international, fast-paced construction or engineering environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple design packages, priorities and deadlines simultaneously.

title: Product Manager Public Safety
description:
*Do you want to shape products that support rescue services and public safety organisations when every second counts? Are you an experienced* 
***Product Manager***
*who enjoys combining customer insight, technology and business needs to turn complex requirements into solutions that create real operational value?*
 AddSecure is strengthening its Public Safety portfolio, and we are now looking for a Product Manager to drive the development and success of our solutions for emergency response and public safety organisations.
   

  

**AddSecure** 
 is a leading European provider of secure IoT connectivity and critical communications solutions. Within our Public Safety business, we develop and deliver solutions that support emergency response organizations, rescue services, and public safety agencies when every second counts.
   

  

 Our primary market today is Sweden. As customer needs, technology and the market continue to evolve, you will play an important role in shaping our future portfolio and supporting opportunities for growth in existing and new markets.
   

  

**About The Job**
 As Product Manager, you will be responsible for defining and driving the product strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of Public Safety solutions.
   

  

 You will work closely with customers to understand their operational challenges and translate those needs into clear product priorities. At the same time, you will balance customer needs with business objectives, technical possibilities and long-term portfolio development.
   

  

 This is a role that combines strategic product management with hands-on collaboration across development, sales, operations and other key stakeholders.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Define and drive product strategy, modernisation, roadmaps and long-term portfolio development.
* Engage directly with rescue services and other public safety organisations to understand operational needs and identify opportunities for product development.
* Own the product lifecycle from idea, prioritisation and business case through development, launch and continuous improvement.
* Work closely with development teams in an Agile environment to create and prioritise requirements and deliver customer value.
* Collaborate with Sales, Operations and Support to ensure successful product launches, adoption and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor market developments, regulatory requirements and emerging technologies within public safety and critical communications.
* Identify opportunities for growth across customers, segments and markets.
* Support go-to-market activities and represent AddSecure in customer meetings, industry events and relevant public safety forums.


**About You**
 We are looking for someone who combines strong product management capabilities with curiosity about customers, technology and business.
   

  

**We believe you have:**
* Proven experience as a Product Manager or in a similar product-focused role within software, technology, communications or another technology-driven environment.
* Experience working closely with software development teams in an Agile product development environment.
* Experience translating customer and market needs into product requirements, priorities and business value.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across customers, commercial teams and technical functions.
* A commercial mindset and the ability to evaluate opportunities from both a customer and business perspective.
* Professional fluency in both Swedish and English.


 Experience from public safety, emergency services, mission-critical communications, public-sector technology or critical infrastructure would be highly valuable.
   

  

**We offer**
 Our employees are our greatest asset and for us it is of great importance to build a culture where our employees thrive and want to perform. You will be part of a motivated team in an international company. In addition, we offer:
   

  

* Wellness allowance
* Occupational pension
* Enhanced parental pay
* Health checks
* Parking


 Start: preferably as soon as possible / according to agreement
   

  

**We're all change makers!**
 If you're looking for an organisation where you can be yourself, have fun at work, and contribute to a safer, smarter, and more sustainable world, AddSecure may be the place for you. Join our growing international team, where every day offers an opportunity to make a real difference.
   

  

 Would you like to take part in our journey? Please apply by submitting your CV and answering a few short questions. We look forward to receiving your application.
   

  

 We use a competence-based recruitment process that may include psychometric assessments, interviews, reference checks, and background checks. As part of the process, candidates may complete assessments provided by Alva Labs to support a fair and structured evaluation.
   

  

 We conduct background checks for all our employees, and you must be eligible to work in Sweden.
   

  

 #addsecure #joinaddsecure #forasaferandsmarterworld #smartertogether #tProductManager #PublicSafety #CriticalCommunications #IoT #ProductManagement #TechJobs
   

  

 AddSecure is a leading European provider of secure IoT connectivity and end-to-end solutions. We help customers optimise their operations, drive business value, and secure vital functions. By combining connected, data-driven, and sensor-based solutions with best-in-class expertise, we meet our customers’ needs regardless of industry. Our secure IoT solutions are used within the areas of buildings, alarms, transportation and logistics, personal safety and security, elderly care, construction, municipalities, schools, rescue services, power grids, and more.

title: Product Owner - Treasury Applications
description:

 Do you want to drive the development and lifecycle of the Treasury application portfolio and lead digital transformation in Treasury processes across the organization? Do you enjoy working in an agile environment, close to internal customers, where new initiatives and possibilities are constantly emerging and the products are delivered and continuously improved to accelerate productivity of thousands of users?
   

  

 Come and join our team, Group Applications, in Atlas Copco Group IT!
   

  

 In the role of the
 **Product Owner** 
 , your primary responsibility is to deliver and maintain
 **Treasury IT applications** 
 , namely Trax, Quantum, and Multibank, in line with Atlas Copco’s business needs while safeguarding system and data integrity.
   

  

 You also act as the technical subject matter expert for the Treasury applications, ensuring their compliant operation and ongoing stability.
   

  

 You may lead a highly motivated virtual, cross-regional team, delivering quality services for our internal customers. Your team will be a combination of internally assigned personnel and external service providers.

 Responsible for product portfolio positioning (vision, architecture, roadmap)
   

  

* Align with business stakeholders in setting priorities and driving product projects
* Develop and maintain product and technology roadmap
* Establish product governance structure
* Create Service Operating Model and define KPIs
* Develop communication strategy

 You will report to Group Applications Manager.

*

*

**In return, we offer**

**Location:** 
 Brno, Dublin, Shanghai, Stockholm
   

  

 This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our office.
   

  

**Uniting curious minds**
 Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

title: Beauty Advisor/Artist Beauty Advisor
description:

 is one of the world’s leading manufacturers, marketers, and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance, and hair care products, and is a steward of luxury and prestige brands globally. The company’s products are sold in approximately 150 countries and territories under brand names including: Estée Lauder, Aramis, Clinique, Lab Series, Origins, M·A·C, La Mer, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics, Aveda, Jo Malone London, Bumble and bumble, Darphin Paris, TOM FORD, Smashbox, AERIN Beauty, Le Labo, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, GLAMGLOW, KILIAN PARIS, Too Faced, Dr.Jart+, the DECIEM family of brands, including The Ordinary and NIOD, and BALMAIN Beauty.

 You will also like working as part of a high performing team to create impact with in-store events and to ensure that the store always achieves our high standards of visual merchandising to stand out against our competitors.

 While certification in make up artistry and/or previous retail make up experience is desirable we also welcome applicants with amateur level experience. As a leader in prestige beauty with a culture that values diversity of thought and people, we offer excellent training and development and a competitive remuneration and benefits package.

* All applicants must be able to demonstrate the ability to provide inspirational, authentic and personalized customer service
* Ability to work retail hours including days, nights, weekends and special events in a fast-paced work environment
* Previous experience with retail point-of-sale software
* Applicants must be able to provide proof of right to live and work in the country if invited to attend for interview


**Pay Range**
 Anticipated Base Salary Range kr26,000.00 to kr28,500.00 (Depending on qualifications, skills, experience and/or budget), based on a 40 hour work week (range to be scaled accordingly). In addition, The Estée Lauder Companies offers a variety of benefits to eligible employees, including health insurance coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance), wellness and family support programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, education-related programs, paid holidays and vacation time. In addition, the Company maintains highly competitive incentive compensation programs (role eligibility may vary based on terms of the respective plan(s)).
   

  

 You may be eligible to participate in the applicable Commission/Bonus Plan, under the plan guidelines in effect at the time of hire. Additional details regarding the commission plan will be provided as part of your onboarding.

title: Senior Art Director
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a visionary
 **Senior Art Director** 
 to elevate the creative impact of our projects. In this role, you will shape and lead creative development, actively engaging with clients to refine project scope and expectations. You’ll not only drive conceptual direction but also produce and oversee visual work across digital, social, video, and print channels, embedding the client’s brand and products within a crafted visual language.
   

  

 You will forge strong, seamless collaboration across departments, blending strategic insight with hands-on creative execution to deliver work of exceptional quality. The ideal candidate is detail-obsessed, aesthetically sharp, skilled at building partnerships, and capable of both inspiring and guiding the team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop creative concepts and communication strategies in partnership with the Creative Lead, Brand Director, and client teams, translating ideas into innovative visual assets and storytelling across channels.
* Manage projects from initiation to completion, leading the creative work through conceptualization, execution, and production with support from the Creative Lead and project management.
* Direct design to ensure consistency and quality across all visual outputs, including new business opportunities and client projects.
* Produce visuals tailored to diverse communication channels.
* Act as the driving force in visual execution on dedicated client projects, ensuring quality control throughout the process.
* Communicate effectively and collaborate closely with team members and external partners.
* Mentor teams in commercial art principles, nurturing strategic and creative thinking while fostering a collaborative environment.
* Cultivate a respectful and trusting workplace that values humility and creates comfort for all team members.
* Stay informed on emerging technologies, sharing relevant insights and inspiring new creative ideas.
* Demonstrate proficiency in industry-standard design software.
* Uphold recognition for creative, impactful solutions rooted in conceptual and strategic thinking.
* Manage project timelines to ensure timely delivery of high-quality creative assets.
* Conduct visual research and stay updated on trends in design, branding, and media to continuously enhance creative output.


 QUALIFICATIONS
   

  

* Proven track record as an Art Director with 5+ years of experience in an agency, freelance, or client-side environment, with a background in working with brands across various categories, both locally and internationally.
* Conceptually strong, with a talent for landing unexpected ideas and shaping them into compelling concepts that bring fresh thinking to the team.
* Strong visual skills and expertise in industry-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Suite including After Effects, Figma, and video editing tools).
* Experience in developing and executing visual concepts and campaigns for omnichannel marketing and advertising.
* Holistic view of communication and a solid understanding of brands and branding, with the ability to see the big picture and think conceptually.
* Advantageous: strong portfolio examples in digital environments and motion graphics.
* Analytical and presentation skills, with the ability to swiftly translate them into project documents and presentations.
* Solution-oriented and flexible, with an eye for new opportunities.
* Passionate about the creative industries, with a keen knowledge of current trends.
* Fluent in both written and spoken Swedish and English.


 This is a permanent position with a 6-month probation period. Employment will start according to agreement. We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Principal Embedded Software Engineer to Markem-Imaje
company: ANTS Akademiskt Nätverk av Tekniska Studenter AB
description:
Om jobbet
  
Markem-Imaje is a trusted world manufacturer of product identification and traceability solutions, offering a full range of reliable and innovative inkjet, thermal transfer, laser, print and label application systems. Markem-Imaje delivers fully integrated solutions that enable product quality and safety, regulatory and retailer compliance, better product recalls and improved manufacturing processes.
  
Markem-Imaje Sweden in Gothenburg is something as unusual as a small innovation and development hub with a startup mindset within an established global company.
  
Our mission is to lead the development of new innovative products and solutions, from concept to production with the freedom to use the work methods we find most efficient. We love what we do, and we have help from the global organization we are a part of.
  
The Role
  
We are seeking an experienced, skilled, and self-driven Principal Embedded Software Engineer, with a system mindset and an interest in exciting technology. You, just like we do, appreciate working with the complete development cycle, from idea to finished product, via proof of concept and implementation, using effective methods and tools.
  
  

**In this role, you will:**  

Develop control software in C++ and Go, as well as associated software architecture, in cooperation with developers from both the local office and other offices within the global organization.
  
  

Bring a system level view, understanding how the software interacts with the hardware, how different customers use the products, and using that knowledge in architectural and prioritization work.
  
  

Be part of an experienced and passionate team that develops not only software but also electronics and mechanics, with the possibility to share ideas, experience, and knowledge.
  
  

Influence design choices within all development disciplines.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
You will develop controller software in C++ and Golang, as well as associated tests, for a controller running embedded Linux that cooperates with other components within the printer, such as MCUs and FPGA. You will interface with other engineering disciplines, engineering teams, stakeholders, and customers to understand the application space and business requirements and use that understanding to influence technology selection and decisions, both within the company and together with major customers.
  
  

**Beyond day-to-day development, you will:**  

Lead and facilitate high level software estimation to support business planning activities.
  
  

Mentor and teach other software engineers in improving their skills.
  
  

Lead design reviews and drive improvements in design and code quality produced by internal and external engineers.
  
  

Drive continuous improvement in source control and continuous integration by staying up to date with the latest industry practices and tools.
  
  

Test and fault find code written by yourself and by others.
  
  

Throughout, you'll work closely with the team to achieve shared goals, and influence and inspire others through personal credibility.
  
What You Need To Have
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree with significant professional experience developing software, and a demonstrable record of delivering high-quality embedded software for end user products from requirements analysis to delivery.
  
  

Expert in writing portable, cross-platform, modern C++ code, with solid experience in Go/Golang and expert knowledge of real time operating system (RTOS) concepts.
  
  

Expert architecture and design skills, functional decomposition, architectural viewpoints, UML/SysML, and design patterns, together with advanced implementation skills such as multithreaded and distributed systems programming and on target debugging.
  
  

Demonstrable experience in a technical leadership role within a software team and for external engineering resources, including code reviews, design reviews, and mentoring.
  
  

Advanced knowledge of electronics, including microcontrollers, memory and peripherals, and experience reading schematics and using oscilloscopes/logic analyzers.
  
  

Swedish, French, Italian, or Polish language skills would be beneficial but are not a requirement.
  
If you believe you match our values and have the experience we're looking for, then apply as we review applications on a rolling basis! We can't wait to hear from you!

Som nätverkstekniker hos oss har du en nyckelroll i att hålla vår operativa vardag flytande. Du blir teamets klippa i den dagliga hanteringen samtidigt som du arbetar nära våra seniora nätverkstekniker och stöttar dem i större initiativ, projekt och arkitekturförändringar.


Genom att kombinera ett operativt ärendeägarskap med moderna AI-verktyg hittar du nya sätt att automatisera rutinuppgifter, effektivisera våra processer och lösa tekniska utmaningar snabbare.

**Vem vi söker**

Vi söker dig med minst 2-3 års erfarenhet som vill växa i din roll och ser detta som en perfekt språngbräda i din karriär. Du kombinerar en grundläggande teknisk förståelse med en stor nyfikenhet på nya verktyg - framför allt AI. #### **Kvalifikationer & Profil:**

It-avdelningen utvecklar och moderniserar polisens it och myndigheten satsar mycket på att stärka avdelningen med ny specialistkompetens och den senaste teknologin till nytta för medborgarna och medarbetarna i den polisiära verksamheten.

Som verksamhetsutvecklare företräder du hela Polismyndigheten både internt och externt samt arbetar för att stärka förtroendet för polisverksamheten.

title: Senior Projektledare

Med en stark drivkraft för kvalitet och agilitet stöttar vi dig genom hela din karriär så att du kan göra allt större avtryck och bli den bästa versionen av dig själv.


**Om rollen**

Du leder komplexa IT- och teknikprojekt med höga säkerhetskrav och är med och utvecklar lösningar som säkrar Sveriges energiförsörjning och digitala infrastruktur. title: Incident & Response Manager
description:
Vill du driva och vidareutveckla Hogiakoncernens gemensamma incidenthantering? Som Incident & Response Manager (IRM) får du en koncerngemensam roll med ansvar för att samordna, utveckla och följa upp arbetet med informations- och cybersäkerhetsincidenter.

##### **Om rollen**


Som Incident & Response Manager är du processägare för Hogiakoncernens incidenthantering. Du säkerställer ett tydligt och praktiskt fungerande arbetssätt för incidentklassning, eskalering, samordning, dokumentation och uppföljning. Du kommer att utgå från vårt huvudkontor som är vackert beläget vid havet i Stenungsund.


Du kommer bland annat att:

* driva och vidareutveckla koncernens IRM-process, inklusive roller, ansvar och eskaleringsvägar
* leda eller samordna hanteringen av allvarliga informations- och cybersäkerhetsincidenter
* säkerställa lägesbild, informationsflöde och dokumentation vid incidenter
* driva uppföljning och lärande efter incidenter och omsätta lärdomar till konkreta förbättringar
* samverka med CISO, IT, bolag, affärsområden och externa parter


För rätt person finns även möjlighet att kombinera IRM-ansvaret med mer operativt IT-säkerhetsarbete, exempelvis inom sårbarhetshantering, loggning och säkerhetskontroller.

##### **Vem är du?**


Vi söker dig som har dokumenterad erfarenhet av incidenthantering inom informations- och/eller cybersäkerhet. Du har erfarenhet av att leda eller samordna incidenter där flera interna och externa parter behöver involveras och har god förståelse för IRM ur ett process- och styrningsperspektiv.


Vi tror att du:

* har erfarenhet av incidentklassning, eskalering, samordning, dokumentation och uppföljning
* är strukturerad och analytisk och kan agera lugnt och metodiskt vid incidenter
* är trygg och tydlig i din kommunikation och kan anpassa information till olika målgrupper
* har relevant akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis informationssäkerhet, IT, juridik eller motsvarande förvärvad kompetens


Eftersom vårt interna arbetsspråk är svenska behöver du kunna kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och ha goda kunskaper i engelska.


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av NIS2/CSL eller GDPR kopplat till incidenthantering, arbete i koncern eller annan komplex organisation samt praktisk IT- eller cybersäkerhet. Relevanta certifieringar är också meriterande.


Hos oss får du möjlighet att påverka och vidareutveckla en viktig koncerngemensam förmåga inom incidenthantering och cybersäkerhet.

***Välkommen med din ansökan!*** *Vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. För den här rollen genomförs en bakgrundskontroll. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Talent Acquisition Specialist Lina Hedenberg på* *lina.hedenberg@hogia.se**.*

**Om Hogia-gruppen**


Hogia utvecklar, säljer och supportar programvaror och IT-system för företag som effektivt vill fokusera på sina verksamheter i stället för krånglig och tidsödande administration. Vi erbjuder allt från mindre löne- och bokföringsprogram för småföretagaren till kompletta, branschspecifika IT-lösningar och -system för exempelvis kollektivtrafik, åkerier, godsterminaler, revisionsbyråer och fastighetsbolag. I Hogiagruppen finns 30 operativa bolag, som vart och ett verkar inom ett väl definierat verksamhetsområde. Vår organisationsform bygger uttalat på småskalighet och entreprenörsanda. Företagskulturen skapar engagerade medarbetare. Tillsammans ger vi våra kunder de bästa tänkbara affärslösningarna. Hogia startade sin verksamhet 1980 i Stenungsund. I dag har den privatägda koncernen totalt 650 anställda på kontor i Sverige, Norge och Finland. Mer information om Hogia finns på www.hogia.se.

title: Business Information Security Officer
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla Hogiakoncernens arbete inom informations- och cybersäkerhet? Som BISO får du en verksamhetsnära roll där du omsätter krav och risker till praktiska lösningar.

##### **Om rollen**


Som BISO blir du ett verksamhetsnära stöd för Hogiakoncernens bolag och affärsområden. Du hjälper verksamheten att förstå vad olika säkerhetskrav och risker innebär i praktiken och omsätter dem till tydliga rekommendationer, arbetssätt och prioriteringar. Du kommer att utgå från vårt huvudkontor som är vackert beläget vid havet i Stenungsund.


Du kommer bland annat att:

* stötta verksamheten i informations- och cybersäkerhetsfrågor
* tolka externa krav och interna styrningar och omsätta dem till praktiska arbetssätt
* bidra i riskbedömningar, säkerhetsgranskningar och uppföljning av säkerhetsåtgärder
* vara ett stöd i kunddialoger, upphandlingar och leverantörsbedömningar där säkerhet är en viktig del
* identifiera förbättringsbehov och bidra till att rätt säkerhetsåtgärder prioriteras
* bidra till utbildning och kommunikation så att säkerhetsfrågor blir begripliga och möjliga att omsätta i vardagen


Du arbetar nära CISO, IT och andra säkerhetsfunktioner och har många kontaktytor inom Hogia. Rollen innebär också att du får vara med och vidareutveckla själva BISO-funktionen och hur vi arbetar med verksamhetsnära säkerhet framåt.

##### **Vem är du?**


Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av informations- och/eller cybersäkerhetsarbete i en verksamhetsnära roll. Du kanske har arbetat som ISO, informationssäkerhetssamordnare, säkerhetsrådgivare eller i en liknande roll. Det viktiga är inte titeln, utan att du har erfarenhet av att stötta verksamhet eller ledning i säkerhetsrelaterade frågor. Eftersom vårt interna arbetsspråk är svenska behöver du kunna kommunicera obehindrat på svenska, samtidigt som du behöver kunna tala och förstå engelska i arbetet.


Vi tror att du:

* har god förståelse för informations- och cybersäkerhet, riskhantering och efterlevnad
* kan tolka krav och risker och omsätta dem till tydliga rekommendationer och praktiska arbetssätt
* har erfarenhet av riskbedömningar, uppföljning och förbättringsarbete

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to billions of people in their everyday lives.


Residential real estate is the world’s largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen.


In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 14,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Together, we aspire to break new ground through innovation and cultivate a workplace where we help each other succeed, where ideas matter more than titles, and where kindness is a strength.


By combining the power of people and technology, we set a new standard for how homes are managed. Our technology-enabled services simplify living for residents and create a better experience for property owners and boards.


Our ambition is to continue our fast-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.


As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision-making close to our customers.


If you share our mindset and ambition, we’d love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.

#### **About the role**


As a Data Engineer in our Global Data & BI team, you will build and operate the pipelines that power the Odevo Data Warehouse (ODW). Working within an established Microsoft Fabric architecture, you'll ingest data from the many source systems used across our operating companies, model it into trusted, reusable datasets, and keep it flowing reliably to the dashboards and data products our business depends on.

###### **Key responsibilities**

* Build and maintain ingestion pipelines in Fabric Data Factory across APIs, databases, SaaS platforms and file-based feeds, including incremental and change data capture patterns.
* Develop and test transformation models across the Bronze, Silver and Gold layers (medallion architecture), following the team's modelling standards and naming conventions.
* Model data for analytical consumption — dimensional models, slowly changing dimensions, and handling multi-entity, multi-currency and multi-country data.
* Operate what you build: monitor pipeline health, investigate and fix failures, respond to source schema changes, and improve reliability and run cost.
* Implement data quality tests and validation rules in pipelines, working to the standards set by our Data Enablement squad.
* Prepare and document governed datasets for the Published layer, so that BI developers, semantic models and downstream applications can consume them with confidence.
* Work within our engineering workflow — version control and CI/CD in Azure DevOps, peer review, secrets management in Azure Key Vault, and clear documentation of pipelines and lineage.
* Work directly with BI developers and business stakeholders to understand what the data is for, and translate that into pipelines and models that answer the actual question.

#### **Who you are**


You're a pragmatic builder who gets things into production. You're comfortable with messy, undocumented source systems and enjoy the detective work of figuring out what the data actually means. You take ownership of the pipelines you build rather than handing them over, you ask what a dataset is for before you build it, and you can explain what you've done to someone who doesn't work in data. You want to work somewhere the data platform is still being built out, rather than somewhere it's already finished.

###### **Experience**

* 2–4 years' hands-on data engineering experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.
* Strong SQL, and Python for data manipulation, automation and API-based ingestion.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Synapse Data Warehouse / Lakehouse, OneLake) — or with the Azure equivalents such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse or Databricks, and the appetite to move onto Fabric quickly.
* Practical experience transformation framework and a solid grasp of modular, tested SQL modelling.
* Solid understanding of data warehousing, ELT and dimensional modelling.
* Comfortable working with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines, ideally Azure DevOps.
* Awareness of data protection and security practice — GDPR, handling of personal data, role-based access — applied to the data you work with.
* Nice to have: experience integrating newly acquired businesses or consolidating data across multiple legal entities; exposure to Power BI as a consumer of your models.

**What Success Looks Like in Your First Six Months**

* You've independently onboarded a new source system into the Bronze and Silver layers, from first connection through to a tested, documented model.
* You're the go-to person for two or three pipelines, including keeping them running.
* You've built at least one Gold-layer dataset that a BI developer or stakeholder is actively using for reporting.
* You're contributing to code review and raising improvements to how the team works, not just consuming the standards.

##### **What we offer**

* Professional growth - to work with the most talented developers in the industry.
* Modern technology - we invest in the latest technologies and tools and encourage our team members to share their ideas and take ownership of their work.
* Innovation - to work on exciting projects that push the boundaries of our industry and make a real impact.
* Commitment to quality - a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values profitable and long-term product development.

**Sounds like you?** Apply today!

resultatet av kravarbetet

Svenska Kraftnät
