title: Engineering Manager - EU
description:
Hi 👋 I’m Colin, Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby.
   

  

 To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been
 *skunkworks* 
 projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby.
   

  

 When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a
 *pessimistic* 
 mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is
 *optimistic* 
 about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way).
   

  

 To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path.
   

  

 We’ve already gathered an experienced, talented, and collaborative team of 25+ engineers. You’ll help me manage the growing team of engineers in Europe.
   

  

 In Addition To Working With Engineers You’ll Also Get To Work On Projects Yourselves. Some Examples Of Work Our Engineering Leaders Have Done
   

  

* Provide feedback on product and technical specs to help engineers identify where to cut scope or improve quality. You don’t make the final decisions, but you’ll influence and coach ICs to reach the right ones.
* Grow engineers to the point where they can take large, loosely defined projects, and deliver them with little intervention. They still ask for help when needed - the difference is that they’re driving.
* Jump into our systems and code to debug a customer issue, ship a small bug fix, or improve our developer experience. Engineering leaders at Ashby are great engineers and enjoy keeping their skills up-to-date (while staying off the critical path).
* Improve how we generate and simulate data in demo accounts. It’s a project off the critical path, but it helps you keep up-to-date on our codebase while immensely impacting the business, from Engineering to QA to Sales.


 Why be a manager?
   

  

 I had two experiences early in my career that set me on my path. I had a great manager who asked tonnes of questions about the decisions I was making and coached me without me realizing it. And I had a
 *terrible* 
 manager - being told to work harder after a week of 3am finishes was not what I needed as a young engineer. The stark difference between these two experiences motivated me to become a manager: I wanted every engineer I worked with to have the support I had in the best case.
   

  

 Since then, as I’ve learned more, I’ve realized that I love the kind of problems I get to solve as a manager. Deeply complex problems with long-term impact both on the company and on people’s lives. One of my proudest achievements is creating a fully transparent pay system, and on the day it was revealed, everybody was happy with it. Nobody stormed out. By spending time thinking deeply about everybody’s pay and ensuring the mechanics of promotion were clear, I put the team in a place where they could see a peer was paid more than them, and it not be a problem.
   

  

 Despite all this, I love being technical. I sometimes indulge myself and spend a morning writing some code to improve tests or provide better abstractions. If I couldn’t be a manager, I’d be super happy to be an IC.
   

  

 I’m looking for someone who is passionate. Passionate about both management and being technical. Someone who spots a pattern amongst their team, figures out a better way for us to operate, and then builds the automation that powers it. I introduced a new process that enables engineers to merge 30% of PRs without a human review beforehand. I also built the automation that approves these PRs. I
 *also* 
 built that automation with abstractions that make it easy for the engineers to improve the automation themselves.
   

  

 It can be hard to find seasoned engineering leaders who haven’t succumbed to the status quo in some way or another. We're committed to giving all our people a total and utter lack of terrible managers, and that means we're willing to take a chance on someone early in their leadership journey who's courageous, principled, and has the drive to build themselves into a great leader who can say “Yah I know everyone is doing that, but we won't because...”
   

  

 What We’re Building
   

  

 As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us
 **better** 
 at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition (TA) software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back.
   

  

 Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. A recruiter needed to manually collect availability from the candidate, identify qualified interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and make any last-minute adjustments as availability changed. They must do this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. 🥵 TA software didn’t help.
   

  

 As hiring managers, we know TA is a critical function, and as engineers, we know software can do better. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the
 *highest* 
 standard of tooling. Software that’s intelligent and powerful. Software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!
   

  

 As we’ve set the standard for excellence in TA software, HR teams have pulled us into solving their problems in areas like onboarding and performance management.
   

  

 Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply
   

  

 Engineering Leadership Comes In Many Flavors, Not All Of Which Fit Our Model. I Thought I’d Outline Some Things I’m Looking For To Help You Decide If This Fits What You’re Looking For
   

  

* You love being technical and can hold in-depth conversations with direct reports from infra to backend to frontend.
* You enjoy management problems. We want people who get excited about driving people to be their best, giving difficult feedback, and building systems that make this easier
* You hold your team to a high standard and don’t shy away from getting into the details and giving feedback, even to the best folks on your team.
* You are an excellent and empathetic communicator. Facilitating change at both an individual and organization level requires understanding how to navigate the beliefs, opinions, and past experiences of engineers and figuring out how to both convince them of a new way of doing things while also leaving yourself open to feedback.
* You know what exceptional engineers look like. You’ve thought deeply about what makes them tick, how to recruit them, and how to grow folks into them. I want to see depth here, the industry often regurgitates a vanilla description, but the reality is more nuanced.
* You’re good at thinking about product, business, and maybe even design, but you’re not interested in calling the shots and are more interested in building a team that can make the best decisions without you.
* You thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments. We're a young startup where leaders wear multiple hats, and you'll build your own (high-speed) on-ramp through developing strong feedback loops.


**Put Another Way, You Shouldn’t Apply If**
* You don’t enjoy coding or don’t find time to stay up-to-date on technology.
* You’ve gotten into management because it was the only growth path available
* You want to make all the product decisions instead of empowering your team to make those calls.
* You're happy with a team of engineers that are predominantly early-career, mid-career, or don't thrive with ownership or autonomy. With enough guardrails, the team can get things done.
* A staff or principal engineer to you is someone who spends most of their time project managing or doing architecture reviews.
* You’re not optimistic or convinced that we can build a large engineering team that functions differently than the status quo. You think, at some size, common processes need to be implemented to ensure consistent product delivery (e.g., sprint planning, product managers writing in-depth specifications). You might not say it out loud, but you think, at some size, compromises have to be made for the sake of hiring numbers.


 Engineering Culture
   

  

 Our Engineering Culture Is Motivated By Abhik And Benji’s (our Co-founders) Belief That a Small Talented Team, Given The Right Environment, Can Build High-quality Software Fast (and Work Regular Hours!). We Do It Through
   

  

* Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design
* Natural collaboration and deliberate communication
* Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage
* Putting effort into building a diverse team


**Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership**
 The best engineers we’ve worked with delivered reliably magical outcomes. They took customer problems and relentlessly drove them to solutions that were not only successful but often brilliant and creative. While they did this with minimal oversight, stakeholders were never in the dark as to what was going on, and no setback was a surprise.
   

  

 Traditional product-development processes aren’t meant for the best engineers. Their purpose is to create consistent outcomes regardless of the engineer’s skill. But, consistency comes at the expense of an engineer’s time and freedom—both ingredients necessary to generate those magical outcomes. As a result, process stifles the best engineers and doesn’t give others the opportunity to practice the behaviors that made the best engineers the “best.”
   

  

 At Ashby, we want to build an environment that encourages every engineer to be their best. So, at Ashby, every Engineer runs their project. Product Managers (and Designers) build strategy, do customer research, and hand off problem briefs to Engineers. Engineers take on the rest: they research the problem, write product specs, build wireframes, and implement their solution end-to-end. We rely on engineers, not process, to push information outward to the relevant folks (e.g., Product Managers) and pull folks in to help (e.g., Designers, Infra). It’s a new level of ownership for many engineers, but we’d rather an engineer fail a bit and coach up their skills than use process as a crutch. Not everyone succeeds in our culture, but those who do
 *thrive* 
 .
   

  

**Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate**
 Our engineering team consists of lifelong learners who are talented but also humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally. We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers are in <2h meetings per week (I wrote about it here).
   

  

 To Drive It Home, Here's a Recent Calendar Of An Engineer Who Has Been With Us For Over 4 Years. ~34 Hours Of Focus Time, 2.5h Of Interviews, And 3.5 Hours Of Meetings
   

  

 We also meet in person at least twice a year, once as a department and once as a company. You also have a small budget to meet up with folks in your city/region.
   

  

**Increase Leverage, not Team Size**
 We Built Ashby With The Quality, Breadth, And Depth That Many Customers Would Expect From Much Larger Teams Over Larger Time Scales. We’ve Done This Through Investment In
   

  

* Great developer tooling. Our CI/CD takes ~10m, and we deploy at least 15x a day. A debugger that works out of the box. Everyone on the team has contributed to our developer experience 💪🏾.
* Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) that we constantly improve. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video below).
* AI-powered tooling. We think of AI as a way to automate the mundane parts of building and maintaining high-quality software. We use a combination of third-party and internally built tools that, for instance, auto-triage customer issues, suggest fixes, prototype ideas, generate production-ready code, and conduct code reviews. Engineers have an unlimited token budget (but are not measured on it). We write in detail about our philosophy, current use of AI, and future plans for AI in Engineering here.


**And a Demo Of One Of These Building Blocks**
 Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby:
   

  

**Put Effort into Diversity**
 Diverse teams drive innovation and better outcomes. Having seen my mother and partner build their careers as minority women in non-diverse fields, I want to make sure Ashby creates opportunities for the next generation of engineers from underrepresented groups.
   

  

 Today, 25% of engineers and 50% of our engineering leaders at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. We are taking conscious steps to improve, like sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, no leetcode interviews, and more.
   

  

**Work-Life Balance: It’s A Marathon, Not a Sprint**
 The intensity of work at Ashby should feel like a marathon, not a sprint (nor speed-walking). We work with urgency and ambition to build excellent software, but we don’t need to prove out a new software category or product-market fit. That requires ingenuity and thoughtfulness, and that doesn’t happen with unrealistic deadlines or sleepless nights.
   

  

 Our remote, low-meeting, high-ownership culture gives you
 *a lot* 
 of flexibility in how you structure your days and weeks. In practice, that means you keep your own hours, but there will be moments of intensity, like launching your feature at our annual user conference. We offer unlimited PTO, and you actually get to use it. Some of our most exceptional engineers take almost 30 days of vacation per year.
   

  

 This way of working allows many of us on the team to be active parents, including Benji and Abhik. Abhik blocks off 1.5 hours every morning to spend with his daughter and drop her off at school. Mujda (Product Engineer) puts it best in an article about us: “I can say that Ashby is a great place to be a mom… No one bats an eye if I have to take my kid to a doctor’s appointment or have to work weird hours because childcare fell through.”
   

  

 Interview Process
   

  

 At Ashby, Our Team And Interview Process Want To Help You Show Your Best Self. We’ll Dive Into Past Projects And Simulate Working Together. Our Interview Process Is Six Interviews In The Following Order
   

  

* Intro Call (30m) - Discuss your application questions, align on the responsibilities of the role, and answer questions about Ashby.
* Past Experience Deep Dive (1h) - Discuss your past experience as an engineering leader.
* Technical Screen (1h) - Add a feature back to Ashby. You'll spend most of your time understanding a specific part of our codebase and write less than 15 lines of code.
* Coffee Chat with VP of Engineering (1h) - Spend time with our VP of Engineering and get to know each other.
* Meet the Team (2h) - At this point, the engineering leadership team is excited about you and you'll meet our CEO, Engineers, Product Managers, and some other folks on the team.


 I will be your main point of contact and prepare you for interviews. If we don’t give an offer, we’ll provide feedback!
   

  

**Technology Stack**
 I’m sharing our tech stack with the caveat that we don’t require previous experience in it (but a love of typed languages is helpful 😀): TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, GraphQL API, Node.js, Postgres, Redis.
   

  

 When they joined Ashby, many of our engineers switched from other languages like Swift and Kotlin (Ben), platforms like iOS (Tom) and Windows (Adam). We care more about fundamentals (e.g., debugging, abstractions) and how fast you learn. For folks on the team who switched, it's nice seeing changes hot reload versus waiting for XCode to compile 😅.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and equity.
* 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
* Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.
* A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.
* Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
* $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
* $250/month tool budget plus access to Claude, Cursor, and Codex with generous token budgets.
* If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.


 Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.
   

  

*Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.*
*Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.*
 Compensation Range: €110K - €185K

title: Technical Account Manager - Energy Transformation
description:
**Summary**
 MathWorks has a hybrid work model that enables staff members to split their time between office and home. The hybrid model provides the advantage of having both in-person time with colleagues and flexible at-home life optimizations. Learn More: https://www.mathworks.com/company/jobs/resources/applying-and-interviewing.html#onboarding.
   

  

 Shape the way leading global industrial enterprises develop next-generation products and systems in the energy transformation sector. Interested in working with Technical Computing, AI-driven engineering workflows, and Model-Based Design with MATLAB and Simulink? By partnering with engineers, technical leaders, and executives, you will help customers accelerate innovation, improve product development efficiency, and achieve strategic business objectives across complex engineering organizations.
   

  

 As a trusted advisor, you will combine technical expertise, business acumen, industry experience, and program management skills to help customers maximize the value of their MathWorks investment. You will provide technical leadership, foster executive and engineering relationships, recommend workflow improvements, guide strategic initiatives, and connect customers with the appropriate MathWorks resources to achieve measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 The key to your success will be your passion for engineering innovation, digital transformation, and emerging technologies combined with a strong business mindset. Leveraging your industry experience and technical expertise, you will provide trusted guidance on how MathWorks solutions can improve product development workflows, engineering productivity, and business outcomes across global organizations.
   

  

* This position is also available in Munich, DE and Bern, CH.\*


 MathWorks nurtures growth, appreciates inclusivity, encourages initiative, values teamwork, shares success, and rewards excellence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a Technical Account Manager, you will closely collaborate with the Sales Account Manager on developing and executing the account strategy in order to increase the adoption of MathWorks products and services. Through this, you will generate new business and contribute to the long-term customer successes with your account. Key responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Serve as the trusted technical advisor for strategic global accounts, building relationships from engineers to executive stakeholders.
* Drive adoption of MathWorks solutions by aligning customer business objectives, technology roadmaps, and engineering workflows with strategic initiatives.
* Provide technical leadership for engineering transformation programs involving Model-Based Design, AI, systems engineering, software development, and verification workflows.
* Develop and execute account growth strategies by teaming up with Sales to expand adoption, create customer value, and identify new business opportunities.
* Lead strategic technical engagements by coordinating resources, managing complex initiatives, and ensuring customer success.
* Advocate for the customer within MathWorks by influencing product direction, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and demonstrating business impact through executive engagement.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* A bachelor's degree and 10 years of professional work experience (or equivalent experience) is required.
* Expertise with MATLAB
* Expertise with Simulink
* Candidates must be willing to travel up to 25% of the time


**Additional Qualifications**
* Substantial working experience with development processes of global industry manufacturing companies
* Experience in leading or supporting strategic technology transformation initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Model-Based Design as a methodology, System Engineering, software development, simulation, testing, verification and validation
* Strong customer-facing, consulting, and business development skills.
* Proven ability to identify technical challenges, quantify business value, and influence strategic decisions.
* Have a desire to listen to customers and present software solutions while setting realistic expectations
* Ability to interact effectively with MathWorks business partners in Sales, Application Engineering, Marketing, Training, Consulting and Software Development

title: Vice President, R&D
description:
*You'll own the technology direction for the platforms our 200+ utility customers run their business on. You'll lead managers, not just individual contributors, through a shift to AI-powered development. And you'll do it with real ownership from day one. This is your next move as Vice President, R&D at EG.*
**As Part of the department**
 Leading R&D for the Software Utility Companies Run On Zynergy and Xellent are EG's core software platforms for Utility, relied on by more than 200 customers across the Nordics every day. As Vice President, R&D, you'll lead the shift toward AI and automated development, and set the technology strategy that keeps both platforms reliable as electrification, flexibility markets and new regulation reshape the sector.
   

  

 You'll lead an international R&D organisation of around 120 people across Denmark, Sweden, Poland and India, with 5 direct reports. You'll report to Bjarki Björnsson, Senior Vice President for Utility, and join the Utility management team. The role is based in Stockholm.
   

  

**Your Role: Own the Technology Direction, End to End**
*Real ownership of an international development organisation, a genuine AI agenda with direct customer impact, and a platform for your next move in EG's leadership team.*
 The R&D organisation is yours to lead. You own development strategy, architecture, delivery and quality across the Utility portfolio, working closely with Product Management, Customer Support and Professional Services. You'll also set the AI agenda for Utility and share practice with R&D leaders across EG.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* International development organisation — lead and grow a distributed team across the Nordics and Mangalore, building one culture with strong local leadership and a deliberate onshore/offshore balance.
* AI in our products and how we build them — set the AI agenda for Utility end to end, and raise engineering productivity through AI-assisted development, automated testing and modern tooling.
* Technology and architecture — own the target architecture and modernisation roadmap for Zynergy and Xellent, balancing new capability, technical debt and long product lifecycles.
* Delivery, quality and commercial ownership — own release predictability and compliance and manage the R&D budget with a commercial mindset.
* Talent and customer proximity — attract, develop and retain leaders, and stay close to our 200+ customers to turn their reality into clear priorities.


**Your Profile: Technical Depth, Commercial Judgement, Real Leadership**
 Strategic thinking comes naturally, paired with the willingness to stay close to the technology, the teams and the customers. Transformation motivates you, and you know how to lead change across cultures, locations and time zones. The big picture stays in view, without losing focus on what matters most. Structure, development standards and continuous improvement matter to you, and you work closely with Product Management, Professional Services, Customer Success and Sales — sharing practice with R&D leaders across EG along the way.
   

  

 Your background can vary, but to thrive in this role, you:
   

  

* Have proven experience leading R&D or engineering organisations at scale in an international software or SaaS company, including distributed teams.
* Bring strong technology judgement across cloud, data, architecture and the modernisation of established products.
* Have a practical, hands-on view of AI in a product context — from data foundation and governance to what turns into real customer value in production.
* Have a performance mindset grounded in evidence, with strong execution and a bias for action.
* Build trust as a leader, develop other leaders, and sustain motivation through change.
* Are curious, ambitious, and eager to grow in a fast-paced environment.
* Relevant master's degree in engineering, computer science or similar.


**What's in it for You?**
 At EG, you will be trusted to set direction, drive change and take responsibility from day one. As part of our leadership team, you will have the mandate to influence strategy and build high-performing teams, in a collaborative, international culture where ambition goes hand in hand with trust and personal growth.
   

  

* Meaningful impact — lead teams that solve real challenges and build software that makes a difference in society and business.
* Real ownership — take responsibility from day one, with the freedom to shape your role, influence strategy and drive change.
* Continuous growth — find the space, support and opportunities to grow and take on new challenges.
* Collaborative culture — join a global, ambitious leadership team rooted in Nordic values, where collaboration and trust help us succeed together.
* AI at the frontier — put AI to work across our products and how we build them, with direct visibility into what it means for more than 200 customers.


**Our Values**
* Lead the Industry — We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry.
* Make it Happen — We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact.
* Stronger Together — We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.


**We Look Forward to Hearing From You!**
 If you would like more information before you apply, please contact Bjarki Björnsson, SVP Utility, on +45 20 69 95 85. We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and recruit when the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially. Please submit your application through our recruitment system using the Apply button.
   

  

**At EG, we build software that makes a difference.**
 Our industry-specific software helps people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.
   

  

 Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security. If you're ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you'll thrive here.
   

  

 Join us in creating software that works for people - not software that makes people work.
   

  

 Curious what it's really like to work at EG?
   

  

 Explore life at EG, meet some of your future colleagues, and see our values in action: Working at EG
   

  

 See all our open positions here
   

  

 Learn more about EG here.

title: Global Maximo Product Owner
description:
Scania Industrial Maintenance AB is a technical production support company within Scania CV AB. We are responsible for production and facility maintenance within Scania and have approximately 1,200 employees in Södertälje, Oskarshamn and Luleå. Our operations are characterized by continuous development, high levels of expertise and close collaboration.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Global Product Owner for Maximo, you will play a key and strategic role in ensuring that Scania’s global Enterprise Asset Management solution develops in a direction that best supports the business.
   

  

 Maximo is used across Scania to support maintenance operations, including planning and execution of maintenance activities, spare parts management and other processes related to both production equipment and facility infrastructure.
   

  

 The application is used globally, and you will work with stakeholders representing different countries and business areas. You will be the person who brings together global business needs, prioritizes them and makes decisions on which improvements and developments should be pursued.
   

  

 You will work closely with the business, internal development resources and our external Maximo solution provider. While technical understanding is important, this is primarily a business-oriented Product Owner role. Your ability to understand maintenance operations, manage stakeholders and translate business needs into clear priorities will be key to your success.
   

  

**Your main responsibilities:**
 As Global Product Owner for Maximo, you will:
   

  

  

* Own and continuously develop the direction and priorities for the global Maximo solution.
* Gather, understand and prioritize maintenance-related needs from stakeholders across Scania.
* Make decisions on which improvements, developments and upgrades should be prioritized.
* Ensure that Maximo develops in line with the needs and strategic direction of the maintenance organization.
* Work closely with global process representatives and stakeholders from different countries.
* Translate business needs into clear requirements and priorities for development.
* Collaborate with internal application developers and the external Maximo solution provider.
* Challenge and evaluate proposed solutions to ensure they meet business needs and create value.
* Coordinate and align different stakeholder perspectives and ensure transparency around priorities and decisions.
* Drive continuous improvement of the application and the maintenance processes it supports.
* Represent the business in discussions concerning the future development of Maximo.
* Ensure that the application remains fit for purpose as Scania’s maintenance organization and ways of working evolve.


**Who You Are**
 We are looking for a business-oriented Product Owner with a strong understanding of maintenance operations and Enterprise Asset Management solutions.
   

  

 You have experience with:
   

  

  

* Enterprise Asset Management solutions, preferably IBM Maximo.
* Maintenance processes and operations.
* Business requirements and prioritization.
* Stakeholder management in a complex organization.
* Working with development teams and/or external suppliers.
* Driving improvements and translating business needs into digital solutions.
* Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is also valuable, as there are similarities between these environments.


 Experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment and from a global organization is considered an advantage.
   

  

 To succeed in this role, you:
   

  

  

* Have strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Are comfortable working with stakeholders from different countries and business areas.
* Can balance competing needs and make clear prioritization decisions.
* Are able to represent the business perspective while working closely with IT and technical teams.
* Have a good understanding of both business processes and supporting systems.
* Are structured and able to turn complex requirements into clear priorities and actions.
* Are comfortable taking ownership and making decisions.
* Have the ability and willingness to learn and adopt Scania’s ways of working.


**Who We Are**
 At Scania Industrial Maintenance, we work to create the conditions for reliable, efficient and sustainable production through professional maintenance and technical expertise. Digitalization is an important part of this development, enabling us to improve our ways of working and strengthen maintenance processes across the organization.
   

  

 We strive for an inclusive work environment with engaged leaders and an open climate, where we continuously work towards a more gender-balanced workplace with diversity in focus. At Scania Industrial Maintenance, professionalism, collaboration and safety are central values.
   

  

 Here, you will have the opportunity to influence and contribute to Scania’s long-term development while continuing to grow both personally and professionally.
   

  

**What Scania Offers**
 We offer a dynamic and flexible workplace with hybrid working opportunities, including Scania Sergel and Midway hubs. With a structured development plan and courses, Scania supports your career development both locally and internationally.
   

  

 Benefits include access to training at our health centre Gröndal or a wellness allowance, performance bonuses, flexible working hours where the business and role allow, and opportunities for a company car. Scania also organizes events for employees and their families, and residents of Stockholm have direct access to Södertälje via Scania Job Express buses.
   

  

**Application**
 We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV, and kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
   

  

 Please apply as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-09-14. Selection will take place continuously during the application period. Logic and personality tests may be used as part of our selection process, and a background check may be required for this position.
   

  

 We actively work with diversity and inclusion throughout the organization and welcome all applicants.
   

  

 If you have any questions or would like to know more, please contact: Group manager IT, jianing.zong@scania.com, 0700869191

title: Tender & Public Sector Account Manager
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
   

  

 The Senior Key Account Manager – Public Sector, Healthcare & Education is responsible for driving sustainable revenue growth through strategic account management, public procurement excellence, and channel partner engagement across the Nordic region.
   

  

 This role combines commercial leadership with strong analytical capabilities, focusing on identifying, managing, and winning complex public tenders while building long-term relationships with customers, procurement stakeholders, channel partners, and internal teams.
   

  

 The position requires deep expertise in public sector procurement processes, tender management, business analytics, and indirect sales models. Success in this role is achieved through a data-driven approach, strategic planning, and the ability to navigate complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
   

  

 Your Contribution
   

  

* Lead and manage the full tender lifecycle, including opportunity identification, qualification, bid strategy, response coordination, submission, and post-award follow-up.
* Develop and execute growth strategies across Public Sector, Healthcare, and Education verticals.
* Drive business growth through a combination of direct sales activities and channel partner engagement.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with procurement authorities, decision-makers, consultants, and strategic customers.
* Collaborate closely with channel partners, distributors, and system integrators to identify opportunities and maximize market coverage.
* Analyze procurement pipelines, framework agreements, market trends, and competitive landscapes to identify new business opportunities.
* Monitor public procurement platforms and proactively manage tender opportunities across the Nordic region.
* Conduct detailed bid/no-bid assessments based on commercial, technical, and strategic criteria.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams including sales, legal, finance, product management, and operations to deliver high-quality tender responses.
* Develop account plans for strategic customers and framework agreements to maximize long-term revenue potential.
* Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and opportunity tracking within CRM systems.
* Deliver regular business reviews, market insights, and performance reporting to senior management.
* Ensure compliance with procurement regulations, contractual obligations, and company governance requirements.
* Represent the company at industry events, procurement forums, and customer engagements.


**Qualifications And SkillsExperience**
* Proven track record managing complex public sector sales and tender processes.
* Strong experience working with public procurement, framework agreements, and regulated purchasing environments.
* Demonstrated success in Healthcare, Education, or Public Sector markets.
* Experience working with channel partners, distributors, and indirect sales models.
* Experience managing strategic accounts and long sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
* Nordic market experience is considered highly advantageous.


 Competencies
   

  

* Exceptional analytical and commercial acumen with the ability to interpret complex procurement requirements and market data.
* Strong tender management and bid strategy capabilities.

title: Manual QA Engineer - Core systems

title: Handläggare med fokus på informationssäkerhet till utbildningsförvaltningen
description:
Har du tidigare erfarenhet av informationssäkerhets- eller dataskyddsfrågor och söker nästa steg? Hos oss erbjuds du en verksamhetsnära och konsultativ roll där du kan utveckla din kompetens och bidra till ett tryggt och hållbart informationssäkerhetsarbete för Stockholms stads skolor.
 



  





**Välkommen till oss** 




  





 Som handläggare med fokus på informationssäkerhet utgår du från kontoret som ligger centralt på Kungsholmen. Du tillhör enheten för digitalt undervisningsstöd och avdelningen utveckling och samordning. Inom avdelningen finns ansvaret för informations- och kommunikationsteknik, forskning och utveckling samt uppföljning och analys till stöd för Stockholms stads och fristående skolor.
 



  





 Här välkomnas du till en kompetensrik arbetsgrupp om 15 personer som verkar för att bidra till stabila systemstöd och plattformar som nyttjas genom hela skolväsendet.
 



 Vi söker nu en ny kollega till gruppen med uppdrag att stödja och vägleda medarbetare inom Utbildningsförvaltningens informationssäkerhetsarbete.
 



  





**Vi erbjuder dig** 




  




* Möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån när arbetet tillåter för att främja balans mellan arbete och privatliv
* Friskvårdsbidrag och rabatterade priser på stadens egna tränings- och simanläggningar
* Generösa flexramar och möjlighet till fler semesterdagar genom semesterväxling



  





  





**Rollen och arbetsuppgifter** 




  





 Digitaliseringen pågår för fullt och det är av största vikt att tekniken inte springer ifrån informationssäkerheten. Du kommer att ha en viktig stödjande funktion och ett nära samarbete med utbildningsförvaltningens Dataskyddsombud (DSO) och Informationssäkerhetsansvarig (ISAM). I korthet innebär ditt uppdrag att ge stöd och vägledning, primärt till utbildningsförvaltningen och de enheter som ansvarar för att systemförvalta de it-system som används av stadens alla pedagogiska verksamheter (grundskolan, gymnasiet, vuxenutbildning, svenska för invandrare, förskolor och kulturskolan).
 



  





 Tillsammans med avdelningens andra funktioner inom informationssäkerhet och dataskydd ser du kontinuerligt över riskhanteringen och användningen av den information som hanteras i utbildningsförvaltningens it-system och molntjänster.
 



  





 Som handläggare med fokus på informationssäkerhet ska du:
 



  




* vara enhetens kontaktperson gentemot DSO och ISAM
* vara ett stöd i arbetet med informationsklassningar, konsekvensbedömningar, handlingsplaner, riskanalyser med avseende på dataskydd och informationssäkerhet
* bistå systemförvaltningen och projekt i arbetet med informationssäkerhet, informationsklassningar och risk-, sårbarhetsanalyser och olika säkerhetsanalyser
* bistå systemförvaltningen vid hantering av personuppgifts- och informationssäkerhetsincidenter
* förklara hur processer, metoder och modeller inom ramen för informationssäkerhet ska efterlevas inom systemförvaltningsområdet
* säkerställa att informationssäkerhets- och GDPR-krav som omfattas av it-komponenter (t.ex. tecknande av personuppgiftsbiträdesavtal) uppfylls



  





**Din kompetens och erfarenhet** 




  





 Vi söker dig som har:
 



  




* en avslutad eftergymnasial utbildning inom informationssäkerhet, dataskydd, alternativt annan utbildning eller erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
* flerårig och aktuell erfarenhet av informationssäkerhetsarbete i en stor och komplex organisation, företrädesvis från en roll som informationssäkerhetshandläggare, dataskyddsombud eller motsvarande
* erfarenhet av att ge stöd och rådgivning rörande lagar, förordningar och riktlinjer inom säkerhetsområdet
* agerat metodstöd vid informationsklassificeringar och risk- och sårbarhetsanalyser
* erfarenhet av att upprätta olika typer av informationssäkerhetsdokumentation
* kunskap och inblick i att arbeta med GDPR och NIS2-direktivet
* goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift



  





 Det är meriterande om du har:
 



  




* aktuell erfarenhet från arbete inom offentlig, kommunal eller politiskt styrd organisation
* erfarenhet att arbeta med ledningssystem i enlighet med standardfamiljen ISO 27000



  





 Som person söker vi dig som trivs i en konsultativ roll och som på ett pedagogiskt och ödmjukt sätt kan göra komplex information lättbegriplig. Vi söker dig som har lätt för att samarbeta med andra och som bidrar till ett prestigelöst och öppet klimat i arbetsgruppen. Samtidigt som du värdesätter tid tillsammans trivs du med att självständigt planera, ta ansvar för och driva egna processer framåt. Du är uppmärksam och lyhörd inför verksamheten och bibehåller engagemanget i uppgifter även vid utmaningar och bakslag.
 



  





**Övrigt** 




  





 Vi rekryterar utan det personliga brevet i denna rekrytering för att stärka fokus på de kompetenser och erfarenheter som efterfrågas för den här rollen. Vid bedömningen av din ansökan kommer vi endast att utgå ifrån ditt CV och ett antal frågor du får besvara i samband med att du söker tjänsten. Vi önskar att du svarar konkret och kortfattat på frågorna, och att det finns en tydlig koppling mellan dina svar och ditt CV.
 



  





 Vi ser mångfald som berikande och välkomnar alla sökande oavsett kön, könsöverskridande identitet eller uttryck, sexuell läggning, etnisk tillhörighet, religion, funktionsnedsättning och ålder.

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) delivers the infrastructure that powers Microsoft’s cloud services. The EMEA Data Centre Delivery (DCD) team leads the end-to-end Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) delivery of data centers across the region. The Microsoft portfolio consists of complex, multi-disciplinary, large scale, multi-year datacenter construction and lease projects. We are looking for a passionate, high-energy individual to help build the cloud datacenters that power the world’s largest online services.
   

  

 We are seeking a Construction Project Manager to lead our team in the development of the Stockholm Metro in Sweden.
   

  

 As the Construction Project Manager
 **,** 
 you will lead the Stockholm campus development by delivering multiple concurrent hyperscale DCs. The successful candidate must be prepared to support multiple site locations as needed, with the role expected to be primarily site based.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the safe, secure, compliant, and predictable delivery of the Stockholm Metro portfolio, currently covering six concurrent data center projects at different stages of design, construction, commissioning, and turnover.
* Establish the metro delivery strategy, governance model, priorities, and integrated plans across scope, schedule, cost, capacity, quality, sustainability, and operational readiness.
* Align campus and project teams, regional leaders, business partners, utilities, authorities, and other key stakeholders around shared outcomes, clear ownership, and timely decision-making.
* Maintain strong financial and commercial control across budgets, forecasts, change orders, contingencies, procurement, contracts, and vendor performance, taking corrective action when delivery or value is at risk.
* Own metro-level risk, safety, security, quality, and regulatory performance, using clear metrics and assurance mechanisms to identify issues early, strengthen accountability, and apply lessons learned across projects.
* Lead and develop a high-performing, inclusive organization, ensuring the right leadership, resources, capabilities, and delivery partners are in place as the Vaasa Metro continues to grow.
* Provide senior technical and constructability leadership, resolve complex cross-project dependencies, and drive improvements, standardization, recovery, or acceleration plans where required.


**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND significant related experience OR equivalent experience.
* Business fluency in English


**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND significant related experience OR equivalent experience.
* Solid experience working on data center projects.
* Solid project management experience.
* Solid people management experience
* Business fluency in Finnish and Swedish


**Background Check Requirements**
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
   

  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.


 Construction Project Management IC5 - The typical base pay range for this role across Sweden is kr 834,000.00 - kr 1,421,000.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.
   

  

**Find Additional Benefits And Pay Information Here**
 https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/sweden-corporate-pay.html
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
 **requesting accommodations.**

title: Endpoint Management Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
 At Sobi, each person brings their unique talents to work as a team and make a difference. We are dedicated to developing and delivering innovative therapies to improve the lives of people who live with a rare disease. Our edge comes from our team of people and our commitment to patients.
   

  

 Here At Sobi, Our Mission And Culture Get Us Excited To Come To Work Every Day, But Here Are a Few More Reasons To Join Our Team
   

  

* Competitive compensation for your work
* Emphasis on work/life balance
* Collaborative and team-oriented environment
* Opportunities for professional growth
* Diversity and Inclusion
* Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments


**Job Description**
 The IT department, a part of IS/IT, are responsible for architecture, strategy, maintenance and support of SOBIs Microsoft platforms, infrastructure such as clients, servers, network. The IT department consist of five teams – Infrastructure, Service desk, IT security, Digital Workplace & AI and Automation & Integration. IT work according to Sobi’s quality framework based on ITIL.
   

  

 As a Digital Workplace IT Operations Manager for Device and Applications you will work in our Microsoft cloud environment. Managing devices and applications in our Windows client and iOS environment, to ensure security, compliance, and productivity. You will enroll and configure devices in Intune, deploy and update applications, monitor health and performance and troubleshoot issues across Windows and iOS.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Ownership of key elements in the Digital Workplace team’s responsibility
* Lead and coordinate Service requests, Changes and roadmap activities within your area
* Manage and coordinate Digital Workplace incidents in ServiceNow
* Suggest and deliver continuous improvement regarding the individuals appointed systems/products/solutions with a focus on identifying opportunities for process improvement
* Support in managing and coordinating training of ServiceDesk and other departments of Sobi regarding the individuals appointed systems/products/solutions
* Serve as SME for the Digital Workplace & AI, including, but not limited to device management, Intune, RoboPack, applications and trainings
* Application and OS Lifecycle management (Intunes/RoboPack/Windows Autopatch), Apple device/Phone OS and Application Lifecycle Management (Intune/Apple Business Manager)
* Knowledge sharing inside the Team to build a stronger resilience, to protect against interruptions in our delivery


**Qualifications**
* Relevant education within IT or equivalent practical experience
* Previous experience of working as a part of a device team in a Microsoft cloud environment (Intune), ability to create and package applications and configurations in Intune, good knowledge in trouble shooting Windows OS, Windows application and iOS application, good knowledge in Microsoft Autopilot and Autopatch, basic to intermediate PowerShell scripting.
* Previous experience of application management in Robopack, or similar solution
* Ideally, intermediate knowledge about security and compliance related to device management in a global company setting.
* Team player, flexible and adoptable. Pro-active and solution oriented.
* Fluent in Swedish and English

title: IT-supporttekniker med inriktning mot systemförvaltning!
description:
Är du vår nästa IT-supporttekniker med intresse för systemförvaltning? Vi söker dig som vill utvecklas inom IT-support, systemförvaltning och teknisk problemlösning och som trivs i en roll där du får kombinera kundkontakt med teknik och problemlösning. Hos Nexer Infrastructure får du chansen att kombinera trygghet, utveckling och gemenskap – vi gillar att lösa problem, bygga smarta lösningar och samtidigt ha kul på vägen.
   

  

**Vad vi erbjuder dig**
* Trygga anställningsvillkor och fast månadslön
* Långsiktig utvecklingsplan som konsult hos Nexer
* Gemenskap genom aktiviteter som AW:s, föreläsningar och träffar med dina Nexer-kollegor
* Möjligheten att jobba med marknadsledande kunder inom olika branscher
* Möjlighet att utvecklas inom IT-support, systemförvaltning och teknisk problemlösning


**Dina arbetsuppgifter**
 Du blir en viktig kontaktpunkt för kunden och användarna och ansvarar för att ta emot, felsöka, lösa och följa upp ärenden från första kontakt till avslut eller vidare eskalering. Rollen kombinerar användarsupport och kundservice med systemadministration, felsökning och förvaltning av verksamhetskritiska system.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter innefattar bland annat:
   

  

* Ta emot, hantera, felsöka, följa upp och avsluta support- och serviceärenden
* Felsöka och lösa både verksamhetsrelaterade och teknikrelaterade problem.
* Arbeta med systemförvaltning och administration av tilldelade produkter och system.
* Genomföra daglig övervakning och uppföljning av felloggar samt initiera åtgärder vid behov.
* Felsöka kringprodukter och kringsystem, exempelvis självincheckningsterminaler, skannrar och skrivare.
* Administrera användarportal, kundkonton och andra systemrelaterade funktioner.
* Ge vägledning och stöd utifrån kundens arbetssätt, avtal och verksamhetsbehov.
* Dokumentera kundkontakter, felsökning, åtgärder och lösningar i ärendehanteringssystem.
* Samverka med kunder, uppdragsgivare och interna förvaltningsfunktioner.
* Kommunicera relevant information från regional förvaltning till kund.
* Hantera och administrera kundinformation och kundutskick.
* Eskalera mer komplexa ärenden till ansvarigt förvaltningsobjekt eller annan relevant funktion.


**Vi ser gärna att du**
* Har erfarenhet av att använda eller ge support i journal-, vård- eller annat verksamhetskritiskt system.
* Har minst ett års erfarenhet av service, support eller annat kundnära arbete.
* Har goda IT-kunskaper och god datorvana.
* Har erfarenhet av IT-support, Service Desk, systemadministration eller systemförvaltning.
* Har erfarenhet av felsökning och problemlösning inom IT.
* Har god förståelse för användares och kunders behov.
* Är van vid att arbeta strukturerat med ärenden och uppföljning.
* Har god kommunikativ förmåga och behärskar svenska och engelska obehindrat i tal och skrift.


**Meriterande:**
* Erfarenhet av systemförvaltning.
* Erfarenhet av 2nd line support.
* Erfarenhet från vård, omsorg eller annan verksamhetskritisk miljö.
* Erfarenhet av journal- eller vårdsystem.
* Erfarenhet av externa e-tjänster och integrationer.
* Erfarenhet av fjärrsupport.
* Erfarenhet av administration av användarkonton och behörigheter.
* Erfarenhet av felsökning av kringutrustning såsom skrivare, skannrar och terminaler.


**Vem trivs hos oss?**
 För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är serviceinriktad, kommunikativ och lösningsorienterad. Du tycker om att hjälpa användare och kunder och har ett genuint intresse för teknik och problemlösning.
   

  

 Du är tålmodig och pedagogisk i din kommunikation och har lätt för att anpassa dig efter olika användares tekniska förutsättningar. Samtidigt är du analytisk och ihärdig när det gäller felsökning och tycker om att hitta grundorsaken till ett problem.
   

  

 Du arbetar strukturerat och tar ansvar för dina ärenden från första kontakt till lösning eller vidare eskalering. Du trivs både med självständigt arbete och med att samarbeta med kollegor, kunder och andra funktioner. Vi ser gärna att du har ambitionen att successivt ta mer ansvar och utvecklas inom systemförvaltning och teknisk problemlösning.
   

  

**Mer om Nexer Infrastructure**
 Nexer Infrastructure (vi hette då Sigma IT Tech) startade sin verksamhet 2018 och är specialister på en sak – talanger inom drift, support och IT-infrastruktur. Vi hjälper företag att växa och att framtidssäkra sin kompetens med hjälp av flexibla konsulttjänster. Bland våra kunder finns många välkända aktörer som är marknadsledande inom sina respektive branscher.
   

  

 Som IT-konsult hos oss blir du väl omhändertagen och vi är måna om att du ska trivas. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att upprätthålla den goda stämningen i vår grupp, bland annat genom gemensamma aktiviteter som föreläsningar, after works och lunchträffar. Blir du konsult hos oss lyssnar vi på dig, dina behov och i vilken riktning du vill utvecklas.
   

  

**Ansökan**
 Då urval sker löpande ser vi gärna att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vi ser fram emot att läsa den!

title: Verksamhetsarkitekt
description:
Svenska kraftnät är en av de viktigaste aktörerna för en hållbar energiomställning. Vill du vara en del av en dynamisk arbetsplats där du tillsammans med kompetenta kollegor verkligen gör skillnad för ett hållbart och lysande Sverige. Då kan det här vara jobbet för dig.
   

  

 Som Verksamhetsarkitekt på enheten Digitalt projektstöd kommer du bidra till en utveckling av Nät-divisionens förmåga att bygga och förvalta stamnätet genom att nyttja digitaliseringens möjligheter. Det är en förutsättning för att Sveriges ska kunna ha en konkurrenskraftig industri och ett hållbart samhälle. Svenska kraftnät behöver dig. Var med och gör verklig skillnad genom att bidra till vårt samhällsviktiga uppdrag att elektrifiera Sverige.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 I rollen som Verksamhetsarkitekt kommer du att ha en central roll i arbetet med att säkerställa att våra nya IT-lösningarna är i linje med vårt verksamhetsbehov och att processer, information och system utvecklas utifrån ett strategiskt och långsiktigt perspektiv. Du kommer att arbeta med digitalisering av hur vi arbetar inom våra anläggningsprojekt, exempelvis effektivare hantering av projektinformation.
   

  

 Verksamhetsarkitekten arbetar på övergripande nivå med att analysera utvecklingsbehov av IT-stöd utifrån verksamhetens behov, på kort och lång sikt. Tjänsten kommer även att innefatta:
   

  

* Utveckla strategiska och långsiktiga planer för IT-stöden inom området Anläggningsprojekt och planering, samt säkerställa att utvecklingen går i linje med verksamhetens behov och målarkitekturen.
* Driva arbetet i nära samarbete med förvaltnings- och utvecklingsledare, strategisk verksamhetsarkitekt, IT-arkitekter, informationsförvaltare och produktägare.
* Operativt stötta i genomförande av behovsanalyser och kravställningar.
* Delta i att omsätta verksamhetens behov till lösningar
* Ta fram nuläges- och målarkitekturbeskrivningar på både övergripande och mer detaljerad nivå.
* Samordna arkitekturarbetet med division Näts målarkitektur och principer.

title: Projektledare IT
description:
**Bakgrund**
 Klassisk IT Projektledning där man arbetar efter strymodeller som PPS och PM3.
   

  

 Det europeiska kraftsystemet och elmarknaden i Sverige, Norden och Europa är samtidigt under stor förändring till följd av nya regelverk och ökad marknadsintegration. För att möjliggöra systematiska och strukturerade leveranser i Svenska Kraftnäts pågående och kommande projekt med IT-påverkan samt säkerställa god effekthemtagning, söker Svenska kraftnät nu 3 st IT-projektledare.
   

  

 Som IT-projektledare på Svenska Kraftnät kommer konsulten att arbeta med styrning och planering, uppbyggnad av struktur, ansvara för projektens leverans inom tid, samt kostnad och resultat gentemot beställare och styrgrupp. Det dagliga arbetet handlar om att leda och styra projektresurser för att kunna bidra till den totala leveransen inom projektet.
   

  

 Som projektledare förväntas konsulten också hantera och facilitera externa intressenter som har beroenden till projektet. Projekten kan komma att omfatta både egenutveckling och införande av standardsystem och bemannas av verksamhetsspecialister och interna/externa resurser inom IT, varför arbete i team med andra projektledare, lösningsarkitekter och krav- & testledare kommer att vara en vanligt förekommande arbetsform.
   

  

 Konsulten är ansvarig för den tekniska framdriften och rapporterar löpande till sin projektägare och styrgrupp. Vidare kan det för denna projektledarroll även bli aktuellt att arbeta med upphandling samt arbetsuppgifter som relaterar till verksamhetsarkitektur. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår också förankring i organisationen samt överlämning till en förvaltningsorganisation. Som stöd har konsulten
   

  

 projektmodellen PPS som i delar är anpassad till Svenska kraftnäts behov. Utöver PPS styrs Svenska kraftnät som statligt affärsverk av riktlinjer, anvisningar och instruktioner. Uppdraget kan även omfatta uppdragsledning inom förvaltningsobjektet
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter:**
 Som IT-projektledare på Svenska kraftnät, kommer konsultens arbetsuppgifter bland annat att innefatta:
   

  

**Övergripande**
* Ett helhetsansvar för ett projekts tidplan, budget, resursallokering och resultat
* Teamledning - leda, motivera och fördela arbetsuppgifter inom projektgruppen
* Säkerställa att verksamhetens behov tas om hand och omsätts till lösning med hjälp av kravanalytiker, verksamhetsspecialister och lösningarkitekter
* Planera, följa upp och rapportera projektets progress till styrgrupp samt riskhantering enligt Svenska kraftnäts rutiner
* Planering, uppföljning och kommunikation av aktiviteter inom projekt
* Initiera processkartläggning för förändring av verksamhetsprocesser vid nyutveckling
* Vid behov leda förstudier, analyser och strategiska utredning

title: Senior projektledare verksamhetsprojekt
description:
Vill du vara med på resan mot ett än mer elektrifierat Sverige? Nu söker vi senior projektledare inom verksamhetsprojekt som kommer att leda stora och komplexa projekt- och program som direkt bidrar till samhällsnyttan.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Rollen som senior projektledare innebär att leda och driva komplexa affärskritiska projekt eller uppdrag från start till mål. Svenska kraftnäts verksamhetsportfölj utgörs av de verksamhetsutvecklingsinitiativ som drivs i program- eller projektform. Projektens längd kan variera från ett år upp till flera år, beroende på projektets omfattning. Det kan handla om att utveckla befintliga eller nya IT-system, anpassa verksamheten efter nya krav eller utveckla effektivare arbetssätt. Utveckling av IT-system ingår ofta i projekten, som genomförs enligt styrmodellen PPS. Du kommer att ta dig an större och mer omfattande projekt och i vissa fall agera programledare där du leder andra projektledare.
   

  

 Projektportföljen och projektledarna är indelade i de tre områdena Kraftsystemutveckling, Drift och Elmarknad. Denna tjänst tillhör gruppen Kraftsystemutveckling och du kommer framförallt att arbeta med de projekten. Inom området Kraftsystemutveckling ingår projekt som på olika sätt syftar till att utveckla morgondagens transmissionsnät. Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas inom projekt- och programledning samt fördjupa dina kunskaper om kraftsystemets uppbyggnad och funktion. Rollen erbjuder även goda möjligheter till samverkan och erfarenhetsutbyte med kollegor.
   

  

 Här får du jobba med ett av Sveriges viktigaste utvecklingsjobb, i vilket du varje dag kommer att bidra till Sveriges elförsörjning. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med spännande och utmanande projekt och uppdrag i en miljö med stora beroenden, många kontaktytor och snabba förändringar samt möjlighet att arbeta på en övergripande strategisk nivå.
   

  

 Du kommer att tillhöra enheten Investeringsplanering som är beställare för anläggningsinvesteringar kopplade till anslutning, systemförstärkning och marknadsintegration samt ansvarig för projektledning av verksamhetsprojekt. Enheten består idag av 20 personer, varav sju är Projekt- och programledare. Projektledarna inom enheten är organiserade i en egen grupp med en teamledare, vilket underlättar informell kunskaps- och erfarenhetsutbyte.
   

  

**Om dig**
**Skallkrav:**
 Personliga egenskaper:
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har en mycket god förmåga att bygga förtroendefulla relationer och skapar starka samarbeten mellan olika intressenter. Du drivs av att nå uppsatta mål och säkerställer framdrift och resultat. Genom din analytiska förmåga kan du identifiera samband, hantera risker och fatta välgrundade beslut. Samtidigt arbetar du strukturerat och metodiskt med planering, prioritering och uppföljning för att säkerställa effektiva och framgångsrika leveranser.

 I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

 Du har master- eller civilingenjörsexamen med relevant inriktning för tjänsten som exempelvis elkraft, energisystem, elektroteknik, IT eller datateknik alternativt motsvarande kompetens förvärvad på annat sätt som Svenska kraftnät bedömer som likvärdig.

* minst 10 års erfarenhet som projektledare för större komplexa verksamhets- och IT-projekt

* goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

* certifiering inom projektledning exempelvis PPS, PMI, PRINCE2 eller liknande
* erfarenhet från energibranschen och god förståelse för det nordiska kraftsystemets uppbyggnad och drift

* erfarenhet av att leda förändringsarbete i större organisationer.

title: Electrical System Architect
description:
**Electrical System Architect – Join Us in Driving Sustainable Mobility!**


﻿Help us power the future of transportation with cutting-edge innovation!


We are on the lookout for a talented Electrical System Architect to join our Electronics & Software group. This is a fantastic opportunity to take on a pivotal role in shaping robust electrical architecture for our products, spanning hybrid and fully electric powertrain solutions.


As part of a highly skilled and top-performing in-house team, you will be instrumental in delivering world-class powertrain systems that revolutionize sustainable mobility.

**About the Role**


As Electrical System Architect, you will lead the strategic design and development of electrical and electronic systems for our products. With a comprehensive scope encompassing hybrid engine control systems all the way to fully electric drivetrains – including functionalities like Electrical Drive Units and inverters – you will be at the forefront of technological innovation.


Your responsibility is to ensure that our system architecture is designed with scalability, performance, and safety in mind while adhering to industry standards. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams from different parts of the company and impact the strategical decision forward.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and develop system architecture for electrical and electronic systems, spanning hybrid and electric powertrain solutions.
* Define tailored requirements for our product portfolio, interpret and adapt customer requirements for new products.
* Oversee integration and scalability of electrical systems, ensuring seamless interaction between subsystems and ECUs.
* Collaborate with component owners for ECUs, Inverters and other critical hardware to align design specifications with system-level requirements.
* Ensure compliance with automotive safety and performance standards, including ISO 26262 and cybersecurity regulations.
* Tackle technical challenges such as communication network design, EMC impact, and topology optimization for the electrical system.
* Drive industrialization of electrical systems from initial concept to production readiness.
* Act as the central technical expert for electrical architecture in communications with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

**Skill requirements:**

**Your Profile**


Are you ready to take ownership of visionary and sustainable system designs? We believe you are a highly skilled and innovative engineer with strong leadership qualities and the ability to see both the big picture and the technical details.


﻿**Requirements:**

* A Master’s degree or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven track record in defining and developing electrical system architecture within the automotive industry.
* Extensive knowledge of Inverter design, ECU design, communication protocols, and relevant industry standards such as AUTOSAR, ISO 26262, and Cyber Security (ISO21434) regulations.
* Deep technical understanding of EMC challenges, load balancing, and signal interactions within vehicles.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with component owners and systems experts while driving integration across hardware and software disciplines.
* Experience with Volvo Cars, AB Volvo, or Geely Group companies is highly meritorious.
* Strong problem-solving skills paired with a proactive and structured approach to managing complex requirements.

title: Regional Sales Manager - Power Conversion Solutions, Utility-Scale
description:

Solna, Stockholm, Sweden

HITACHI ENERGY SWEDEN AB
**Profession (Job Category):**

Full time
**Remote:**

No
**Job Description:**

**The opportunity**  

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Regional Sales Manager to drive sales and business development for our power conversion solutions within the utility-scale renewable energy sector. In this role, you will build and strengthen relationships with key customers, identify new business opportunities, and play a central role in expanding our presence across the region.


Working as part of a small and agile team, you will enjoy a high degree of autonomy and ownership, with a strong focus on delivering ambitious sales targets. The position involves regular travel throughout the region and offers an excellent opportunity for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a customer-facing environment. While the role does not include direct people management responsibilities, it requires strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions to achieve business growth.


**How you’ll make an impact**

* Develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies for utility-scale power conversion solutions (e.g., inverters, converters for solar, wind, battery storage) to achieve regional revenue and market share goals.
* Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities with utility companies, independent power producers (IPPs), developers, and EPC contractors in the assigned territory.
* Cultivate and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing and prospective clients, understanding their needs and positioning Hitachi Energy solutions effectively.
* Prepare and deliver compelling technical and commercial presentations, proposals, and quotations to clients.
* Negotiate contracts, terms, and conditions to secure profitable sales agreements.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams including engineering, product management, project management, and legal to ensure seamless project execution and customer satisfaction.
* Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats, providing valuable input for product development and strategic planning.
* Participate in industry trade shows, conferences, and events to promote Hitachi Energy's solutions and expand professional networks.
* Provide accurate sales forecasts, reports, and market intelligence to management.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards.

**Your background**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Business Administration, or a related technical field.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive sales experience in the power conversion or renewable energy sector, with a proven track record of selling complex solutions to utility-scale clients.
* In-depth understanding of utility-scale solar, wind, and/or battery energy storage systems and associated power conversion technologies.
* Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation and closing skills.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a global team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
* Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; proficiency in other regional languages is a plus.

**More about us**

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.


Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:


* Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)
* Group life insurance and additional insurances.
* Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank
* Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)
* Health care and wellness allowance
* Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)
* Psychological support program
* Supplementary compensation for parental leave
* Various trainings and education supporting employee development
* Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally
* Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks
* The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today.


Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Gustaf Hedström, gustaf.hedstrom@hitachienergy.com
