title: Applied AI Engineer - Agents & Local Models
description:
Playground Dev is the software engineering company in Playground Group. We build AI systems for clients and for the group itself: agent flows, LLM integrations, internal tooling, and the engineering around them that makes everything hold up in production.


We're in a growth phase and expanding the team across backend, fullstack and AI engineering. This opening is the AI engineering part of that.

#### **The role**


You'd join our in-house client and group deliveries as an engineer. Some days are pure code. Others start with a messy, half-defined problem and end with the first version of a plan.


The hard problems we're hiring for sit at the deeper end of the stack: running local models in production, context management for long-running agents, evaluation that actually tells you something, and the architecture decisions that come with all of it. If your experience so far is mostly calling hosted APIs, this role goes further than that.


We're a small enough team that good arguments win, so you'll have a lot of influence over how we do AI here. Part of the job is also teaching: helping other engineers understand how these systems behave in practice.

#### **Who we're looking for**


A few years of experience, comfortable across the stack. You've shipped AI-enabled systems with actual users, and you know what breaks. LLM integrations, agents, RAG, evals, knowledge graphs: you don't need to have done all of it, but you should be able to design and build most of it on your own.


You can drive things forward without anyone holding your hand. Low ego. We have no room for lone wolves who hoard knowledge.


If you've built something weird and AI-shaped on your own time, we want to hear about it.

#### **How we work**


Three types of engagements. This role sits mainly in the first two:

* In-house platform deliveries for group-wide initiatives
* Team-based client solutions with shared ownership
* Consulting engineering for clients who need extra technical strength


AI is part of our daily workflow, from delivery process to how we learn and solve problems. We spend real time understanding new tools and learning from each other, and the bar is high.


You won't sit in a narrow box. You'll collaborate with backend, fullstack and AI-focused engineers across deliveries, and put your skills where they create the most value.

#### **Things we've built**


A few examples from past deliveries, to give you a feel for the range:

* System mapping and automated migration of large enterprise codebases, using agents we built ourselves
* Due diligence tooling for VC firms: automated analysis of a startup's tech stack, architecture and risks
* Real-time anomaly detection that catches deviations before a human would
* Chatbot products for global brands launching new products
* Report pipelines that plug into Word and turn real estate market data into finished analysis


What you'd work on is the next wave: **the platform and team deliveries** we're scaling into now.

#### **Practical details**

* Based in central Stockholm
* Fluency in Swedish is a strong plus, and English is required.
* Some assignments require extended background vetting.
* No visa sponsorship or relocation support. You need an existing, independent and permanent right to work in Sweden.
* The final stage of recruitment includes a background check by a third party.

JOB\_015548**Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.**

**Your opportunity**


As a strategic rock mechanics engineer, you will have a role in preparing Garpenberg for its future as a productive, sustainable and safe mining operation. You will be part of the long-term technical services team which is working on the mid- to long-term planning of Garpenberg operations regarding both spatial extension of mining footprint and ore tonnage production. This needs to be done in a way that is efficient and ensures long term stability, even at higher mining rates and greater depths. It is an excellent opportunity if you want to further develop your own and Garpenberg’s long-term approach to rock mechanics and strategic mine development and contribute to one of Europe’s largest mine expansions.

**Who you will work with**


You will be part of a dedicated engineering team within the Long-term planning section within the Garpenberg Mine organization. This section comprises of mine geology, rock mechanics, long- and mid-term planning and mine infrastructure. You will work together with our geotechnical team of 6 geotechnical engineers and technicians, collaborating closely short-term mine planning, geology departments, production technology specialists and other technical service departments at the Garpenberg mine.


Your work will also involve interaction with consultants and other technical experts across Boliden’s operations. The Geotechnical network in the Boliden Mines is geographically distributed, but you will have regular opportunities for knowledge sharing and joint problem-solving in cross-functional projects. The geotechnical department at the Boliden Mines Staff is composed of numerous geotechnical engineers, seniors and specialists from various nationalities which instills a unique, welcoming culture that caters for a thriving environment.

**What you will do**

* Work with our Mine planning engineers within Long-term planning and provide geotechnical input into LOMP designs and sequences as well as to our mid-range planning horizon
* Conduct geotechnical risk assessment of LOMP and Budget plans including stope dimensions, mining sequence, infrastructure placements and ground support designs
* Support numerical stress modelling and geotechnical analysis for mine design and planning
* Work closely together with exploration and mine geology to develop a geotechnical block model and routines to maintain it
* Support the development of our understanding of rock mechanics, to include for example structural geology, hydrogeology or seismology
* Optimize economic extraction of resources within the requirements of mine stability and safety
* Explain rock mechanics strategy to the wider mine organization and other stakeholders
* Participate in research and development initiatives focused on rock mechanics and mining innovation
* Provide technical guidance and support effective collaboration across the organization

**What you bring**

* A master’s degree in geotechnical and/or mining engineering
* Experience with underground hard-rock mining
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ability to explain complex concepts clearly and proficiency with relevant software
* Strong computer skills, including experience with CAD software, preferably Deswik and other technical applications
* Good communication skills and the ability to write technical reports and communicate results to stakeholders
* Flexibility and openness to varying work assignments
* Fluency in English
* Fluency in Swedish, or a willingness to learn this quickly
* Valid B-class driver’s license

**It´s an advantage if you have:**

* Advanced numerical modelling experience using the ITASCA suite
* Experience with seismic monitoring using the IMS suite and mXrap
* Experience with deep, seismically active underground sublevel stoping mines
* Experience with feasibility studies and/or expansion projects

**Why work with us**


At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a workplace where we believe in collaboration and where what you contribute will have a direct impact on future generations. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world.

**Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!**


At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us stay at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. Therefore, we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.


Want to know more about the position? Contact hiring manager, Ottomar.Brussee@boliden.com.


Questions about the application are answered by our Talent Acquisition Partner, Helen.Eklid@boliden.com.


For union information, please contact Kent Hedin, Ledarna, 0225-369 50, Jacob Wallén, Unionen, 070-305 03 82, Morvan Derrien, SACO, 070- 209 05 63.

**Last day to apply: 15 October 2026. Interviews will happen continuously, so do not postpone applying.**


As part of Boliden’s qualitative recruitment efforts and systematic safety work, background checks may be included in the recruitment process.


If the position you applied for involves handling explosives, you will, in accordance with the Act on Flammable and Explosive Goods (2010:1011), undergo a background check for approval by the Swedish Civil Contingencies Agency (MCF) during the recruitment process.

*If you are a representative of a recruiting company, please refrain from contacting us about this advertisement. We appreciate your consideration.*

title: Senior AI Engineer - B2B SaaS startup
description:
Senior AI Engineer - Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry!
 



  





 A brand-new role has opened up within one of Stockholm's renowned AI-startups, an opportunity for a senior engineer to help lead & spearhead their tech, with an AI-powered B2B SaaS product making it's mark within a trillion-dollar industry!
 



  





 Having broken both the US & UK markets in the last year, ARR growing, an established GTM strategy and product roadmap, and led by industry veterans with multiple successful startup exits and big-tech experience, the company is in a better position than ever, with profitability looming, there's a ton of momentum and a lot to be built!
 



  





 Now, they are looking for another Senior/Lead engineer to join the mission on a permanent basis out of their Stockholm HQ! This is a role for someone who wants to be part of a super talented & small team with a lot of ownership and agency, helping to drive the technology forward!
 



  





**Role:** 




 ✅Take ideas from problem definition → analytics → architecture → APIs → AI capabilities → frontend requirements → production impact.
 



  





 ✅Collab with Product leadership to define what should be built, not just how it gets built.
 



  





 ✅A commercially-minded engineer who understands that technology exists to drive customer outcomes and business value.
 



  





 ✅Hands-on role combining full-stack engineering, system design, data/analytics, AI integration, and technical leadership.
 



  





 ✅Ideal background in B2B SaaS, e-commerce, data-intensive products, or applied AI environments.
 



  





 ✅comfortable making decisions and taking accountability for outcomes.
 



  





 ✅Less process-driven software engineering; more ownership, product thinking, and building impactful solutions from first principles.
 



  





 ✅have significant influence on product direction, technical strategy, and company growth.
 



  





 What we are looking for:
 



  




* Ideally, the above sounds like you. You thrive in high-paced environments where you own engineering initiatives and roadmap end-to-end, can think beyond tech stack or the next ticket, and rather bring a commercial & product-led mindset where you understand what needs to be built, how we can build it and what trade-offs should be made!



  





 What we offer:
 



  




* Not only a potentially career-defining role & mission, but we compensate this with a strong salary package, bonus & significant equity!



  





 This is a permanent role, hybrid - Right now we are unable to assist in visa sponsorship or relocaiton. Candidates must have full right-to-work in Sweden.

title: Senior .NET Engineer - Microsoft Partner - Stockholm

 I am hiring for a Mid-Level .NET Developer to join a top-ranking global consultancy specializing in Microsoft development. With an exceptional reputation in the Microsoft ecosystem and a team that includes Microsoft MVPs, this is a fantastic opportunity for a developer looking to accelerate their career while working on some of the most exciting technology projects in the industry.
 



  





 You'll work alongside highly experienced Microsoft specialists, contributing to challenging client projects across a range of industries and technologies. You'll have the opportunity to broaden your technical skill set, learn from some of the best developers in the Microsoft community, and work as part of a truly global engineering organisation.
 



  





 The consultancy is also in an excellent position commercially, with more project work than they currently have consultants to deliver it. That means a strong pipeline of exciting projects and, importantly, no concern about spending your time sitting on the bench.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  




* Design, develop, and maintain modern applications using .NET and C#.
* Work across a variety of client projects, helping to deliver high-quality Microsoft solutions.
* Collaborate with experienced developers, architects, Microsoft MVPs, and client stakeholders.
* Contribute to technical design, development, testing, and deployment.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following modern engineering best practices.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous technical improvement.
* Learn and adopt new Microsoft technologies and development practices.
* Work as part of distributed, international teams across a global consultancy.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* 6+ years' commercial experience developing applications using .NET / C#.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming and modern software development practices.
* Experience building and maintaining web applications and APIs.
* Good understanding of software engineering principles, including testing, version control, and code quality.
* Experience with modern Microsoft technologies and the wider .NET ecosystem.
* Experience with Azure or other cloud technologies would be advantageous.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* A genuine interest in continuing to learn and develop your technical skills.



  





*This role requires candidates to speak fluent Swedish and unfortunately cannot support visa sponsorships.* 




  





**Why join?** 




  




* Join a top-ranking Microsoft consultancy and work alongside Microsoft MVPs and leading specialists.
* Work on exciting projects with a strong pipeline of work (more projects than consultants, so no bench concerns).
* Be part of a global team with plenty of opportunities to learn and progress your career.
* Enjoy a genuinely strong and sociable team culture, with summer and winter parties, sports clubs, after-work events, and regular opportunities to get to know your colleagues outside of work.



  





**Please apply via the Easy Apply function.** 




  





**For more information, please email l.letchford@tenthrevolution.com.**

title: QA Engineer [Fixed Term]
description:
Avalanche Studios Group are looking for a skilled QA Engineer for our successful title theHunter: Call of the Wild.
   

  

 As Senior QA Engineer, you will be responsible for managing the holistic quality of a robust, live title, maintaining and executing test passes, investigating complex and confounding issues, and coordinating with developers across all disciplines to ensure that maintain our quality targets with every release.
   

  

 The role is in our Live Operations QA, which focuses on delivering the entire game on time and at quality to all the various folks who depend on it.
   

  

 We need a passionate and dynamic team member, whose attitude is backed up by their experience in QA helping to create great quality games, having worked as an experienced QA Engineer on at least one released project.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Collaborating with Production to ensure satisfactory coverage and risk management across an entire release cycle.
* Investigating, triaging, prioritizing, and managing bugs.
* Planning and executing regression testing and release readiness testing.
* Coordinating across disciplines and teams to drive quality results.


**Who You Are**
* 5+ years experience in Video Games Quality Assurance (preferable experience from shipping AA or AAA games).
* Experience from working as embedded QA within a development team.
* Excellent communication skills – must possess excellent English verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Knowledge of bug writing and bug tracking software.
* Experience with testing tools and live product(s) with a frequent release cycle.
* Console & PC testing experience.


**Desired Qualifications**
* Able to define QA strategy, approach and execution.
* Passion for games, the industry and next-generation technology across multiple platforms.
* Able to build a detailed test plan that is flexible with ongoing changes in features and verifies builds for full production testing.


 Note: Research shows under-represented groups in the industry might not apply to a job if they don’t check off every requirement. At Avalanche, we’re more about your drive to learn and interest in tackling challenges than what’s on your resume! So don’t stress if you don’t tick every box— shoot us your application anyway! Diverse opinions and different experiences are what make our teams so great, not itemized lists of qualifications.
   

  

**The Stockholm location**
 Our Stockholm office is situated in Södermalm, the beating heart of the city’s game industry. It’s a physical representation of our games – the lush vegetation of Just Cause and theHunter: Call of the Wild meets corroded metal straight out of Mad Max. Our hybrid model requires you to be in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays to foster collaboration and creativity.
   

  

**Our values**
 At Avalanche Studios Group, we create worlds beyond limits. But that’s not exclusive to our games, so we’re committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. All Avalanchers have a shared responsibility to create an open work environment where everyone is treated equally and respectfully. Being part of our world is not contingent on your heritage, your gender, or sexual orientation. It’s all about your passion and creativity.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 To apply for this position, please register below and provide your CV in English. We review applications continuously. All further studio-related information is provided under a non-disclosure agreement.
   

  

 At Avalanche Studios Group we're always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our passionate team, but please note that relocation assistance is not available for this role.

**Hyper-growth Enterprise AI Scale-up** 




**Location: Sweden** 




**Salary: Market-leading salary + bonus + stock** 




  





**The Role** 




 We’re hiring a senior technology professional to play a key role in the next stage of the company’s growth. This is a broad position with exposure across the business. You’ll work with senior stakeholders, customers, and technical teams, helping turn complex requirements into practical solutions while contributing to the development of the wider organisation.
 



 The ideal person will enjoy variety, autonomy, and being close to the technology rather than operating purely at a strategic level.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Provide technical leadership on high-priority projects and customer opportunities.
* Help evaluate requirements and determine the best approach to solving complex problems.
* Work alongside commercial teams where technical input is important.
* Partner with engineers on challenging projects and contribute directly when appropriate.
* Help improve the way technical projects are planned, delivered, and supported.
* Develop and mentor engineers and other technical professionals.
* Work with senior leadership to identify opportunities to improve the technology organisation.
* Build trusted relationships with important customers and external stakeholders.
* Help resolve difficult technical issues and ensure the right people are involved.
* Contribute to decisions around technology, product direction, and future capabilities.
* Introduce practical processes and standards as the business continues to grow.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Strong background in software engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
* Experience working at a senior level within a technology company.
* A track record of solving complex technical problems in real-world environments.
* Comfortable communicating with engineers, executives, customers, and commercial teams.
* Experience working in a startup, scale-up, or similarly entrepreneurial environment.
* Some experience managing, mentoring, or developing technical talent.
